jobs.description: San Francisco Bay Area (on\-site) or USA (remote) Job Type Full Time **About the Company** --------------------- Beehive AI provides a generative AI platform designed specifically for an organization’s unique qualitative data. With self\-learning language models, validated by human experts, and built\-in statistical analysis, research and insights leaders can quickly, accurately, and safely analyze their qualitative data, and combine it with quantitative data, to generate more robust customer insights. Beehive AI ingests data from any insights program running in the organization, breaking down silos between data sets and creating a more consistent approach to analysis. jobs.title: BIW/Conversion Structures Engineer – Mobility Vehicles
jobs.description: **What your day looks like** ---------------------------- You start by opening your CAD workstation and translating early concepts and physical mock‑ups into robust body and floor structures. As the design matures, you carry it all the way through release—making careful choices about steel and aluminum, validating load paths, and ensuring joints are production‑ready. Mid‑morning, you’re refining how structural adhesives and bonding methods work alongside welded joints so assemblies hold up on the line and in service. After lunch, you’re engineering moving systems—closures, door operators, suspension modifications, and ramp mechanisms—that integrate seamlessly with modified structures. Every change you make is checked against the rules that matter: FMVSS, ADA requirements, and mobility industry safety standards. You plan and lead DV and PV prototype builds, coordinate crash testing, and map design, purchasing, assembly, and test activities to project milestones using Stage Gate/APQP processes. As designs approach launch, you partner closely with purchasing, parts, and production to hit cost, quality, and timing targets—never compromising safety. Between launches, you hunt for ways to standardize parts across platforms, close out root‑cause investigations, and drive continuous engineering improvements on vehicles already in production. **What you’ll own** ------------------- * Design and validation of conversion body/floor structures in CAD from concept through release * Selection/design of steel and aluminum components balancing weight, capacity, and strength * Definition of welded joints with complementary structural adhesive/bonding applications * Integration of closures, door operators, suspension changes, and ramp mechanisms * Compliance stewardship for FMVSS, ADA, and mobility industry safety standards * Leadership of DV/PV prototype builds and coordination of crash testing * Project planning across design, purchasing, assembly, and testing with Stage Gate/APQP * Launch support with purchasing/parts/production to meet cost, quality, and timing goals * Standardization across platforms and support for RCA, engineering changes, and field improvements **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or related field * 3–5\+ years in BIW/body structures/vehicle structural engineering * Proficiency in CATIA, SolidWorks, or AutoCAD * Working knowledge of sheet metal fabrication, welding, structural adhesives/bonding, and automotive materials * Hands‑on with FEA, DFA/DFM, DOE, DFMEA/PFMEA, DVP\&R, 8D/problem solving, GD\&T, and tolerance stack‑ups * Understanding of FMVSS related to crash dynamics and vehicle safety testing * Strong problem‑solving, attention to detail, and clear written/verbal communication * Comfort thriving in a fast‑paced environment and meeting deadlines under pressure **Bonus points** ---------------- * Background in vehicle upfitting, specialty vehicles, or mobility conversions * Familiarity with FMVSS specifics, SAE J2249 securement requirements, and NMEDA QAP * Experience with ANSYS, LS‑DYNA, or HyperWorks **Domain experience** --------------------- Proficiency working with Wheelchair Accessible Vehicles (WAV) and mobility conversions.

jobs.title: Data Warehouse Programmer/Analyst
jobs.description: The Supreme Court of Nevada, Administrative Office of the Courts (AOC), is seeking a Data Warehouse Programmer/Analyst to support and expand the Nevada Courts Data Warehouse. The Data Warehouse Programmer/Analyst plays a crucial role in Nevada Courts Data Warehouse in developing, maintaining, testing, and supporting the programming and data transformations that move court data into reliable statewide reporting structures. The incumbent applies advanced programming and database skills to develop complex queries, stored procedures, data transformations, and automated processes. This position works closely with stakeholders to understand business requirements, implement approved business rules, resolve data and programming issues, and expand the Data Warehouse and related data services to support current and future AOC initiatives. This position may require travel to various court locations throughout Nevada and occasional travel outside of Nevada. Occasional overtime and work on holidays, nights, and/or weekends may be required. This position can be located in Carson City or Las Vegas. After an initial training period, there may be an opportunity for a hybrid remote/in\-office schedule. **Please note: This position is inellegible to work fully remote. The selected candidate is required to work from the Carson City or Las Vegas office.** **Examples of Duties** * Business Analysis and Solutions Design: Work closely with business stakeholders to gather and document requirements, understand business processes, and identify opportunities for improvement. Create detailed technical designs and implement solutions that align with business requirements and architectural standards. * Translate business needs into technical specifications and actionable plans. * Support integration of new court systems, data sources, and AOC applications into the Data Warehouse and related reporting environment. * Support future AOC initiatives that depend on consistent data collection, transformation, integration, and reporting. * Participate in requirements analysis, technical design, coding, testing, deployment, and post\-implementation support for Data Warehouse enhancements. * Develop and execute test plans to validate solutions. * Work with other units of the AOC to ensure transformations reflect approved business rules and produce reliable reporting data and/or metrics. * Database Development: Develop, maintain, and support Data Warehouse code, scripts, queries, procedures, jobs, and data\-transformation processes. * Build and maintain extract, transform, and load processes that collect, standardize, validate, and load court data from approved source systems. * Develop and maintain SQL queries, stored procedures, views, functions, and other code used for data integration, validation, reporting, and analysis. * Optimize code and data\-processing workflows for performance, scalability, maintainability, and efficient use of resources. * Technical Support and Documentation: Provide support for production databases and applications, troubleshoot issues, and implement solutions in a timely manner. Monitor and enhance system performance. Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for database structures, processes, and system configurations. Ensure documentation is up\-to\-date and accessible. * Troubleshoot failed or incomplete data loads, transformation errors, mapping issues, performance problems, and other programming defects. * Maintain source\-to\-target mappings, transformation specifications, code documentation, dependencies, version history, and operational runbooks. * Assist with user acceptance testing and validation of data transformations, reports, and interfaces before production release. * Collaboration: Work with cross\-functional teams, including end users, developers, data analysts, and project managers, to ensure successful project delivery and integration. Participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing. * Security: Apply secure coding, change\-management, source\-control, and release\-management practices established by the AOC. * Protect confidential, restricted, and sensitive court information and comply with applicable judiciary policies governing data access and use. * Follow department policies and procedures. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Qualifications** * Two to five years of professional programming or data\-engineering experience involving relational databases, structured data, integrations, or enterprise reporting environments. * Strong SQL skills and experience developing queries, stored procedures, scripts, or comparable database programming components. * Knowledge of data structures, database concepts, testing, error handling, logging, source control, and software development practices. * Ability to analyze technical problems, trace data through multiple processing steps, and develop maintainable solutions. * Skilled at delivering precise, high\-quality documentation for system requirements, codebases, data mappings, test results, and technical dependencies. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders. If this position is approved for remote/hybrid work, the incumbent is required to work a minimum of 40 hours in the office per pay period, in accordance with a supervisor\-approved schedule. The remaining work hours are eligible to be performed remotely in accordance with operational needs and applicable remote\-work policies. The incumbent must be able to work effectively and collaborate with employees while working remotely. The individual must be proficient in virtual meeting platforms such as Microsoft Teams and be able to perform all duties through a reliable internet connection provided by the employee. The internet connection must be sufficient to support all job functions, with a minimum download speed of 50–100 Mbps. Higher speeds may be necessary if the connection is shared with other members of the household. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience developing or maintaining ETL/ELT processes, data transformations, interfaces, or automated data workflows. * Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, integration services, or scripting languages. * Experience with AWS services including S3, Redshift, and Glue or similar cloud platforms. **Additional** **Benefits include:** * **Health Insurance:** medical, dental, prescription, vision, life and disability insurance programs for employees and dependents/family are offered through the Public Employees’ Benefits Program (PEBP). * **Vacation:** Accrual of three weeks of annual leave each year. * **Sick Leave:** Accrual of three weeks of sick leave each year. * **Holidays:** 12 paid holidays per year. * **Retirement:** Participation in the Nevada Public Employees’ Retirement System (PERS). * **Deferred Compensation:** The State has a voluntary deferred compensation program. * **No Nevada state income tax.** * **Positions are eligible for Public Service Loan Forgiveness.** * **Flexibility:** a work\-life balance beyond compare! Those applications submitted without both documents will not be considered.** **This recruitment will remain open until the position is filled or a suitable number of applications have been received. Qualified applicants are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.**

hands\-on integration, modifications, and repairs across robotic, mechanical, electrical, and controls domains. * Plan and execute testing and runoffs to verify functionality against customer and contractual requirements. * Conduct quality checks and help ensure compliance with company safety policies and electrical codes. * Diagnose root causes and implement durable corrective actions. ### electromechanical control systems at Automation Solutions and at customer facilities. * Support customer production startup and resolve controls\-related issues during commissioning. * Document programming changes, troubleshooting steps, work completed, and system configurations. * Inspect controls panels, field wiring, and installed equipment for quality. * Represent Automation Solutions professionally on every site visit. ### **Shop and Workplace** * Maintain a clean, safe, well\-organized work area. * Assist with general housekeeping across fabrication and shop spaces. * Follow safety procedures and use required PPE. * Work safely around energized electrical systems, industrial machinery, and robotic equipment. **Qualifications** ------------------ ### **Education** * background (including ladder logic) for creation, modification, and troubleshooting. * Hands\-on exposure to one or more: PLCs, HMIs, variable frequency drives, servo/motion systems, industrial robots, machine vision, and industrial networks. * Ability to read and work from full electrical drawing sets. * Practical experience integrating, modifying, troubleshooting, or repairing industrial control systems. * Preferred: Supporting custom machinery, automated manufacturing equipment, or robotics. * Preferred: Creating or revising electrical drawings. * Preferred: Commissioning, installation, startup, or field service experience. ### **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** * Expert troubleshooting and problem\-solving in industrial controls. * Strong computer literacy and technical software proficiency. * Clear written and verbal communicator. * Experience with Allen\-Bradley, Omron, Siemens, GE, or similar PLC platforms. * Ability to diagnose electrical, mechanical, programming, networking, and integration issues. * Skilled at conveying technical information to customers, engineers, and technicians. * Capable of managing multiple priorities and adapting to evolving project needs. * Effective working solo or within multidisciplinary teams. * Highly organized with strong documentation habits. * Self\-driven, dependable, and accountable. * Comfortable with hands\-on work in both shop and field environments. ### **Travel and Field\-Service** * Willing and able to travel approximately 25%, dictated by project and customer requirements. * Travel for installation, commissioning, startup, troubleshooting, training, and post\-delivery support; some trips may require overnights. * Frequency and duration of travel will vary with schedules and customer needs. * Capable of working at industrial/manufacturing facilities while meeting customer safety and access requirements. * Maintain a valid U.S. driver’s license with an acceptable driving record. **Physical Requirements** ------------------------- * Lift and carry up to 50 lbs. * Stand for extended periods. * Bend, reach, climb, kneel, and perform hands\-on tasks around industrial equipment. * Use electrical test instruments, hand tools, and power tools. * Work safely around automated machinery, robotics, electrical equipment, and industrial processes. * Wear required PPE. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position. **Why You’ll Like It Here** --------------------------- * Contribute to diverse, custom automation and robotic projects—no two days are the same. * Own the lifecycle: concept, programming, testing, commissioning, installation, and support. * Broaden your expertise across PLCs, HMIs, VFDs, motion, robotics, vision, and networks. * Tackle real manufacturing challenges and see your work become production\-ready equipment. * Collaborate with veteran engineers, technicians, and fabricators. * Enjoy stable, full\-time work with opportunities for growth and development. **Pre\-Employment and Compliance** ---------------------------------- * Ability to pass applicable background checks. * Ability to pass pre\-employment and random drug screenings. * Ability to comply with company and customer safety requirements. * Ability to wear required personal protective equipment. Automation Solutions and Livingston \& Haven consider all qualified applicants without regard to age, race, color, national origin, sex, religion, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other status protected by applicable law. **Preferred Proficiencies** --------------------------- * PLC Troubleshooting Skills * Bachelor's Degree * Electrical Schematics * Troubleshooting Skills * Machine Building/Assembling * Single and Three Phase Power * 120/208/240/480 Voltage Systems * CAD Software * Industrial Robot Programming * Electrical Installation * Troubleshooting Industrial Automation Equipment * PLC Programming Experience * SCADA Experience * Programming Machine Vision Systems * Electrical / Electronic Systems * Pneumatics Troubleshooting * Field Service Readiness * Industrial Electrical Systems * Electrical Schematic Reading * Equipment Installation \& Wiring **Tools \& Technologies** ------------------------- * Variable Frequency Drives (VFD) * CAD Software (AutoCAD, Autodesk Inventor) * Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) (Fanuc, Allen Bradley, Omron, Siemens) * Vision System (Keyence, Cognex, Omron, Banner) * Servo Motors * Industrial Robot (Fanuc, Kuka, ABB, Yaskawa Motoman, Universal Robotics, Nachi, Epson, Kawasaki)

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Overview** **About Firefly** Similar to how AI tools are accelerating engineering and mathematical discovery, Firefly uses advanced computational and statistical methods to accelerate human learning to develop the next generation of doctors. The Firefly Foundation is a nonprofit that builds the most innovative educational platform for competency\-based medical and surgical training. Faculty use Firefly to assess residents and fellows after real cases, trainees assess themselves, and dashboards turn those ratings into learning curves and precision education plans that training programs use to guide each trainee. Residency and fellowship programs across the United States use it every day. **The role** You will work directly with our CTO and take on a steady share of our day\-to\-day engineering: thinking through technical challenges, fixing bugs, shipping well\-scoped features, keeping data imports healthy, and answering the technical questions that come from training programs. To help make it easy to get started, projects will be well specified and written with a clear goal. As you learn the platform, you will own whole areas of it. This is a good fit for an early\-career engineer who is mission driven to help benefit society, likes finding the real cause of a problem, cares about the people using the software, is friendly and collegial, and wants close mentorship on a small team. **What you'll do** * Fix bugs and build features across the application: SvelteKit (Svelte 5\) pages for our progressive web app, server code in JavaScript, and PostgreSQL. * Investigate problems reported by faculty, trainees and program coordinators, find the cause, and fix it with a regression test. * Maintain the imports that bring hospital schedules and case logs into Firefly, and add new ones as programs join. * Write and review database queries and migrations, with care for data integrity and for who is allowed to see what. * Write tests, review code and have yours reviewed, and release through our deployment checks. * Improve forms and dashboards so that busy clinicians can finish an assessment quickly and read their results at a glance. * Keep our documentation and runbooks current as the system changes. **What you bring** * About one to four years of professional experience building and maintaining a web application that real people use. * Solid JavaScript, HTML and CSS, and experience with a component framework such as Svelte, React or Vue. Svelte itself is not required. * Working SQL: you can read a schema and write joins, and you want to learn query plans, indexes and migrations. * Git, code review and automated tests as everyday habits. * Careful debugging. You reproduce a problem and find its cause before you change code. * Clear writing. You will explain technical matters to physicians and program coordinators. * Good judgment with sensitive data, and the habit of asking when you are unsure. * Authorization to work in the United States, and at least four working hours a day that overlap with Pacific time. **Using AI tools responsibly** With modern software engineering migrating to AI coding assistants, it's important to use them intentionally, securely, and responsibly. Firefly holds identifiable records about trainees, faculty and clinical cases, so how you use those tools matters as much as how well. * You read, understand and test everything you ship, whoever or whatever wrote it. * Identifiable data goes only into tools we have approved for it. Credentials stay out of prompts, logs and commits. * You give an AI agent the access a task needs and no more, and a person approves anything that touches production. * You say plainly what you checked and what you did not. **Nice to have** * PostgreSQL in production, including indexes and query plans. * AWS experience: EC2, RDS, event logging. * Healthcare or education data: HL7, hospital schedule exports, HIPAA or FERPA. * Python or R, or an interest in statistics. * Time on a small team, at a nonprofit, or in medical education. **Apply** Please send resume, email address, your website if you have one, no cover letter is required. However, please include answers to the following questions below in your application: 1\. Link to code or a project you built (optional). Tell us about a project you're proud of. What did you personally build, and how did you know it worked? (150 words at most) 2\. Tell us about a bug that took real effort to track down. How did you find the cause? (150 words at most) 3\. Describe a recent task where you used an AI coding tool, and a time you decided not to trust its output. (150 words at most) 4\. Optional: Have you worked, studied or volunteered in healthcare or education? Tell us briefly. (50 words at most) **Pay range** $75,000 to $85,000 a year, depending on experience. The position is full\-time, remote within the United States, and employment is at will. An offer depends on a background check. Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $85,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Staff Software Developer
jobs.description: **About the Role** We’re looking for a pragmatic, detail\-oriented staff\-level developer to support, modernize, and extend the core banking platform used by our credit union clients. You’ll work across a mature .NET application with significant business logic in SQL Server stored procedures, and across the newer Python and Azure services we’re building alongside it. AI is part of how we work every day. Our developers use AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex to investigate production issues, trace code across repositories, write and review changes, and produce documentation. We want someone who already works this way, or is eager to, and who understands that AI output is a starting point to verify, not an answer to trust. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys detective work, can trace issues across application and database layers, and takes pride in keeping complex systems running smoothly for real users. **What You’ll Actually Be Doing** •**Investigating and resolving production issues** \- tracing problems from user\-reported symptoms through VB.NET and ASP.NET code into SQL Server stored procedures and back, often with an AI agent doing the first pass and you confirming every finding against the source code and live data •**Enhancing existing functionality** \- adding features to a 15\+ year codebase while respecting existing patterns and avoiding regressions •**Writing and modifying stored procedures** \- much of the business logic lives in T\-SQL and is deployed to every credit union we support; you’ll spend significant time here, including checking for client\-specific differences before a change goes out •**Directing AI coding agents** \- writing clear specs, breaking work into tasks an agent can build, and reviewing AI\-generated changes with the same rigor as any other pull request •**Building AI\-assisted tools and services** \- extending our internal AI investigation platform (Python, Azure Functions, Azure AI Foundry), including the agent workflows, prompts, and guardrails that keep its answers accurate •**Building on Azure** \- Function Apps, App Service, Key Vault, Cosmos DB, and Blob Storage, with managed identities and least\-privilege access designed in from the start •**Reviewing code and releases** \- reviewing pull requests and deployment plans from the team and contractors, and catching risky changes before they reach production •**Technical leadership** \- making architecture decisions, writing technical handoffs for contractors, mentoring other developers, and helping set the team’s standards for using AI safely •**Supporting Crystal Reports** \- modifying report logic, troubleshooting data discrepancies, and occasionally building new reports •**Working directly with support staff** \- translating technical findings into plain English and providing guidance on client\-facing issues •**Maintaining integrations** \- ACH processing, card networks, GL interfaces, IRS information returns, and various third\-party vendor connections **Required Skills Must Have:** •**VB.NET or C\#** \- 5\+ years working in .NET Framework (not just .NET Core) •**SQL Server \& T\-SQL** \- Strong experience writing and debugging complex stored procedures, views, and functions. You should be comfortable with: – Multi\-table JOINs and subqueries –Transaction handling and error management in T\-SQL – Query performance analysis and optimization, including locking behavior on busy production tables –Reading and understanding someone else’s 500\-line stored procedure •**AI\-assisted development** \- Daily, hands\-on use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or similar) for real production work, not just autocomplete. You should be able to show us how you check AI output before you rely on it. •**Python** \- Experience building services, scripts, or internal tools •**Debugging skills** \- Ability to trace issues across application and database layers •**Windows Forms or WPF** \- Experience with desktop application development **Strongly Preferred:** •**Microsoft Azure** \- Functions, App Service, Key Vault, Cosmos DB, Storage, and Entra ID / managed identities * **Building with LLMs** \- Prompt design, tool calling, MCP servers, retrieval (RAG), and measuring whether model output is actually correct •**Security and compliance awareness** \- SOC 2 controls, least\-privilege database access, secrets management, and protecting member data •**Crystal Reports** \- Experience modifying existing reports and understanding how they consume stored procedure data •**Financial/banking domain** \- Understanding of accounts, transactions, GL concepts, or similar •**Legacy system experience** \- You’ve worked on systems that evolved over many years and understand the value of incremental improvement over rewrites **Nice to Have:** •Credit union or community bank experience •ACH/NACHA file processing •Card processing integrations (ISO 8583\) •**Future\-state platform work** \- TypeScript, Node.js, Fastify, and React for the next\-generation services we’re building •GitHub Actions and CI/CD pipelines •Leading contractors or mentoring developers **What We’re NOT Looking For** •Someone who wants to rewrite everything in the latest framework •A developer who only wants to work on greenfield projects •Someone uncomfortable with stored procedures containing business logic (this is the architecture \- we need someone who can thrive in it) •Someone who pastes AI output into production without reading it and checking it against the real system •Someone unwilling to use AI tools \- this is how our team works, and we expect you to keep getting better with them **The Right Mindset** **The ideal candidate:** •**Reads before writing** \- Understands existing code before making changes •**Asks “why is it this way?”** \- Before assuming something is wrong •**Trusts, but verifies** \- Treats AI findings as leads, then confirms them against the source code and live data •**Communicates clearly** \- Can explain technical issues to non\-technical staff •**Values stability** \- Understands that “working” beats “elegant” in production financial systems •**Has patience** \- Some investigations take time; you’re okay with that •**Keeps learning** \- AI tools change every few months; you enjoy trying new ones and sharing what works with the team **Technical Environment** •**Languages:** VB.NET, T\-SQL, C\#, Python, some TypeScript •**Database:** SQL Server 2019\+, Azure Cosmos DB, Postgres •**Cloud:** Microsoft Azure (Functions, App Service, Key Vault, Storage, AI Foundry) •**AI Tools:** Claude Code, Codex, Azure\-hosted models, MCP servers •**Reporting:** Crystal Reports •**Source Control:** Git/GitHub, with required pull request review •**IDE:** Visual Studio, VS Code Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: AI Engineer, Agentic Systems & Platform

This role is ideal for a strong engineer who can ship without AI tools and then use modern AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, etc.) to move faster with control and reliability. **This role is located in Eden Prairie, MN and is an onsite / in\-person role.** **Come work with us, not for us!** 2nd Swing is a one\-of\-a\-kind, forward thinking, customer\-centric golf retail company. Our employees are highly valued while working hard in a positive and supportive culture. **Position Responsibilities:** * Design and build multi\-step, tool\-calling AI workflows (planning, execution, validation, retries) that integrate with internal systems and APIs. * Build and operate the platform that lets teams across the company take AI tools to production: hosting, CI/CD pipelines, access controls, and automated code and security review. * Centralize observability across all agentic workflows at the company: logging, tracing, evals, regression tests, and feedback loops, so reliability and quality are visible in one place. * Set up shared, sandboxed environments for AI coding agents, and evaluate options for self\-hosted or local AI compute. * Implement and maintain model routing across providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, and/or open\-source or self\-hosted models) based on cost, latency, and quality needs. * Build and/or integrate MCP connectors to safely expose tools and data (data warehouse, ERP, internal APIs) to agentic systems. * Convert unstructured data (PDFs, emails, logs, free text, poorly formed CSVs) into AI\-ready assets: cleaned datasets, structured schemas, metadata, embeddings, and RAG indices. * Use AI coding agents effectively, set guardrails, and review outputs with strong engineering judgment. * Help colleagues onboard to the platform with documentation, guidance, and a clear process for improving their tools after launch. * Stay current with AI technologies as they evolve. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Built MCP connectors or other tool\-integration interfaces used by LLMs in production. * Experience with vector search / RAG systems (pgvector, OpenSearch, Qdrant, Azure AI Search, etc.). * Familiarity with LangChain/LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent orchestration patterns. * Experience with identity and access management and least\-privilege design for internal platforms. * Experience with containerized or sandboxed environments, or self\-hosting models on local or GPU compute. * Experience building developer platforms, SDKs, or tooling that other teams adopt. * Familiarity with the game of golf and golf equipment. **Minimum Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree in a STEM field (Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, etc.) or equivalent experience. * Hands\-on experience deploying and operating production services in the cloud (Azure preferred), including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code. * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong track record before AI coding agents. * Strong programming ability in Python and/or TypeScript (testing, APIs, debugging, code review). * Built multiple production agentic workflows using tool calling. * Experience working with models from multiple providers. * Proven ability to transform unstructured data into structured, consumable formats. * Hands\-on experience with agentic observability platforms for tracing, debugging, evaluating, and monitoring production AI workflows (LangSmith, Langfuse, Braintrust, Arize Phoenix, Opik, etc.). * Experience instrumenting production systems with logging, tracing, and monitoring. * Keeps up with AI technology on a near\-daily basis and can separate signal from hype **Benefits:** * Competitive Pay * Health Insurance * 401(K) company match * Paid Time Off * HSA/FSA * Gym Membership Reimbursement * Discounted Merchandise * Continued Training and Development * Health and Wellness Initiatives * Work Life Balance **Job type:****full\-time, on\-site.** **Compensation**: $130,000 \- $190,000 per year, based on previous experience. This role accelerates technology delivery and enhances operational efficiency by standardizing multi\-cloud infrastructure deployments across Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), alongside cloud data platforms such as Databricks. Working collaboratively across Cloud Infrastructure, Application Development, Data Engineering, Cybersecurity, and Service Operations teams, the Engineer implements scalable delivery standards aligned with enterprise architecture, security governance, cost optimization, and change management requirements. A typical day involves writing reusable IaC modules, optimizing deployment pipelines, integrating ITSM observability tools, and troubleshooting automation workflows to ensure secure, resilient technology operations. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Designs, develops, and maintains Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) solutions and reusable Terraform modules to standardize provisioning across multi\-cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI) and cloud data platforms such as Databricks. * Automates cloud infrastructure configurations, identity and access controls, policy enforcement, resource tagging, and operational readiness in compliance with architecture, security, and cost\-optimization standards. * Engineers and maintains automated CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent platforms to streamline application, infrastructure, and data workflow deployments across development, test, staging, and production environments. * Establishes repeatable, secure release management processes with automated testing, approval gates, configuration management, deployment validation, and rollback capabilities. * Administers enterprise orchestration platforms to automate application workloads, data pipelines, scheduled processes, and system integrations with automated error handling and failure recovery. * Builds automated integrations with ServiceNow and enterprise APIs, web services, event systems, and monitoring tools to automate incident handling, service requests, and operational remediation. * Implements telemetry, logging, alerting, and dashboards integrated with Grafana and ServiceNow to monitor the health, performance, and execution of automation workflows and pipelines. * Troubleshoots automation failures, performs root\-cause analysis, implements lasting corrective actions, and executes approved infrastructure and platform changes through established change\-management processes. * Maintains comprehensive architecture diagrams, implementation guides, runbooks, troubleshooting procedures, and knowledge base articles to support consistent operations and recovery. * Identifies continuous improvement opportunities for automation, orchestration, and self\-service to reduce technical debt and measure results in deployment speed, failure reduction, and operational capacity. **Position Requirements (Work Experience, Skills, Licenses, etc.):** * * Strong proficiency with Terraform or comparable Infrastructure\-as\-Code technologies and scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash. * Hands\-on experience with Git\-based source control, CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and multi\-cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI). * Working knowledge of enterprise workload orchestration, REST APIs, ServiceNow or comparable ITSM platforms, and observability tools such as Grafana. * Solid understanding of cloud architecture, networking fundamentals, identity and access management (IAM), infrastructure security, and operational change management. * Strong organizational, analytical, and troubleshooting skills with the ability to manage complex deployment pipelines under tight deadlines. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the proven ability to build alignment across cross\-functional engineering, development, and cybersecurity teams. **Education and Experience:** * **Required**: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field (or equivalent combination of education and practical experience with Databricks, Unity Catalog, Databricks Declarative Automation Bundles, or advanced data platform governance tools. * **Desired**: Relevant professional certifications in cloud platforms, DevOps, or automation (e.g., Azure Administrator, AWS Solutions Architect, HashiCorp Certified Terraform Associate, Databricks, or ITIL Foundation). **ACCO Competencies:** * **Proactivity/Initiative**: Recognizes what needs to be done a s. jobs.title: Quality Control Engineer
jobs.description: Contract Type: Permanent Job Location: Belgium \- Machelen **Overview** The Quality Control Engineer (QCE) will be responsible for assuring product quality, reliability, and compliance across incoming inspection, production processes, and end\-of\-line testing. The role combines hands\-on quality control and testing with ownership of customer claim and field\-issue investigations, including structured root\-cause and corrective action (RCCA). Day\-to\-day work includes defining and performing inspections and tests, analyzing quality data, coordinating containment and corrective actions with cross\-functional teams and suppliers, maintaining traceable quality records, and supporting audits and continuous improvement. The QCE is expected to be assertive, practical, and customer\-focused, with strong collaboration across Production, Purchasing, R\&D, Customer Service, and Quality Management. **Key Duties \& Responsibilities** * Develop and implement quality control systems, inspection criteria, and testing protocols. * Conduct incoming goods, in\-process, and outgoing/final inspections, including online/offline and laboratory sample testing of components and finished products. * Analyze production data using SPC to monitor trends and process capability. * Define and monitor quality KPIs to track production and product performance and prevent defects. * Manage incoming nonconformities and supplier quality issues with Purchasing and R\&D, define quality requirements, agree corrective/preventive actions with suppliers, and follow through to closure. * Investigate customer claims and field issues; lead structured RCCA using 8D, 5 Whys, and other tools, define containment and CAPA, and verify effectiveness. * Define and maintain quality control and test instructions and test equipment specifications, and audit their correct application at internal and external production facilities. * Translate customer and internal quality feedback into product and process improvements and communicate investigation findings and actions to Customer Service and other stakeholders. * Review supplier PPAP submissions and first‑article inspections (FAI) for new parts. * Maintain quality documentation, including control plans, FMEAs, inspection and test reports, nonconformance records, and traceability evidence. * Conduct internal/external audits (ISO 9001\). * Perform measurement system analysis (gauge R\&R, bias, linearity). * Collaborate with design, manufacturing, and supplier teams to resolve quality issues. * Act as the quality point of contact for production problems, coordinating containment, disposition, and corrective actions. * Train personnel on quality procedures and equipment use. **Required Skills \& Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, industrial, manufacturing, or materials engineering or equivalent experience. * At least 3 years of practical experience in quality control, quality engineering, industrialization, or a similar manufacturing environment. * Practical knowledge of production processes and inspection/testing of electrical/electronic, mechanical, and optical products or components. * Experience with supplier quality, nonconformance management, and structured problem solving, with a hands\-on troubleshooting mindset. * Knowledge of quality management systems (ISO 9001\). * Proficiency in statistical tools and SPC software. * Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, FMEA, PPAP, and APQP. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem\-solving, and communication skills, with an assertive, hands\-on, customer\-focused approach. * Fluent English; French and/or Duch knowledge are a nice to have. * Proficiency with MS Office and experience with ERP/SAP and controlled quality\-documentation platforms such as Power BI or SharePoint. **Additional advantages** * Experience with product traceability. * Knowledge of aviation or airport products and relevant national/international requirements, including FAA/ICAO and CE/IEC standards. **Nice to have certifications** * Six Sigma Green/Black Belt * ISO 9001 Internal Auditor ADB SAFEGATE is an equal opportunity employer. ADB SAFEGATE does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of characteristics protected by law, including but not limited to, race, color, age, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, or disability. If you need assistance or reasonable accommodation in completing this application or during the interview, please contact our Human Resources Department. Req Id: 1671

jobs.title: Founding Lead AI for Engineering US
jobs.description: **Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.** At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. This is not a traditional management role. We need someone who can build something from the ground up, move exceptionally fast, attract outstanding talent, and help shape the future of engineering through AI. We are particularly interested in individuals who have founded or scaled technology companies, built high\-performing technical teams, or led ambitious AI\-driven product development. This person will be instrumental in connecting the worlds of engineering and AI, identifying opportunities, developing new product directions, and turning ambitious ideas into working AI agents. **What You’ll Do** **Establish and lead the Dallas–Fort Worth office** * Build our new AI for Engineering office from the ground up. * Establish a high\-performance, entrepreneurial culture focused on speed, ownership, ambition, and delivery. * Recruit, develop, and motivate exceptional talent, including product managers, AI engineers, and technical specialists. * Build a small, exceptionally capable team with a strong bias towards action. **Drive AI product development and innovation** * Lead the development and expansion of AI for Engineering capabilities. * Bridge traditional engineering disciplines and cutting\-edge AI technology. * Identify new opportunities where AI agents can fundamentally transform engineering workflows and deliver client value. * Challenge conventional approaches and develop creative, ambitious product concepts. * Work closely with our global AI for Engineering leadership, product, and engineering teams to translate strategy into execution. **Provide strategic and technical leadership** * Help shape the direction of AI for Engineering, identifying emerging technologies, opportunities, and new areas of development. * Stay at the forefront of AI developments and understand how rapidly evolving technology can be applied to real\-world engineering challenges. * Turn complex technical opportunities into clear priorities, product roadmaps, and tangible outcomes. * Balance long\-term strategic vision with exceptional execution speed. * Actively contribute to technical discussions, product decisions, and problem\-solving rather than managing from a distance. **Qualifications** **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's Degree plus extensive years of software engineering, data science, or AI/ML experience, including 6 understanding of modern AI technologies, including LLMs, AI agents, and emerging AI architectures. **Preferred Qualifications** We are open to unconventional profiles and will prioritize exceptional talent, ambition, technical capability, and entrepreneurial attitude over traditional credentials. Experience that would be particularly attractive includes: * Founder, co\-founder, or early executive at one or more AI or technology startups. * Leadership in AI product development, applied AI, or advanced engineering technology. * Experience translating complex technical challenges into scalable products. * Exposure to engineering, infrastructure, construction, industrial technology, or related technical industries. **What Success Looks Like** Within the first 12 months, this person will have: * Established a functioning, high\-performing AI for Engineering office in Dallas–Fort Worth. * Recruited an exceptional initial team, including strong product management leadership. * Created a culture of speed, creativity, technical excellence, and ownership. * Identified and advanced high\-impact AI product opportunities. * Delivered tangibl for Engineering globally. * Real\-world impact: AI that changes how transportation infrastructure is designed and delivered, backed by AECOM's projects, data, and clients. * Ownership of hiring, culture, and product direction. **The Person We Are Looking For** * Entrepreneurial by nature: Someone who thinks and acts like a founder. Ideally, they have started one or more companies, built products from scratch, or helped scale ambitious technology businesses. They are comfortable with ambiguity, take ownership, and create momentum without waiting for instructions. * AI and technology to the core: Deeply passionate about AI and technology, with a strong technical foundation. They actively experiment with emerging AI capabilities and understand what is possible today, not just what was possible six months ago. * A bridge between engineering and AI: Able to connect real engineering challenges with cutting\-edge AI capabilities. A background in engineering, engineering technology, or AI applied to complex technical industries would be highly valuable. * Exceptionally driven and fast\-moving: Highly ambitious, hardworking, and energized by challenging goals. Someone who moves quickly, makes decisions, removes obstacles, and consistently delivers results. * Creative and strategically minded: Not simply someone who executes an existing roadmap, but someone who constantly generates new ideas, challenges assumptions, identifies opportunities, and helps define where we should go next. * An inspiring, hands\-on leader: Someone who attracts exceptional people, builds strong teams, and motivates others through ambition, energy, technical credibility, and personal example. A leader who is also a doer. At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.*** **About AECOM** AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan. AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public\- and private\-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. Learn more at aecom.com. **What makes AECOM a great place to work** You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects \- both in your local community and on a global scale \- that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting\-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award\-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

By combining empathy with innovation, we empower providers to improve outcomes and drive operational performance. **Mission \& Vision** Ensure that every patient receives the care they need, when they need it. This role is not available to residents of California, New Jersey, New York, Montana, Hawaii, or Alaska, or of any U.S. territory. **Summary** The Software Engineer is a key member of Abax Health’s newly established U.S.\-based development team. Our current architecture is primarily .NET, but **.NET is our existing architecture, not our hiring philosophy**. We value engineering judgment, problem solving, adaptability, and strong fundamentals over deep expertise or allegiance to any particular language, framework, or technology—and we are open to evolving our stack as better solutions emerge. This is not a people\-management role. Software Engineers lead through initiative, technical judgment, collaboration, and ownership.**Responsibilities** * Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain production software across the application stack. * Develop new capabilities while supporting and modernizing AbaxOne. * Build deep knowledge of AbaxOne architecture, workflows, integrations, and dependencies as knowledge and development responsibility transition to the U.S.\-based team. * Help establish durable internal technical ownership and continuity for the AbaxOne platform. * Spend significant time understanding business problems, exploring solutions, experimenting, and applying engineering judgment before and during implementation. * Diagnose application defects, integration failures, data issues, performance problems, and production incidents. * Perform root\-cause analysis and implement durable solutions. * Make practical technical decisions that balance speed, scalability, maintainability, and reliability. * Identify technical debt, risks, and opportunities to simplify or improve the platform. * Contribute to strong practices for testing, code review, documentation, deployment, security, and production readiness. * Use and help develop AI\-assisted engineering approaches that accelerate development, implementation, testing, debugging, and maintenance while remaining accountable for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability. * Partner closely with fellow engineers, Product, QA, Data, Implementation, Infrastructure, Security, Support, and business stakeholders. * Take ownership of problems and initiatives from analysis through production. **Qualifications and Experience** * Strong software engineering experience building and supporting production applications. * Experience across multiple areas of a modern application stack, including backend, frontend, APIs, relational databases, integrations, or cloud technologies. * Strong system\-design, troubleshooting, debugging, and root\-cause\-analysis skills. * Experience with SQL, APIs, automated testing, source control, code review, and CI/CD. * Experience with modern cloud environments; Microsoft Azure is preferred. * Ability to quickly learn unfamiliar technologies and systems. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools with appropriate technical judgment and validation. * Strong communication, collaboration, initiative, and ownership. * Experience with .NET/C\#, healthcare technology, HL7/FHIR, EHR integrations, or HIPAA\-regulated environments is valuable but **not jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Monte Carlo** Monte Carlo is the agent trust platform that autonomously observes, fixes, and continuously improves agents and the data that powers them — so enterprises can scale trust at the speed of AI. Bayes, our AI teammate, does the work: detecting, triaging, troubleshooting, and fixing issues in AI agents and the data powering them. The result is self\-improving agents that get better with every fix instead of drifting. More than 400 enterprises, including Amazon, PepsiCo, CNN, Nasdaq, and JetBlue, rely on Monte Carlo. Learn more at montecarlo.ai. **The Role** We're building the products that tell enterprises whether their AI agents can be trusted — and we need someone who works end to end, from an ambiguous problem statement through research, prototyping, and production. You'd get the problem, not the spec: research the approaches, prototype, prove what works, build it, and integrate it into the platform alongside our engineering and data science teams. This role exists because agent observability moved from roadmap to revenue faster than anyone predicted, and the work is now on the critical path. **What You'll Do** * Take an open problem end\-to\-end — from research and prototyping through production, killing what doesn't work before it becomes someone's roadmap * Design and ship agent\-powered features — root\-cause analysis, incident triage, monitor generation — and integrate them into the platform with our engineering team * Build the eval infrastructure that makes those features safe to change: golden datasets, regression suites, offline and online scoring, and the judgment calls about what "good" means * Own retrieval and context pipelines over customer metadata, lineage, and query history, and instrument agent behavior in production — traces, failure taxonomies, cost and latency budgets — to close the loop on quality * Partner with data science on detection quality and experiment design, and with PM on what an agent should do versus what it merely can do * Set the technical bar for how we build with LLMs — patterns, guardrails, and the internal tooling other engineers reuse **What We're Looking For** * You've built agents in production with real users. Not integrated a framework. Not worked on a team that had one. Built them — agents with real autonomy and internal loops, where the model uses tools and decides what to do next without a human in the middle, and you kept them running once real users showed up. RAG with a wrapper doesn't count. Neither does a set of MCP tools point at an API. * You've run evals and monitored agents after launch. Agents are non\-deterministic, so normal tests don't work on them. You've owned an eval framework — golden datasets, regression suites, offline and online scoring — not a folder of one\-off scripts. And you've watched agents in production, not just in dev. * Python, plus an ML or data science background. Python is your daily language and you're solid on the backend, though you don't need to be a distributed systems specialist. You understand models well enough to reason about how they behave — you're not an application engineer calling someone else's API. * 3\+ years in ML, data science, or software engineering — at companies that ship quickly. Startups, AI\-native teams, or high\-growth product companies where the release cadence is measured in weeks, not quarters. If all of your experience sits inside large, process\-heavy organizations with the platform already built for you, this seat will be a hard adjustment. * You work from a problem, not a spec. Handed an ambiguous problem statement, you design the experiment, build the smallest version to test it, and take what works into production. * You use AI tools every day. Claude or its equivalents are part of how you write code and do research, not something you tried once. This is backend and model layer work, by the way — no frontend. * You'd rather ship than polish. Most of this work needs a good answer quickly, not a perfect one eventually. You can tell which problems are the exception and deserve real depth — and you'll say no to the version that demos well and falls apart in production. * Nice to have: statistics and hypothesis testing, applied rather than theoretical. Building and maintaining MCP servers. Experience in the data and cloud space — Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, Airflow. **This Is Not For You If** * Your AI work is retrieval with a wrapper, or MCP tools pointed at an API — nothing that decides and acts on its own * Your LLM experience is prototypes, notebooks, and demos that never carried production traffic * You need a fully specified problem before you start, or you're uncomfortable with the ambiguity of a category being invented in real time **Why Monte Carlo** * We created the data observability category, and we're doing it again with agent trust — you'll build where the market is forming, not where it's settled * Series D, $236M raised, backed by Accel, Redpoint, Notable Capital, ICONIQ Growth, and Salesforce Ventures * Customers include HubSpot, Fox, Nasdaq, Toast, and Mercado Libre — your work ships to enterprises with real stakes * Snowflake Partner of the Year and a verified connector in Anthropic's Claude AI directory * Remote\-first by design since day one, and recognized as a Best Workplace for it * Competitive compensation, equity, and a remote\-first environment.

jobs.title: Applied Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: The Role We're hiring an Applied Forward Deployed Engineer (Post\-Sales) to own the technical side of every new customer from the moment the deal closes until they're live and getting value. You'll write production code in customers' Snowflake and Databricks environments, integrate Monte Carlo with their real pipelines, and become the technical advisor they call before they escalate. This isn't support and it isn't a CSM role: your metric is whether the customer is live and consuming. It's an early hire into a new function, so you'll help write the FDE playbook, not inherit one. Remote (US), with roughly 25% travel to customers. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own deployment from day one post\-close: monitors, alerts, and integrations configured for the customer's actual environment. * Write production\-quality Python, SQL, and API integrations tailored to customer pipelines, and clear whatever stands between a signed contract and a fully operational deployment. * Drive customers to consumption. You're accountable for active usage and measurable value, not just go\-live. * Expand adoption beyond the first champion across teams, data assets, and use cases. * Feed what you see in the field back to Product and Engineering so it shapes the core product instead of turning into one\-off work. * Shape the FDE playbook as an early member of the team. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * **Data platform depth.** 5\+ years building on Snowflake, Databricks, or a modern cloud warehouse as the person who designed and built it, not an end user. Production Python and SQL, and comfortable wiring up REST APIs in someone else's environment. * **Post\-sale ownership.** You've owned technical outcomes for enterprise customers after the contract: implementation, solutions or forward deployed engineering, technical onboarding. You measure yourself on go\-live and adoption. * **Range with people.** You can run a working session with a room of data engineers and brief a VP in the same week. * **Builder in ambiguity.** You've operated without a playbook and built the structure yourself. You create motion instead of waiting for direction. * **Nice to have.** dbt, Airflow, Fivetran, or Looker; data quality, pipeline monitoring, or incident response; a background in data observability or an adjacent category. **This Is Not For You If** -------------------------- * You want a support queue or a defined playbook to follow. * You've only worked pre\-sale and never owned what happens after the contract is signed. * Your data experience is all internal, with no customer\-facing context. * You'd rather advise on the stack than write code in it.

jobs.description: **Principal AI Engineer, Director I (Hybrid)** **Chicago, IL** The American Medical Association (AMA) is the nation's largest professional Association of physicians and a non\-profit organization. To be part of the AMA is to be part of our Mission to promote the art and science of medicine and the betterment of public health. Together, we advance meaningful change in health care and the communities we serve. We encourage and support professional development for our employees, and we are dedicated to social responsibility. We invite you to learn more about us and we look forward to getting to know you. We have an opportunity at our corporate offices in Chicago for a **Principal AI Engineer, Director I (Hybrid)** on our Digital Strategy team. This is a hybrid position reporting into our Chicago, IL office, requiring 3 days a week in the office. As a Principal AI Engineer, Director I, you will be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and enabling enterprise AI solutions. This role leads solution\-level technical design, develops innovative approaches to complex AI challenges, and provides architectural guidance across AI initiatives. Partnering with Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Architecture, Security, and business teams, this role contributes to AMA’s AI technology direction and roadmap by evaluating emerging technologies, recommending architecture patterns and platform capabilities, and influencing technology adoption and investment decisions. This role serves as a center\-of\-excellence resource for AI technologies, LLM solutions, prompt engineering practices, AI agents, and Databricks AI tooling. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** **AI Solution Development** * Design, develop, test, and deploy AI\-enabled applications, services, and workflows. * Build solutions leveraging large language models, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, agents, and automation frameworks. * Develop integrations between enterprise systems, data assets, and AI capabilities. * Develop innovative solutions for complex AI challenges where established enterprise patterns may not exist, including enterprise\-scale AI architectures, agentic workflows, and emerging AI technologies. * Create reusable components, frameworks, and accelerators that support enterprise AI adoption. * Implement monitoring, evaluation, and performance optimization for deployed AI solutions. **AI Architecture \& Technical Design** * Contribute to AMA’s AI technology direction and roadmap by evaluating emerging technologies, recommending platform capabilities and engineering standards, and providing technical guidance on long\-term AI investments. * Lead technical design for AI initiatives across the organization within established enterprise architecture and security standards. * Evaluate AI use cases, select appropriate solution\-level AI patterns, and recommend AI architectures, models, and tooling. * Design secure, scalable, and compliant AI solutions aligned with enterprise standards. * Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Platform Engineering on technical governance and solution reviews. * Develop AI solution\-level reference architectures and implementation patterns for AI adoption and address emerging technical challenges. **AI Technical Advisory \& Governance** * Serve as AMA’s primary AI engineering and solution architect, providing technical guidance to teams pursuing AI\-enabled capabilities across business units. * Provide consulting, design reviews, prompt engineering guidance, and best practices to developers, and support education, training and knowledge\-sharing efforts. * Guide technical teams on model selection, evaluation methodologies, testing approaches, and implementation strategies. * Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend opportunities for organizational adoption, and advise on Databricks AI/ML capabilities including Mosaic AI, Model Serving, Vector Search, MLflow, and related tooling. * Collaborate with governance teams to implement responsible AI controls and regulatory requirements, and support model lifecycle management, monitoring, and operational best practices. * Provide technical recommendations that influence AI platform capabilities, technology and vendor selection, engineering standards, and prioritization of AI initiatives; participate in AI Working Group reviews and technology assessments where appropriate. **May include other responsibilities as assigned** **REQUIREMENTS:** * Education: Bachelor's degree required (P1\+/M1\+) * Years of experience: 10\+ years software engineering, data engineering, or machine learning engineering experience. * BS in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or related field required. The American Medical Association is located at 330 N. Wabash Avenue, Chicago, IL 60611 and is convenient to all public transportation in Chicago. This role is an exempt position, and the salary range for this position is $172,056\-$207,000\. This is the lowest to highest salary we believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s pay within the salary range will be determined by a variety of factors including but not limited to business consideration and geographical location, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience. Employees are also eligible to participate in an incentive plan. To learn more about the American Medical Association’s benefits offerings, please click here. As an EOE/AA employer, the American Medical Association will not discriminate in its employment practices due to an applicant’s race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity and veteran or disability status. **THE AMA IS COMMITTED TO IMPROVING THE HEALTH OF THE NATION**

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Denver)
jobs.description: **Forward Deployed Engineer** ============================= * Full time * Location: Denver, Colorado. Hybrid / remote friendly * Level: Senior / Mid\-level * **Salary range: $140,000 \- $175,000 USD base \+ benefits** * **Application deadline: Friday 29 January 2027, unless filled earlier.** This isn't a traditional engineering role. We're looking for someone who lives at the intersection of AI, customer obsession, and shipping: someone who believes the future of software is built with intelligence, not just by hand. Timing: we're hiring thoughtfully, not urgently. Applications will be reviewed from December and we'll keep this open until late January. **Building the OS for Construction** Assignar is a mission\-driven, cloud\-based operations platform built for the construction industry. We help contractors plan, manage, and optimize their crews, equipment, and financial workflows, all in one place. Founded in 2014 in Australia and headquartered in Denver, Colorado, with teams across Australia and North America, we're leading the digital transformation of construction. Our mission is to empower the construction industry through digital innovation for a stronger, safer world. Our vision is to be the source of truth for construction operations data, globally. We've entered a new era. Our engineering org is going AI\-first, not as a buzzword, but as a structural shift in how we build software. AI agents handle the majority of our code. Our engineers own the thinking, the architecture, and the customer outcomes. This is what modern engineering looks like, and you'd be at the center of it. The constraint has shifted from “can we build it?” to “are we building the right thing?” That changes everything: the skills that matter, how we work, and what great engineering looks like. **What does “Forward Deployed” actually mean?** You'll be embedded close to customers: understanding their problems deeply, translating pain into product, and shipping solutions fast. You're not just building features handed to you from a backlog. You're discovering what needs to exist, then making it real. You'll work directly with construction contractors, sit in on their workflows, diagnose friction, and then build. You'll use AI agents as your superpower, orchestrating Claude, Cursor, and the AI SDK to ship in hours what used to take weeks. Every sprint, you're shipping something that genuinely helps a real person do their job better. Think of this as 10% product manager, 20% solutions engineer, 70% hands\-on builder, with AI amplifying every hour of your day. **What you'll own** * **Spend time with real customers.** Join calls, site visits, and discovery sessions to understand construction workflows at ground level, not just from Zendesk tickets. * **Translate customer insights into shipped features.** Move fast from discovery to deployment. Weekly releases aren't a target, they're the baseline. * **Orchestrate AI agents to write, test, and review code.** Your leverage comes from how well you direct and verify AI output, not from lines of code written manually. * **Own features end\-to\-end.** From database schema to UI interaction to production deploy, you're accountable for the whole thing. * **Work on the Assignar NextGen platform.** Our modern stack (Next.js 16, React 19, Supabase, Vercel) powering the next generation of construction financial workflows: EBA payroll, Schedule of Values, invoicing, and more. * **Feed insights back to the product team.** You're the eyes and ears on the ground. What you learn from customers shapes what we build next. * **Push the standard forward.** Contribute to how we build, how we use AI, and how we think about quality. Leave the codebase better than you found it. **The profile we're looking for** * **Customer\-obsessed, genuinely.** You find real users more interesting than abstract architecture debates. You care about outcomes, not outputs. * **An AI native.** You've already shifted how you work. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot: you use these as multipliers, not novelties. You know where AI shines and where to stay in control. * **A strong full\-stack engineer.** TypeScript, React, and SQL feel natural. You can navigate a Supabase schema, build a Next.js route, and ship a polished UI without being blocked. * **Fast and decisive.** You'd rather ship something good and iterate than spend weeks seeking perfection. You have a bias for action. * **Comfortable with ambiguity.** You don't need a perfectly groomed ticket. You can move from “here's the customer problem” to shipped solution with minimal hand\-holding. * **A clear communicator.** You can explain a technical tradeoff to a non\-technical customer, and explain a customer constraint to an engineer. The bridge between worlds. * **Energized by construction tech.** Or at least genuinely curious about the industry. There's a lot to learn here, and it's fascinating once you're in it. **What we don't need** * Someone who waits to be told what to build *  will compound in value for years. No legacy cruft on this platform. We won't force you to use one coding client over another: our shared skills and AI harnesses are reusable across the majority of coding agents, and Grok Bot personal assistants take care of a tremendous amount of administrative work to remove mental load across product and engineering. * Next.js (v16\): App Router, Server Actions, RSC * React \+ TypeScript (v19\): concurrent features, strict typing * Supabase: Postgres, Auth, Realtime, Storage (managed \+ edge) * Vercel: Edge Network, CI/CD, Analytics (enterprise) * AI SDK (v6\): streaming, tool use, agents * Claude API (Anthropic): tool calling, agentic loops, code gen You'll also interact with: Linear (project management) · GitHub Actions · Trigger.dev (background jobs) · Turborepo · React Native (mobile team) **What makes this role different** * **AI\-native from day one.** You'll build with AI agents as core infrastructure, not an experiment. Ship more meaningful work in a week than most engineers do in a month. * **Weekly releases, real impact.** We've shipped every week since late 2025\. You'll see your work in production constantly, used by real construction teams on real job sites. * **Mentorship at the frontier.** Learn from engineers and founders who are actively shaping what agentic engineering looks like. The playbook is being written right now, and you'll help write it. * **A genuinely interesting domain.** Construction tech is underserved and fascinating. EBA payroll rules, Schedule of Values, compliance: hard problems with real business stakes and grateful users. * **Early on a growth curve.** Assignar NextGen is the primary growth vehicle: new customers, new platform. Join while the foundation is being laid, not after the ceiling is set. * **Skills that compound forever.** Agentic development, AI orchestration, customer empathy: these aren't trendy. They're the foundation of how all software will be built going forward. **Pay and benefits** **Salary range: $140,000 \- $175,000 USD base \+ benefits.** Final pay depends on experience and skills. * Unlimited PTO * Company\-subsidized medical, dental, and vision plans, including a 100% paid option for employee\-only coverage * $100/month Assignar contribution towards HSAs * Paid parental leave * Up\-skill training opportunities, coaching, and training * At least one annual get\-together with the whole US team (usually around the holidays) **Application deadline: Friday 29 January 2027, unless filled earlier.** We review applications as they arrive. **Work authorization:** Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor visas for this role. **How we hire** We keep it fast and signal\-rich. No LeetCode. No whiteboard puzzles. We care about how you think and how you work. * **Intro call (30 min).** Get to know each other. Tell us what you've been building. Ask us anything. * **Technical conversation (60 min).** A real problem discussion, not a quiz. We'll walk through something from our actual product together. * **Paid take\-home (half day).** A realistic task on our actual stack. Use AI tools freely: we want to see how you work, not how you perform without them. * **Final conversation with founders.** Culture, vision, and mutual fit. We want you to leave knowing exactly who we are. **What we stand for: Our Values** * Do what's right, even if it's hard or uncomfortable. * Customers are our why. They're our blueprint for success. * Grow with purpose: intentionally, collectively, and for our industry. * One team. We win as a team, learn as a team. **Ready to build the future?** Send us a note. Tell us what you've been shipping lately, especially anything where AI changed how you worked. We read everything. We value inclusion and welcome applicants from every background. If any part of this process needs to look different for you, let us know and we'll adjust. No recruiters please · We respond within 5 business days
