jobs.title: Principal AI Research Engineer, Customer World Model & Proactive Intelligence
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: It all started with an idea at Block in 2013\. Initially built to take the pain out of peer\-to\-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50\+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible. Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy. #### **The Team** Apollo leads Block's work on the **Customer World Model**: a continuously evolving representation of each customer's goals, context, history, constraints, and likely future needs. The Customer World Model powers **Proactive Intelligence** across Block's ecosystem, including Square, Cash App, and Afterpay. Instead of customers searching through products for the feature they need, the system understands what matters to them, anticipates what comes next, and takes timely action that improves their outcomes. Both are top priorities for Block. #### **The Role** We're hiring exceptional AI Researchers to take Customer World Model and Proactive Intelligence from promising research to reliable production systems. You'll set the technical direction, solve the hardest research and engineering problems, and own delivery all the way through production integration. The scope covers customer representations, forecasts, decision models, evaluation, real\-time serving, and integration into the products customers use every day. You'll shape problems that span several teams, connect applied research with engineering and product, and raise the effectiveness of everyone around you through shared infrastructure, clear technical standards, and mentorship. Our team already builds heavily with agentic development tools. As throughput grows, the judgment to frame the right problem, validate the result, and get it through the last mile matters more than ever. That judgment is what this role brings. #### **You Will** * Translate product needs into research and engineering plans with clear, measurable success criteria. * Develop customer representations, forecasts, and decision models from large\-scale event, transaction, and behavioral data. * Evaluate models rigorously for accuracy, uncertainty, and real customer impact, and build the evaluation frameworks that predict how they'll perform in production. * Own the path from prototype to production, including data dependencies, real\-time serving, monitoring, and integration with product teams. * Lead cross\-team technical decisions, act as a tie\-breaker on hard tradeoffs, and build shared capabilities that reduce duplicated work across Block's businesses. * Expand automation across development, experimentation, evaluation, and operations so the whole team moves faster. * Mentor researchers and engineers, set technical standards, and help grow the team's research and engineering practice. #### **You Have** * A track record of technical leadership at a Principal or equivalent level, setting direction for work that spans multiple teams. * \[10\+] years of experience in machine learning research or engineering, \[or a PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field with 7\+ years of industry experience]. * Deep expertise in modern machine learning, including representation learning, sequence or foundation models, and forecasting or decision\-making under uncertainty. * Experience taking models from research to production at scale, and owning them through serving, monitoring, and iteration. * Strong judgment in evaluation: offline and online metrics, calibration and uncertainty, experimentation, and measuring real customer impact. * Fluency in Python and a modern ML framework such as PyTorch or JAX, and the ability to write production\-quality code. * Clear communication and the ability to align research, engineering, and product partners on ambiguous problems. #### **Preferred** * Experience building foundation models or embeddings over transaction, event\-sequence, or behavioral data. * Experience with reinforcement learning, causal inference, counterfactual evaluation, or next\-best\-action systems. * Experience building real\-time ML systems that power customer\-facing products. * Experience in financial technology, payments, or another regulated domain. * Hands\-on experience using agentic development tools to speed up research and engineering. * A record of research excellence through publications, open\-source contributions, or equivalent work. #### **Success in Your First Year** * You've set the technical direction for a core part of the Customer World Model or Proactive Intelligence, with success criteria the team and product partners agree on. * At least one capability you led is in production, monitored, and measurably improving a customer experience. * You've built a shared evaluation or infrastructure capability that other teams use instead of building their own. * The team ships faster and with higher confidence because of the standards, automation, and mentorship you brought. U.S. locations are categorized into one of four zones based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. jobs.title: Associate GTM Engineer, AI
jobs.description: Go\-to\-market is being rebuilt around AI, and the teams that get it right will pair smart systems with people who know where judgment, taste and follow\-through still matter. We're hiring someone who wants to be that person, and who wants to help build the systems too. Blue Orange Digital is an AI consulting and implementation firm. We build data and AI systems for private equity firms and the upper mid\-market companies they own, which means our buyers are skeptical, busy, and very good at spotting noise. We've been at this long enough to earn their trust. We still run like a startup: a small team, a short distance between an idea and a shipped thing, and nowhere for good work to hide. You'll work directly with our founder and CEO, a technical founder, and alongside our sales and go\-to\-market leads. Together we're figuring out what go\-to\-market looks like when AI handles most of the production. Then we're building it, and you'll be one of the people running it. ###### **What You'll Work On** This is a broad role on purpose. You'll own or co\-own programs across marketing and the sell side, each one built heavily with AI: * Newsletter. Grow and run a newsletter that PE operators actually open, with AI doing the heavy lifting on research and drafting. * Media. Help stand up our media operation, including video, which we're just starting to lean into. * Account\-based marketing. Targeted programs aimed at specific PE firms and portfolio companies, so the right people discover us before they need us. * GEO and AEO. Make sure Blue Orange shows up when a buyer asks ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity who to call about AI. * Content. Articles, posts, case studies and point\-of\-view pieces that sound like a firm with opinions. * Sales enablement. Decks, messaging, offers and video for the sales team, plus the AI skills and infrastructure that let us produce them in hours instead of weeks. Across all of it, you'll own the numbers. We already have strong analytics, and this role lives in them: setting up tests, reading what's working, and telling us where our time and energy should go next. We want taste and data working together. Good instincts get something shipped, the data tells us whether people engaged, and engagement is the goal in every one of these channels. AI makes it easier than ever to pull every channel into one consistent view of go\-to\-market. We need someone watching that view every day and acting on it. Some of these are running. Some are half built. A few are ideas on a whiteboard. You'll do the implementation, and you'll also be in the room when we decide what to build next. Bring ideas. We'd rather test five and keep one than debate one for a month. We care about shipping. A rough version in front of a real audience this week beats a polished plan for next quarter. ###### **How You'll Work** You'll work with the tools most marketing teams haven't touched yet: agent orchestration, workflow automation, Claude Code, custom skills, and whatever ships next month that's better. You'll learn how the technical side works by building on it next to people who build this for clients every day. You'll start behind the keyboard. As you learn our sales process, how we qualify deals, and how the data and AI market fits together, you'll move into client\-facing work. We'll train you for that. Nobody gets thrown in front of a PE partner on day ten. ###### **Who Does Well Here** The people who thrive at Blue Orange can't leave a system alone. When they see a tool, they want to know how it works, and they don't really believe they understand something until they've built it end to end. They act before they're told to. They finish things, then check the numbers to see whether it worked. They'd rather own a messy problem than polish someone else's slide. If you've ever stayed up rebuilding a workflow because the first version annoyed you, or wired three AI tools together just to see if it would work, we want to hear from you. ###### **What You Need** * Roughly 1 to 3 years of experience in marketing, growth, go\-to\-market, sales ops, consulting or a startup, or clear evidence you've built real things on your own * Heavy daily use of AI tools, with opinions. You should be able to tell us where models from Anthropic, OpenAI and Google each win, and why you think so * Comfort with technology and a real appetite to learn the technical side. You don't need to be an engineer * Clear writing. Most of this job ends up as words someone else reads * Based in New York City and in our Midtown office 2 to 3 days a week * Rigor with analytics and testing. You set up experiments, read results honestly, and change course when the data says so ###### **Nice to Have** * You've used Claude Code, even if you're not technical * You've run a CMS such as WordPress, Webflow or Sanity, especially if you've driven it with AI * Some video production or editing experience * Exposure to private equity, B2B services, or data and AI ###### **Where This Goes** This role has a lot of room above it. Once you've built domain knowledge in data and AI, paths open into client work, sales, and owning a go\-to\-market function outright. The people who build the playbook tend to end up running it. ###### **Compensation** * Base salary: $90,000 to $105,000 * On\-target earnings: $125,000 to $140,000 Variable pay is paid quarterly. About 60% is tied to sales\-accepted pipeline from any channel you run, and about 40% is tied to program goals you set with the founder each quarter. The split exists because some of the most valuable work here, like the newsletter and GEO, builds over time and doesn't show up as a lead this month. Pipeline pays on the upside. ###### **How to Apply** Send us something you built with AI: a workflow, an agent, a newsletter, a strange experiment that half worked. Tell us in a few sentences what it does and what you'd change about it. That tells us more than your resume does, though we'd like that too. Background checks may be required for certain positions/projects. Blue Orange Digital is an equal\-opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Head of Projects
jobs.description: Location: New York or London (on site) Type: Full\-time ### **About Build** We help owners get infrastructure built faster than anyone else. Experienced development teams, running on our own technology stack and proprietary data, take projects from site selection through construction readiness and project management in a fraction of the usual time. Build is a development firm, not a software vendor. Owners appoint us to run the program: we do the high\-value development work in house, direct the architects, engineers and contractors, and stay accountable for the outcome. The owner holds the construction contract. We keep the decision\-making and the standard, and we leave construction risk with the owner and the general contractor. We work first on power\-constrained infrastructure: data centers, energy and industrial projects. Our offices are in New York and London. ### **About the role** The Head of Projects is a seasoned development manager, someone owners trust to run large industrial, data center or power programs, and someone who has already built a delivery team and taken projects through the full lifecycle. You will build and lead that function here: hiring the team, setting the bar, and owning delivery on the programs Build is appointed to run. The person this role is built for has usually done one of two things. They stood up a delivery unit inside a larger firm and hired it into a real team. Or they started a practice or a firm and ran projects across every stage. They are still in the work themselves, not reviewing it from a distance. They are credible enough that an owner would let them appoint the designers and contractors, and sharp enough that they still want a faster way to get things built than the firms they came from. If you have already done this end to end in a large institution, and the live question for you is whether to stay, go out on your own, or find a platform that lets you run programs properly, this is that platform. You bring the judgment, the team\-building and the owner trust. We supercharge the work with a team and a technology stack built for speed, at cost parity or better with traditional firms. You will work directly with the founders, with delivery colleagues, and with the owners and development leaders who appoint us. ### **What you will own** * The outcome on Build's development\-manager mandates: programs taken from site selection through design, preconstruction, construction readiness and project management, on time and on budget. * Building the projects team. You will hire, coach and lead the people who run this work, and set a bar the rest of the company can trust. Over time this may include a small number of senior hires across delivery areas, not a large traditional PMO. * The delivery system: one plan, one team, every workstream and partner visible, with Build accountable for the result, not the next report. * Design management and preconstruction: coordinating engineers and specialists to a design that hits cost, speed and quality targets, and running budget, procurement and schedule so we meet or beat traditional\-firm cost. * Selecting and managing the firms under us (architects, engineers, cost consultants, contractors) and holding them to the standard, while the owner signs the major contracts. * Being a credible peer to owners, developers and investors on live programs, in the room and in decisions. * Feeding what you learn on projects back into how Build works, including the technology the team runs on. The stack exists to make a lean senior team faster and more reliable, not to replace your judgment. ### **What we're looking for** * You have built a delivery team from scratch, or you founded a firm or launched a delivery unit and grew it to real scale. A team in the range of 20 to 50 people is the kind of scope we mean. * You have led projects across the full building lifecycle: site and development, design, procurement, construction, and handover or commissioning. Not a single stage, and not advisory sitting beside someone else's delivery team. * Owner or developer\-side experience, as a development manager, owner's representative, or the person the owner appointed to run the program. You have chosen and managed designers and contractors, and delivered on cost and schedule. * A track record on industrial, data center or power infrastructure at serious scale, including programs measured in the hundreds of millions to billions of project value. * You still do the work. You have enough cycles behind you to have built and run a team at this level, and you are close enough to the work that you have not gone stale in a large organization. * Comfort in the room with owners and senior development leaders, and the judgment to help win and then deliver the mandate. * Based in New York or London, or ready to be, and willing to travel to sites and clients. ### **Strong pluses** * Data center or other mission\-critical delivery, especially hyperscale or colocation programs taken through construction. * A chartered or professional engineering background (mechanical, electrical or civil), or an equivalent technical foundation owners will trust. * Time on both the owner or developer side and in consulting, EPC or a contractor environment, so you can see a project from every angle without taking the contractor seat here. * Experience building a lean senior team that has run a large portfolio, including in a startup or a new unit inside a larger firm. * A book of owner relationships you can bring, without needing to be the sitting CEO or owner of the firm those relationships currently sit in. ### **What this is not** * Not a software job, and not a PMO that exists to write reports. You own the outcome. * Not a consultant hired by someone else's development manager. We are appointed to run the program. * Not a late\-career figurehead or a sitting founder who wants to keep running their own firm. This is a builder's seat, in the office, on live work. ### **How to win at Build** Growing Build requires a radically different approach to company building. As a company we are focused on one outcome: winning. That means we move fast, work with intensity, and demand excellence from ourselves. We look for people who show: Velocity: You are relentless in asking the right questions to set direction. Once you find the right direction you go all\-in. Excellence: You obsess with being the best. For you, excellence is a non\-negotiable standard rather than an aspiration. Long time horizons: You choose to be in something for the long run, because that is where most of the returns are realized. Ownership: You take full ownership of the outcomes. You are meticulous in your pursuits and believe you can actively shape your environment rather than adapt to it. Customers: You have a passion for the built world and those who shape it. Integrity: You choose to do the right thing even when it isn't easy. Trust: You only work with people you can trust, because it is the only way to do truly extraordinary things. Yield: You have a burning need to see a result on every action you take, and you are always looking for routes to do more with less. ### **What we offer** Radical autonomy, real ownership: High standards. Minimal bureaucracy. You own problems end to end, choose how the work gets done, and are accountable for exceptional outcomes. Ownership is matched with meaningful, generous equity. An accelerated founder's track: Build is for builders. If you want to learn what it actually takes to create a generational company (product judgment, execution speed, and accountability) there is no faster path than building from zero when everything is up for grabs. Elite teammates, uncompromising bar: You work with people who think clearly, execute relentlessly, and take full ownership. Shape the built world: We are rebuilding how the physical world gets made. The work turns into real projects breaking ground. We work with the institutions that build, and you will see your decisions land in the world around you. Compensation Range: $200K \- $300K

The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in building scalable data platforms, production\-grade AI applications, RAG solutions, and LLM\-based workflows, along with strong technical leadership and solution architecture capabilities. jobs.title: Founding Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join an early\-stage AI research team building reinforcement learning environments from high\-fidelity, real\-world data. You will work with the founding team and collaborate with frontier AI labs to help improve model capabilities. ### **What You'll Do** * Build reinforcement learning environments that use real\-world data to support AI research. * Work with the founding team and partner AI labs on projects that improve model capabilities. * Own product lifecycles end to end and help shape technical direction, engineering standards, and processes. ### **What We're Looking For** * A bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent strong computer science fundamentals, plus 1 to 2 years of engineering experience after graduation. * Experience building production services or tools with Python, Go, Rust, or similar backend, data, or systems languages. * Startup experience, such as founding a company, raising funding, or strong results in hackathons or academic competitions. * A product\-minded engineer who has shipped a product to multiple users and is comfortable taking ownership across the stack. * Experience with real\-world data collection, annotation, or simulation is a plus; prior reinforcement learning experience is not required. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary is $150,000 to $250,000 annually. Total compensation may reach up to $1,000,000, including equity. Visa sponsorship policy was not provided. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California. Compensation Range: $150K \- $250K

jobs.title: Founding Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join an early\-stage AI company building multimodal agents across voice, SMS, and email. As a Founding Engineer, you will own a core product or engineering domain end to end, work directly with customers, and help shape technical and product decisions. ### **What You'll Do** * Own a domain from architecture through daily production releases. * Join customer calls, synthesize feedback, and make product decisions independently. * Build and optimize multimodal agents, including low\-latency voice experiences and persistent conversations across channels. * Set quality practices for non\-deterministic systems, including evaluations, prompt versioning, guardrails, and drift detection. * Build across React and Next.js frontends, Node.js backends, and Python services. ### **What We're Looking For** * Three to eight years of full\-stack engineering experience, with a record of shipping and scaling products in fast\-paced environments. * Production proficiency with TypeScript, Node.js, React, and Next.js, plus experience building Python services. * Hands\-on experience building production systems with LLM APIs or agent SDKs. * Depth in at least one area: production voice or SMS agents, long\-running agent state and memory, agent evaluations and guardrails, or B2B2C and marketplace architecture. * Ability to own product decisions, conduct customer discovery, and deliver independently in an early\-stage environment. * Experience with low\-latency systems and production AI or agentic systems. Voice pipelines, evaluation tooling, and infrastructure tools such as Redis or BullMQ are useful. * Strong computer science fundamentals or demonstrated founder experience and product traction. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $180,000 to $250,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site five days per week in New York, New York. Compensation Range: $180K \- $250K

jobs.title: Founding Engineer, AI Agents
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join the founding engineering team building an AI agent framework for farm operations. You will design and ship systems that help agents handle real business decisions, with direct feedback from the teams using them. ### **What You'll Do** * Design and own the agent framework, including roles, tools, permissions, approvals, and runtime orchestration for long\-running tasks. * Build memory and context systems that give agents relevant farm\-specific knowledge, including operational knowledge that may not be documented. * Develop code automation that supports repeatable work and escalates unexpected situations to human oversight. * Create evaluations and safety measures to build trust and track agent performance over time. * Build tools on top of the data layer and integrate machine learning insights into the framework. * Work with farm teams to observe real\-world usage and improve the product based on feedback. ### **What We're Looking For** * Two to four years of engineering experience shipping production LLM agents or agentic workflows that people rely on. * Experience building agents with tool use, context and memory design, orchestration, and evaluation. * Strong Python skills and familiarity with PostgreSQL, asynchronous systems, and workflow engines. * Experience writing evaluations, investigating real\-world user needs, and independently performing system design and critically reviewing AI\-generated code. * Knowledge of memory, retrieval, and context management, including when work should be handed to a person or handled with conventional code. * Experience with durable workflow engines such as Temporal, agent observability and tracing, or security topics such as prompt injection and permissions is a plus. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary is $170,000 to $200,000 annually, plus 1% equity with four\-year vesting and a one\-year cliff. Benefits include healthcare, AI coding tools and model access, and work hardware. Visa sponsorship is not available; candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, five days a week, with about one week of travel per quarter to farms in Washington, Oregon, and California. Compensation Range: $170K \- $200K

jobs.title: Founding Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** As the first machine learning engineer on a founding team at an agricultural technology company, you will build the models and data foundation that help growers make informed operational decisions. You will bring fragmented farm data together and evaluate models against real\-world outcomes. ### **What You'll Do** * Audit and integrate historical data from farm systems, identifying available signals and data gaps. * Build forecasting, performance analysis, and operational efficiency tools for growers. * Develop rigorous backtesting and evaluation frameworks to assess model accuracy before deployment. * Create privacy\-first, anonymized datasets that enable farms to benefit from shared insights. * Partner with an agent engineer to deliver actionable insights through the product. ### **What We're Looking For** * Two to four years of engineering experience, including shipping production ML models that inform real decisions. * Strong Python and SQL skills, with fluency in pandas or polars, scikit\-learn, gradient boosting, and forecasting libraries. * Experience with tabular or time\-series data, data pipelines, and tools that explain model behavior. * Careful model evaluation skills, including understanding data leakage, backtesting, and production readiness. * Ability to explain model outputs and uncertainty to non\-technical stakeholders and investigate users' operational problems. * Daily experience building with AI and interest in combining LLMs and agents with classical ML. * Experience in agriculture, weather, supply chain, or other physical\-world forecasting is helpful, as is experience with privacy\-preserving data approaches. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary is $170,000 to $200,000 annually, plus 1% equity with four\-year vesting and a one\-year cliff. Healthcare benefits are provided. Visa sponsorship is not available; candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, five days a week. Travel to farms in Washington, Oregon, and California is expected for about one week per quarter. Compensation Range: $170K \- $200K

jobs.title: Founding Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join an early\-stage commercial insurance technology team to build and own the AI systems behind an automated insurance platform. You will work directly with the founder, developing tools that help businesses find suitable coverage and streamline the sales process. ### **What You'll Do** * Build browser\-use agents that automate insurance workflows. * Develop voice AI for interactions with clients and insurance carriers. * Create long\-horizon LLM pipelines and robust evaluation frameworks. * Build carrier integrations and AI\-powered quoting and submission workflows. * Develop AI agents for policy analysis and document processing. * Take ownership of technical projects across the platform, from design through deployment. ### **What We're Looking For** * New graduate or 0 to 5 years of software engineering experience. * Strong software engineering fundamentals, including systems design, clean code, and debugging. * Hands\-on experience building production LLM, AI agent, or voice AI systems, including evaluation frameworks. * Experience building end\-to\-end systems in an ambiguous, fast\-moving environment, or relevant engineering experience at an established technology company. * Familiarity with Python, TypeScript, LangGraph, browser\-use agents, or autonomous agent frameworks. * A completed CS or engineering degree and experience in insurance technology, fintech, or healthcare technology are relevant. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary is $150,000 to $250,000 annually, depending on experience, plus founding\-team equity. Visa sponsorship is available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco. Compensation Range: $150K \- $250K

jobs.title: Founding Product Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join an early\-stage legal technology team building AI\-powered software for legal work. As a founding product engineer, you will build core features from the ground up, working closely with attorneys and AI engineers to turn complex workflows into reliable tools used by customers. ### **What You'll Do** * Build and own full\-stack product features, from data models and backend systems to user\-facing interfaces. * Work with attorneys and AI engineers to translate legal workflows and review playbooks into production software. * Make pragmatic architecture and tooling decisions that support fast development and future growth. * Write maintainable, reliable code and take ownership of features through production deployment. * Help establish engineering standards, culture, and hiring practices as the team grows. ### **What We're Looking For** * One to three years of experience building and shipping production software, ideally at an early\-stage startup or as a founder. * Full\-stack development experience with TypeScript and React, a modern backend stack, and relational databases. * Hands\-on experience building with AI or large language models, in production or through personal projects. * Experience owning product features end to end, building data models for complex workflows, and making sound engineering trade\-offs under time constraints. * Strong product instincts, clear communication, and comfort working with ambiguity in a fast\-moving environment. * Experience working with legal or other domain experts is a plus. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $140,000 to $180,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California, six days per week. Relocation is not employer\-funded. Compensation Range: $140K \- $180K

jobs.title: Founding Product Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join a small team building a B2B SaaS platform for AI\-driven pricing and monetization. You will own product modules from customer discovery through launch, shaping architecture and delivering reliable tools for complex financial workflows. ### **What You'll Do** * Scope product needs with customers, design versioned APIs, build user interfaces, and ship complete product modules. * Design and evolve systems for AI agents across conversational interfaces, web applications, and integrations. * Make product capabilities accessible to LLM agents through agent\-oriented interfaces and tooling. * Move pricing and business logic into backend services to ensure financial accuracy. * Extend typed data models for pricing and related business concepts. * Set and improve practices for testing, observability, deployment, performance, and secure architecture. * Lead technical discussions, mentor teammates, and investigate production issues, especially those affecting financial calculations. * Improve development workflows that use AI assistance and automated code review. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 8 years of software engineering experience, including startup experience and staff\-level ownership of product areas. * Strong backend skills with production experience in Python, FastAPI, and MongoDB or comparable technologies. * Full\-stack ability, including React and TypeScript, with experience independently delivering polished interfaces. * Experience taking ambiguous customer needs from discovery to shipped product, including API and data model design. * Background in B2B SaaS pricing, packaging, quoting, billing, or monetization. * Experience integrating AI features or agent\-driven workflows; familiarity with agent tooling is a plus. * Care for financial correctness and experience handling production issues involving money\-related logic. * Must be authorized to work in the United States without visa sponsorship. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $200,000 to $250,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California. Compensation Range: $200K \- $250K

jobs.title: Founding Product Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join the founding engineering team at an early\-stage SaaS company building AI tools for industrial ingredient manufacturers. You will shape product decisions and own software from customer discovery through delivery, working across backend systems, AI agents, frontend, and infrastructure. ### **What You'll Do** * Talk directly with manufacturers to understand their workflows and translate customer needs into product features. * Build backend systems that ingest and process documents from customer ERPs and inboxes. * Develop AI agents that complete complex compliance and food safety documents. * Own products end to end, from problem definition and user interface through shipping and iteration. * Ship quickly and refine products using feedback from real users. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 4 years of professional engineering experience, with substantial hands\-on production coding. * Experience as a product manager who moved into engineering, or as a sole or first product engineer who owned products from discovery through launch and iteration. * A track record of shipping products or major features used by real customers, with strong product judgment and the ability to explain tradeoffs. * Full\-stack experience, including backend services, frontend development, and taking features through to the user interface. * Strong backend skills, including data ingestion and relational database design. Experience with Kotlin, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, and cloud infrastructure such as GCP is useful. * Production experience with LLMs, agents, or document processing is a plus, including tools such as Gemini or Anthropic models. * Direct customer discovery experience and interest in food manufacturing, supply chains, or other traditional industrial sectors are valued. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary is $180,000 to $250,000 annually, plus 0\.5% to 1\.5% equity. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** Full\-time, on\-site in San Francisco. Compensation Range: $180K \- $250K

jobs.title: Research Engineer, AI Evals
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join a consumer technology research team evaluating how AI models behave alongside real people. You will design and ship practical benchmarks that measure real\-world model behavior, helping distinguish meaningful results from evaluations that can be gamed. ### **What You'll Do** * Develop and publish benchmarks regularly, taking each from an initial idea through its results. * Design studies with clear tasks, no\-AI baselines, participant consent, and measurable real\-world actions. * Build evaluation harnesses that isolate model performance from prompt wording, and run leading models through them. * Create grading systems using ground truth, verifiers, and rubrics. * Document methods and write up findings for publication. ### **What We're Looking For** * 0 to 3 years of research or engineering experience, with an early PhD or research\-minded undergraduate background. * Experience building and shipping an evaluation, benchmark, or human study end to end. * Strong Python skills and experience using model APIs at scale. * Understanding of model cards, how evaluations can be gamed, and how to design technically serious tests. * Experience designing studies and building grading systems with ground truth, verifiers, and rubrics. * Relevant background may include human\-subject research in psychology, HCI, or social science; research on persuasion, sycophancy, or deception; speech or audio; or a published paper or open benchmark. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Salary range: $180,000 to $350,000 annually, plus equity. Visa sponsorship is available. ### **Location** On\-site in Palo Alto, California. Compensation Range: $180K \- $350K

jobs.title: Senior Android Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join a product\-focused fintech engineering team to build and scale a consumer Android app. You will collaborate across product, engineering, and business teams to improve the app and its platform. ### **What You'll Do** * Design, implement, and maintain the Android application. * Contribute to platform\-level Android development and architecture. * Solve technical and product problems pragmatically. * Contribute to product design and direction. * Collaborate and communicate effectively with other teams. * Support and mentor junior Android engineers. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 5 years of mobile app development experience, including 2 or more years building and shipping production Android apps and 3 or more years in a startup environment. * Strong Kotlin expertise and hands\-on experience with Jetpack Compose and MVVM or Clean Architecture. * Experience building consumer\-facing mobile applications. * Proficiency with protobufs, REST APIs, and gRPC. * Experience integrating Firebase Authentication, Firestore or Realtime Database, and Cloud Messaging. * Experience with Android unit, instrumentation, and UI testing, as well as mobile CI/CD pipelines. * Mentorship or technical leadership experience guiding junior engineers, and strong academic foundations. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $160,000 to $200,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California. Compensation Range: $160K \- $200K

jobs.title: Senior Backend/Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join a team building distributed messaging infrastructure that enables AI agents to work across popular communication platforms. You will own complex systems from architecture through production and help shape the APIs and internal tools that make the infrastructure reliable and easy to use. ### **What You'll Do** * Design and operate highly available backend services for large\-scale, real\-time messaging workloads. * Own projects end to end, from defining the problem and architecture to implementation, deployment, and ongoing operation. * Build intuitive APIs, SDKs, developer tools, dashboards, and internal platforms. * Address distributed systems challenges involving reliability, concurrency, fault tolerance, and message delivery. * Make pragmatic technical decisions and contribute to architecture discussions, code reviews, and incident analysis. * Use AI coding agents effectively while carefully reviewing generated code and its operational consequences. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 3 years of professional software engineering experience, including building and operating production backend systems. * Strong TypeScript and Node.js skills, plus experience with another backend language such as Go, Rust, or Swift. * Solid knowledge of distributed systems, concurrency, networking, databases, and API design. * Hands\-on experience with PostgreSQL, Redis or other NoSQL systems, AWS, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure. * Experience independently designing, deploying, and maintaining complex, high\-availability services, including observability, incident response, and performance optimization. * Fluency in Mandarin. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** $100,000 to $200,000 annual base salary, meaningful equity, and H\-1B sponsorship, OPT, and CPT support. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California. jobs.title: Staff Infrastructure Software Engineer
jobs.description: **At Carbon, our mission goes beyond 3D printing. We are enabling creators everywhere to make what the world needs, right now. Our company is built on the idea that diverse fields of study must come together to solve intractable problems. We have grand ambitions to create technology that will influence industry around the world. You will be joining a diverse team with a vibrant culture, where team success is as important as celebrating individual contributions.** **Help us change the world and we will help you change yours.** **Job Description:** Working at the intersection of hardware, software, and molecular science, Carbon delivers on the promise of 3D printing by helping commercial customers move beyond prototyping to produce real\-world parts. Every one of those parts starts with a print job that flows through our cloud, so the infrastructure that runs it has to be fast, safe, and boringly reliable. We are looking for a Staff Infrastructure / DevOps Engineer to join a small, high\-trust platform team that owns the foundations everything else at Carbon runs on: our AWS and GCP footprints, the networks that connect our cloud to printers in the field, the Terraform that describes all of it, and the CI/CD pipelines that ship software to production. You will be a core owner of that platform, drive substantial initiatives across it end to end, and raise the engineering bar for how we build and operate cloud infrastructure at Carbon. **You will:** ------------- * **Operate \& Extend Multi\-Cloud Infrastructure:** Be a core owner of our AWS and GCP environments that host our Tier\-0 services, keeping them resilient, cost\-efficient, and secure while extending them to support the next generation of Carbon products. * **Build the Network Between Cloud and Printer:** Design and maintain the networking that connects our cloud services to a global fleet of printers, including VPCs, peering, DNS, load balancing, TLS, and secure edge connectivity. You will make sure a printer in a customer's factory can reach the cloud reliably, no matter where it is. * **Run Services on Kubernetes with Istio:** Be a core owner of the Kubernetes clusters and Istio service mesh that our platform runs on. You will drive substantial improvements to cluster architecture, workload isolation, traffic management, mTLS, and observability, and help application teams run their services on the platform safely and confidently. * **Own Infrastructure as Code in Terraform:** Take end\-to\-end ownership of substantial Terraform initiatives, from module design through rollout. You will help shape our IaC standards, keep our state and module ecosystem healthy, and make it easy for other engineers to ship infrastructure safely. * **Ship Software Faster and Safer with CI/CD:** Lead major improvements to our Jenkins and GitHub Actions pipelines: faster builds, safer deploys, better feedback loops, and clear paths from a merged PR to production. You will help define what "good" looks like for delivery at Carbon. * **Own Reliability Alongside the Product Teams:** Participate in on\-call for the platform, drive incident response and postmortems on the initiatives you own, and turn recurring pain into permanent fixes. You will help other teams adopt strong operational practices for the services they own. * **Technical Leadership \& Mentorship:** Work as a senior technical contributor across infrastructure, security, and application teams. You will translate real product and operational needs into robust designs, raise the bar through design and code review, and mentor engineers around you. **You have:** ------------- * Seven or more years of experience building and operating production cloud infrastructure, with deep expertise in at least one of AWS or GCP and working proficiency in the other. * Strong networking fundamentals: VPCs, subnets, routing, DNS, load balancing, TLS, VPNs, and secure connectivity between cloud and on\-prem or edge devices. * Expert\-level Terraform. You have designed modules others depend on, managed state at scale, and led non\-trivial migrations without downtime. * Hands\-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins and GitHub Actions (or comparable systems), including build performance, artifact management, and safe deployment patterns. * Strong Kubernetes expertise. You have operated production clusters at scale, understand the control plane and networking model in depth, and have designed workload, upgrade, and multi\-tenant strategies that others rely on. * Hands\-on experience with a service mesh in production, ideally Istio. You are comfortable with envoy\-based traffic management, mTLS, authorization policy, and mesh observability, and you can debug problems that cross the mesh boundary. * Fluency in Linux and containers, and in at least one scripting or systems language (Python, Go, Bash, or similar). * A production mindset: you think about failure modes, blast radius, cost, and observability from the start, and you have carried a pager for infrastructure you built. * Strong communication, debugging, and problem\-solving skills, and a track record of driving major initiatives end to end across teams. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. * **Nice to have:** ----------------- * Experience connecting cloud services to physical devices or edge hardware in the field. * Familiarity with Bazel or another polyglot monorepo build system. * Experience with security and compliance controls (SOC 2, ISO 27001\) as they apply to cloud infrastructure. Experience running or contributing to a platform team that other engineers depend on as internal customers. * You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Carbon, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills. At Carbon, we look at the person holistically and carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining salary. The compensation bracket for this position is $209,600 \- $314,400 (per year). In order to maintain equitable internal pay practices, we aim to hire new employees near the midpoint of $262,000, taking into account your experience, work location, certifications, and the unique skills you bring to the role. If you are not based in our Sunnyvale or Santa Clara, CA office, the range above will be adjusted for the geographical differential associated with your actual work location. For more information on how we modify your pay based on your location, please refer to our geographic differentials chart . Carbon also offers to our eligible employees a comprehensive total rewards package that includes equity, benefits, and time off programs. For details on our total rewards package, visit https://www.carbon3d.com/about/life\-at\-carbon . \#LI\-Onsite. \#LI\-MRWC By clicking the “APPLY NOW” button and submitting your job application, you agree you have reviewed the complete Privacy Notice for Employees, Independent Contractors and Job Applicants , which explains the categories of personal information we collect about you, the purposes for which the categories of personal information shall be used and your rights with respect to our use of such personal Information.

Under general direction, the Senior Engineer participates in the conduct of complicated civil, structural, electrical, or mechanical engineering planning, design, construction, maintenance/operation, plan review, assessment, and regulatory activities; develops plans; inspects sites and assists in problem resolution; coordinates engineering related activities with other City departments and outside agencies; conducts engineering planning studies; conducts plan reviews; and prepares grant applications. **DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS** This advanced journey\-level class is populated with multiple incumbents. Assignments require the exercise of independent judgment and initiative in scheduling, assigning, and coordinating work with that of other units, referring only unusual or highly\-complex problems. jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **ABOUT CIVILGRID** CivilGrid is the trusted civil design platform powering affordable infrastructure renewal and growth. We give utilities, civil engineers, and municipalities a single, collaborative source of truth for what's underground so teams can plan, design, and build faster, smarter, and safer. Our platform consolidates utility records, geotechnical and environmental data, paving moratoriums, and jurisdictional requirements directly from 3,000\+ utilities, agencies, and municipalities with full chain\-of\-custody documentation. Teams at PG\&E, Mark Thomas, and dozens of leading engineering firms use CivilGrid to cut research time by up to 88%, reduce project costs, prevent dig\-ins, and accelerate delivery on the projects that keep communities running. We're a venture\-backed Series A startup tackling a $4\.7T US infrastructure market that has been underserved by software for decades. Founded by industry insiders, each with 10\+ years in utilities and civil engineering, we move fast, ship work that matters, and stay close to the customers and field teams we build for. **WHY THIS ROLE** As a small team, we all wear many hats and enjoy tackling new challenges. When it comes to tech, we're seeking experienced individuals who can efficiently identify problems and devise solutions. As a Full Stack Engineer, you will be a foundational team member with the opportunity to work on all aspects of the application and shape the technical future of CivilGrid. Joining at this stage, you will build core systems that will help us scale quickly, and benefit from tremendous upside as we grow. This role will report to one of our Engineering Managers. It is a hybrid role with expectations that you are working from our downtown Boston office at least 3 days per week if hired. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Design and build end\-to\-end features, covering everything from database models to user\-facing components using React * Tackle a variety of areas: web and mobile applications, mapping interfaces, data processing pipelines, algorithmic relevancy, and real\-time collaboration tools * Profile and tune performance across the entire stack to ensure efficient and responsive systems * Implement and maintain analytics, health monitoring, alerts, and logging to maintain operational visibility and system reliability **WHAT YOU'LL BRING** * 5 years of experience working with JavaScript or TypeScript, particularly with React and Node.js (or equivalent frameworks) * Start Up Ready: Autonomous, moves fast, takes initiative without being asked, eagerness to learn and take ownership of hard problems * Strong foundational knowledge of PostgreSQL is a plus * Familiarity with geospatial frameworks (PostGIS, GeoJSON, map rendering libraries, etc.) is a plus * Conduct code reviews, mentor junior engineers, and offer constructive feedback to help grow the team’s technical capabilities * Strong verbal and written communication, able to articulate ideas clearly and collaborate effectively * A degree in Computer Science **HOW WE WORK** We're a small, but rapidly growing team that ships. Expect direct feedback, real ownership from day one, and proximity to customers — huge utilities, public agencies, and engineering firms whose work depends on what we build. We default to in\-person collaboration where it matters and remote\-friendly flexibility otherwise. We hire people who care deeply about their craft and the communities our customers serve. **COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS** **The base salary range for this role is** *$132,039 \- $201,101* Base salary is only one part of your total compensation package at CivilGrid, which also includes meaningful early\-stage equity, comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity to shape a category\-defining company. The base salary range listed above may encompass various levels and/or geographic locations; final offers are determined based on the candidate's experience, skills, level, and work location. In addition to base and equity, we offer: * Company\-funded medical, dental, and vision insurance — including medical plans at no cost to the employee * FSA (health and dependent care) * Unlimited PTO and a culture that expects you to actually use it * 401(k) plan * A high\-trust team, real ownership, and the chance to do the most meaningful work of your career **EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY** CivilGrid is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Employment decisions at CivilGrid are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact us — we're happy to help. Compensation Range: $132,039 \- $201,101

jobs.title: Staff Full Stack Engineer - Lead
jobs.description: We're partnering with a well established asset management firm, headquartered in Toronto. They operate across private equity, venture capital, real estate and private credit. With $45b in AUM and growing, they're expanding their team. We're looking for a **Staff Full Stack Engineer** to join them on a permanent basis. Our client is building its own portfolio management system for private equity teams, replacing a third\-party PMS and supporting new funds from day one. You will be the technical lead on the build: the most senior engineer on the team, setting the architecture and writing code yourself. You will lead a small engineering team, partner day to day with a product manager, and work with fund controllers, data operations and compliance. Fund administrators remain the book of record, but this system drives cashflows, reconciliations, LP economics, performance and regulatory reporting. Correctness and auditability matter as much as speed. **What You Will Do** -------------------- * Own the PMS architecture across data, workflow and controls, and reporting. * Build the core workflows end to end: cashflow import, validation and four\-eyes approval; NAV reconciliation against GP statements and administrator records; fee, carry and performance calculations; compliance rules; LP and regulatory reporting. * Build platform controls as first\-class features: maker\-checker, period locking, version history, audit trails and entity\-level access. * Partner with the product manager, who owns the spec. Make sure it is complete, write the technical design, then build with AI coding tools. * Make every build auditable: versioned calculations, lineage to source, and logged approvals and overrides. * Lead the parallel run against the legacy system, resolve breaks, and gate each new fund's onboarding. * Integrate with fund administrators, data extraction tools, the LP portal and downstream systems. **What You Will Bring** ----------------------- * 10\+ years building production software, including 3\+ years at staff or tech\-lead level on systems where correctness is non\-negotiable. * Full\-stack depth: backend services, data modelling and SQL, APIs and workflow design, and a modern web front end. * Experience with financial or accounting\-adjacent systems: ledgers, reconciliations, calculations that must tie out, and approval workflows. * Cloud and data platform experience, ideally GCP. * Daily use of AI coding tools, and a clear view on how to specify, review and test AI\-generated code at team scale. * Clear communication with non\-engineers, especially product and finance teams. **Strong Plus** --------------- * Prior experience building or working on a PMS, investment accounting or fund administration platform, as a vendor or in\-house. This is the most valuable background for the role. * Private markets knowledge: capital calls and distributions, NAV, IRR, TVPI and DPI, fees and carry, side letters and LP restrictions. * Familiarity with platforms such as eFront, Domos, Allvue, Investran, Aladdin or SimCorp. * Regulatory reporting experience, such as Solvency II or AIFMD. Click **'Apply Now** ' to submit your application or send your resume directly to **richard.riddett@cpl.ie** \#LI\-RR1

jobs.title: AI Senior Manager - SFL Scientific
jobs.description: Our Deloitte Strategy \& Transactions team helps guide clients through their most critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team delivers integrated, end\-to\-end support and advisory services covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, mergers and acquisitions (M\&A), and sustainability. Work alongside clients every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and provide practical solutions at every stage of their journey\-before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions. SFL Scientific, a Deloitte Business, is a U.S. based, data science consulting firm specializing in building mission\-specific, artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to support and transform our partners and clients. Our scientists and engineers' partner with Deloitte to deliver custom AI capabilities. With our continued growth and our commercial sector\-focused clients' overwhelming demand for AI development in new areas, we are expanding our consulting and development team to deliver valuable AI solutions, tools, and services. As a Senior Manager, you will define and execute our strategy for AI, ML, and GenAI services\-from strategic alignment, roadmap definition, to full\-scale AI solution delivery. You will be responsible for helping to identify, advocate, and execute programs with a specific focus on novel approaches leveraging automation, NLP, computer vision, time series, GenAI, and other use cases and data\-centric AI approaches that differentiate and solve complex problem statements. Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026\. **Work You'll Do** The candidate will work with senior leaders within SFL Scientific, a Deloitte Business, to determine what services to provide, what capabilities to deliver, and how to best position and partner to meet client requirements from idea to pilot to program. The practice has a proven track record serving large, market\-leading organizations in the private and public sectors, successfully delivering high\-quality, novel and complex projects, offering deep domain, R\&D, and scientific capabilities. The individual is responsible for building the relationship between Deloitte and the client, helping architect novel AI solutions and capabilities to generate client impact, as well as planning and penetrating target technology areas and supporting AI integration and deployment. A key aspect of the role will be to drive the vision, design, and deployment of generative AI solutions across commercial functions, ensuring cutting\-edge use of LLMs and adjacent technologies. Key responsibilities: * Go\-to\-Market: Drive high\-impact opportunities as an AI leader and position Deloitte as a go\-to provider for novel AI solutions * Engage clients to accelerate their development and adoption of AI/GenAI services to create operational and research value * Identify client and partners relationships which would benefit our practice and lead technical and to\-go\-market activities to help business and technical development efforts * Team Leadership: Support the growth and development of our AI and data science practice, including data science team management and solution delivery * Strategy: Identify high\-value client problems in AI/ML/GenAI and develop strategy and technical solution roadmaps * Delivery: Manage an interdisciplinary team of data scientists, engineers, and solution architects to achieve technical delivery objectives and real\-world deployment * Talent: Establish objectives and initiatives for the team, recommend the team's structure and roles, and organize, delegate, oversee, and monitor work * Talent: Coach and mentor team members, provide feedback, and support teaming and education A successful candidate would possess these skills: * Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team * Effective written and verbal communication skills * Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product * Ability to build and sustain professional relationships * Ability to lead projects or workstreams * Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment * Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor * Ability to meet deadlines * Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others **The Team** SFL Scientific, a Deloitte Business, is a data science professional services practice focused on strategy, technology, and solving business challenges with Artificial Intelligence (AI). The team has a proven track record serving large, market\-leading organizations in the private and public sectors, successfully delivering high\-quality, novel and complex projects, and offering deep domain and scientific capabilities. We are advancing both predictive and generative AI technologies while maintaining a commitment to data\-driven decision making across all levels of a client's organization, building solutions that drive growth and create meaningful impact. Made up of experienced AI strategists, data scientists, and AI engineers, they serve as trusted advisors to executives, helping them understand and evaluate new and essential areas for AI investment and identify unique opportunities to transform their businesses. In our consultative approach, we are platform agnostic and committed to providing the best technical solutions for each organization's requirements. Some of our novel use cases include supporting cancer detection, drug discovery, optimizing population health and clinical trials, autonomous systems and edge AI, defect and optimization in manufacturing and semiconductors, and GenAI\-enabled search, chat, and knowledge capabilities in every sector **Qualifications** **Required:** * Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, or related STEM field * 10\+ years of experience in AI/ML technology and services, including deep exposure to developing new AI programs, tools, or services * 10\+ years programming background and expertise in machine learning, deep learning, NLP, GenAI/LLMs, \& AI program governance * 6\+ years of previous experience in managing technical teams and delivering complex AI/ML and analytics workloads, including deployment and environment strategy * 5\+ years of experience in solution delivery, including stakeholder relationship development, proposal management, and delivery of technical solutions in complex organizations * Demonstrated ability to advise on a variety of high impact problems/projects through in\-depth evaluation of complex business processes, system processes, and technical requirements * Strong executive presence with the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value for senior leadership and bridge technical and business conversations * Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve * Live within commuting distance to one of Deloitte's consulting offices * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available. **Preferred:** * 2\+ years of experience working in a client\-facing, consulting environment * 5\+ years of experience working in or providing enterprise (non\-public sector) client service across multiple industries The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; jobs.title: Innovation & Delivery Transformation Products+ Engineering Excellence Lead - Products & Platforms
jobs.description: **The Team** The Innovation \& Delivery Transformation (I\&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte's business through new AI\-native platforms and products. The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, IDT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future. This role sits within Products\+ at the portfolio level, driving product management excellence across the portfolio of products. Products\+ is Deloitte's enterprise software business, with revenue rivaling publicly traded software companies and customer relationships spanning more than a decade. We combine that scale and staying power with Deloitte's industry expertise to build the next generation of AI\-powered products. **Position Summary** Deloitte is looking for a leader to strengthen engineering excellence across product lines. You will help define and embed organization\-wide engineering standards, expand how we find and develop exceptional engineering talent, and turn successful practices into capabilities that benefit every team. This role helps empowered product teams build useful, secure, reliable software through clear expectations, shared learning, and stronger engineering judgment. You will partner closely with the CTO and product\-line engineering leaders to turn technical direction and the engineering bar into practical standards, guidance, and development opportunities. Common Platform and Developer Experience own shared tooling and infrastructure; product teams own their technical decisions and delivery within those standards. This role connects those groups, supports adoption, and helps standards evolve with evidence from engineering work. Recruiting for this role ends on 12/25/2026\. **Work you'll do** Raise engineering standards, develop talent, and help great practices spread across the organization. **Define and embed engineering standards** * Translate the CTO's engineering bar into clear organization\-wide standards for software design, code quality, testing, security, accessibility, reliability, and maintainability, in partnership with engineering leaders and relevant specialists. * Make standards practical through reference examples, design guidance, review criteria, and reusable patterns that teams can apply in different product contexts. * Strengthen how engineers frame technical problems, document design tradeoffs, review code, test software, and manage technical debt. * Establish shared expectations for AI\-enabled engineering, including verification, code review, security, data protections, and accountability for generated work. * Help engineering leaders assess adoption and address gaps through coaching and peer review, with clear decision rights for teams and specialists. * Keep standards current by incorporating lessons from product teams, changes in technology, and evidence about software quality and customer outcomes. **Expand how we recruit and develop great engineers** * Partner with engineering leaders and recruiting to define the technical capabilities, problem\-solving skills, and domain knowledge each product needs. * Identify promising talent across varied backgrounds, including engineers in consulting and client delivery, internal technology teams, open\-source communities, and adjacent technical disciplines who demonstrate the ability to build and maintain product software. * Create targeted job descriptions and sourcing strategies that welcome relevant experience beyond traditional software\-product organizations. * Develop practical assessments that reveal engineering judgment, coding and debugging ability, system design, learning ability, collaboration, and attention to quality. * Translate engineering career expectations into clear, observable examples of excellent work at different levels, and help leaders apply those expectations consistently in hiring, feedback, and development. * Build onboarding, mentorship, and practical learning opportunities that develop product\-engineering habits and familiarity with shared engineering standards. * Use hiring and development outcomes to continuously improve how we recruit, support, and grow engineers. **Spread effective practices across the organization** * Discover practices that are producing better software, technical decisions, and product outcomes across product lines, and turn them into useful examples, coaching, and peer learning. * Build engineering communities that share expertise, review approaches, and help teams apply lessons beyond their own codebases. * Identify effective AI\-enabled engineering practices, test their value with teams, and help successful approaches spread with appropriate verification and review. * Improve access to current technical guidance and shared knowledge so teams can learn from one another and avoid repeatedly solving the same problems. * Addre rm and Developer Experience to inform their priorities. * Measure whether standards and practices improve the work. Combine team feedback with evidence such as onboarding time, rework, defects, and maintainability; avoid treating activity counts as measures of individual performance. **The successful candidate will possess these skills:** * An ability to recognize engineering talent across varied backgrounds and develop people through coaching, mentorship, and structured learning. * Strong analytical, communication, and change\-management skills, including the ability to interpret engineering measures in context. * The ability to influence across teams, build alignment with engineering leaders, and translate organizational expectations into everyday engineering practice. **The successful candidate will achieve these outcomes:** * Engineering standards are clear, current, and consistently applied across product lines, with guidance that teams can use in their everyday work. * Software quality, security, accessibility, reliability, and maintainability improve as teams apply shared standards and learn from one another. * Engineers make stronger technical decisions and receive consistent expectations and useful feedback about their development. * Effective AI\-enabled practices spread across teams and deliver measurable improvements in productivity and work quality, supported by appropriate verification and review. * Recruiting reaches strong candidates from a wider range of relevant backgrounds, and assessments consistently reflect the engineering bar. * New engineers reach meaningful contribution sooner, and engineers at every level have practical opportunities to develop their skills and judgment. * Successful practices and technical knowledge spread across product lines, reducing repeated mistakes and duplicated effort. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's Degree from an accredited college or university * 5\+ years of experience in software engineering and engineering leadership, with a track record of improving engineering practices across multiple teams or product lines. * 5\+ years of experiences of using strong engineering judgment and a practical understanding of software design, testing, secure development, and maintainable production systems. * 3\+ years of experience defining engineering standards and helping autonomous teams apply them consistently without unnecessary process or approval layers. * 3\+ years of demonstrated a track record of turning effective practices into guidance, learning opportunities, and measurable improvements that engineers adopt. * 2\+ years working with AI\-enabled engineering tools and workflows, with sound judgment about where they improve work and where correctness, security, data access, or human review matter. * Ability to travel 20\-25% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $134,500\-$265,100\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.
