jobs.title: Lead SDET Engineer, Manager
jobs.description: **Lead SDET II Engineer \-AI \& Engineering** Join our AI \& Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re\-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation. AI \& Engineering leverages cutting\-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission\-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology \& data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements. Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models\-traditional teams, pools, or pods\-are tailored to each client's needs, offering engineering\-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation. **Work You'll Do** As a Lead SDET II, you will bring considerable technical expertise to deliver effective solutions to clients including the following: * Acting as the lead, interfacing between clients and our Deloitte teams. * Helping to create testing solutions to meet our clients business needs. * Leading the testing of custom technology solutions. * Managing client projects, including people, finances, risk, governance, delivery. **Required Qualifications and Experience** * 8\+ years' relevant consulting or industry experience. * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field. * 8\+ years hands\-on experience defining the testing strategy for large scale programs and ensuring requirements traceability throughout the system development lifecycle. Experience should include leading the testing efforts, including experience with all phases of testing: system integration, user acceptance, and performance testing. * Experience with at least two of the following: TOSCA, TMO, mobile testing, automation testing, SAP testing, data testing in a client\-facing or industry role. * 8\+ years' experience driving the quality assurance processes and gaining delivery and buy\-in from executive leadership. * 4\+ years' experience leading teams \- onshore, offshore and nearshore. * Experience with Test and Defect Management tools \- MicroFocus, ALM, JIRA. * 6\+ years' experience working in a testing role in different environments including the following: client server, service\-oriented architecture, web\-based, mainframe\-based and three\-tier architectures. * Experience with the following: MicroFocus UFT, Rational Tooling, and Open Source Automation Tools such as Selenium, Cucumber, OpSoapUI, PostMan, RESTAssured, Mockito. * Experience in at least one Scripting language \- Shell, VBScript, Perl or Python. * Experience with Source Control Systems \- SVN or GIT. * Experience with Build tools \- Maven, CircleCI. * Experience with Automated Reporting. * Experience with Cloud testing, API testing * Experience with CI/CD/CT tools \- Jenkins, Bamboo, Quickbuild. * Ability to travel up to 50% of the time, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available. Position to be unposted on 12/2/26\. **Preferred Qualifications and Experience** * Experience working with robotics solutions such as UIPath, AutomationAnywhere or BluePrism. * 6\+ years in the life and annuity insurance industry in a testing role. * Experience working in Cloud, Web and Mobile Testing platforms \- Saucelabs, Browerstack are preferred. * Hands\-on experience with machine learning models. * Experience in Python NLTK or similar natural language processing technology. * Experience implementing testing best practices specific to the test planning and execution processes and gaining buy\-in for changes from executives. * A deep understanding of testing planning and associated delivery challenges. * A strong understanding of the various approaches used in testing techniques \- white\-box, black\-box, load testing, coverage testing and regression testing. **Wages \+ Salary** * The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. Discord's mission is to cultivate belonging, and doing that at scale requires internal systems that move as fast as the product itself. The mission of this role is to turn our enterprise infrastructure into self\-service software. Your job is to replace manual consoles and tickets with a platform of reusable primitives, building blocks like "provision a device" or "push an IAM policy or app integration through code," exposed through clean APIs and self\-service portals. As a code\-forward Senior engineer, you will design abstractions that hide the messy reality of Okta, Jamf, and Terraform (our identity, device management, and infrastructure\-as\-code tools) behind interfaces people actually want to use, operating with a platform\-as\-a\-product mindset. **What You'll Do** * Manage the device fleet as code: Move device configuration off consoles and into versioned, API\-driven infrastructure for endpoint management and hardware provisioning. * Automate the identity layer: Manage identity systems and their connections to downstream apps as code, from SSO and SCIM integrations to account workflows, so changes ship through version control and CI/CD instead of an admin console. * Own app delivery and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC): Build deployment pipelines and provisioning patterns that let internal systems be built and changed safely, establishing CI/CD standards. * Build the self\-service layer: Design and ship the APIs, CLIs, and portals that compose primitives into paved paths, like a new hire's first day, where software access and group memberships land in one automated, auditable flow. * Own your domain end to end: Take core components of the platform from design through production with no code boundaries, writing the RFCs and documentation for the areas you own. **What You Should Have** * 3\+ years building and operating production software and systems at a technology company, with a track record of owning projects end to end. * Strong software engineering fundamentals. You write production code (we lean on Go, Python, and TypeScript), and design, test, and ship it. This is not a systems admin role. * Hands\-on IAM experience (SSO, SCIM, OAuth/OIDC, RBAC) and working fluency with infrastructure as code (Terraform) and CI/CD. * Experience treating endpoint or infrastructure configuration as an API\-driven engineering surface rather than console work. * A platform\-as\-a\-product mindset. You care whether people actually adopt what you build, not just whether it ships. * Comfort owning complex, multi\-milestone projects through ambiguity, and energy for building in a greenfield environment. **Bonus Points** * Hands\-on experience with Okta, Jamf, or Intune. * Experience with identity and access governance for non\-human, workload, or AI\-agent principals. * Background at a high\-growth consumer tech company with a highly technical employee base. **Why Discord?** Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. **Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!** **Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process.** We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know. ***Please see our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy for details regarding Discord's collection and usage of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking*** ***HERE.***

jobs.title: Principal Engineer AI/ML Platform
jobs.description: **About the Team** ------------------ AI/ML Platform at DoorDash is building the foundation for the most advanced AI driven logistics and commerce platform in the world. Our mission is to define the technical backbone that powers all machine learning and generative AI workloads across DoorDash, from marketplace ranking to next generation AI native product experiences. We own the end to end ML lifecycle and evolving GenAI platform capabilities, enabling teams across DoorDash to build and ship high impact experiences for consumers, merchants, and dashers at global scale. **About the Role** ------------------ As Principal Engineer, you will define the architectural north star for the full ML and GenAI stack and set the long term technical strategy across AI platform teams. You will translate company level AI ambitions into clear architectural direction and cohesive standards spanning distributed training, high performance inference, and generative AI systems. Beyond strategy, you will serve as a technical role model for the organization, setting a high bar for engineering rigor, clarity of thinking, and long term design quality. You will step in to unblock teams, clarify architectural direction, and provide decisive guidance during moments of ambiguity. Success means delivering a cohesive, scalable, and developer friendly AI platform that accelerates research to production velocity and enables AI capabilities across every product line. You must be located in San Francisco, Sunnyvale or Seattle for this hybrid position. You will report directly to the Director of Engineering, Machine Learning. **You're excited about this opportunity because you will…** ----------------------------------------------------------- * Set the long term AI architecture for DoorDash, connecting company level strategy to concrete platform roadmaps and technical execution. + Operate at every altitude, from executive level AI vision and cross org alignment to deep dives into distributed systems performance, training bottlenecks, and production debugging. + Lead the integration of GenAI capabilities including model gateway and routing, fine tuning frameworks, vector infrastructure, RAG pipelines, LLM evaluation systems, guardrails, and agent platform foundations into a unified ML platform. + Raise the engineering bar by mentoring senior engineers, driving architectural rigor, and ensuring reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency at global scale. **We're excited about you because…** ------------------------------------ * You have 12\+ years of experience building and scaling distributed systems and ML infrastructure, with deep expertise in large scale training systems, high throughput inference, and production LLM architectures. * You bring significant hands\-on experience with modern LLM systems, including fine tuning, LLM evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and cost efficient model serving at scale. * You have built or architected agentic systems in production, including multi step reasoning pipelines, tool use frameworks, memory systems, and agent platforms. * You can translate company level AI strategy into executable platform architecture, while also diving into code to debug complex distributed systems, model performance bottlenecks, and inference failures. * You have led multi team technical initiatives, influenced senior leadership, and consistently raised the technical standards of organizations operating at global scale. **About DoorDash** ------------------ At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** --------------------------------------------- We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Statement of Non\-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on "protected categories," we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non\-binary or gender non\-conforming, LGBTQIA\+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently\-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non\-discrimination. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation. **If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.** **Notice Regarding Use of AI and Automated Tools:** To streamline our hiring process, DoorDash utilizes an automated recruitment tool called Metaview. **How it works:** Metaview assists our recruiting team by evaluating job related qualifications and characteristics in connection with hiring. The tool is designed and used to support \- rather than replace \- human decision\-making; trained personnel make final decisions with meaningful human review and oversight, and DoorDash does not use Metaview or other AI\-enabled tool in a manner that has the effect of subjecting applicants or employees to discrimination based on any protected characteristic or proxy or for engaging in any protected activity under applicable law. **Data Retention, Privacy \& Bias Audit:** Data collected during this process is retained in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy https://help.doordash.com/en\-us/legal/article/ax\-privacy\-notice and applicable state laws. jobs.title: Principal AI Research Engineer
jobs.description: Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It's a big mission, and that's where you come in! At Duolingo, you'll join a team that cares about finding innovative solutions to complex technical problems, running countless experiments (300\+ at a time!) with our massive user base to make data\-driven decisions, and educating our users and employees alike. You'll have limitless learning opportunities, mentorship and collaboration with world\-class minds, and a variety of projects with large scopes — while doing work that's both fun and meaningful. Join our life\-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world. **About the role** ------------------ We are looking for an industry expert AI Research Engineer to join our team to lead Duolingo's company\-wide modeling efforts, training custom models to improve the learning experience, including tutoring, speech recognition, and personalization. The ideal candidate will have an extensive track record as an AI research engineer, with extensive experience across various machine learning techniques, including NLP, deep learning, SFT, RL approaches (RLVR, PPO, GRPO, etc.), DPO, ASR, and more. They will have experience at all levels of the ML stack, including feature engineering, curating training data, model training, benchmarks and evaluations, deployment, and monitoring. #### **You will...** * Help lead a full\-stack team of frontend, backend, and other AI Research engineers, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment. * Define the technical strategy and engineering foundations for Duolingo's ML efforts across infrastructure, training, serving, and product use cases. * Contribute to the development and training of a variety of large\-scale machine learning models. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand their needs, to align the models' outputs with company objectives. * Partner with senior leadership to drive strategic product and business decision making as a member of the engineering and AI leadership group. * Stay up\-to\-date with the latest developments in machine learning, and apply this knowledge to drive advancements in our projects. * Mentor team members, providing guidance and support in their professional development. * Ensure the delivery of high\-quality, scalable, and efficient machine learning solutions #### **You have...** * Proven experience as an AI research engineer, for example, in LLMs, NLP, speech, or related fields. * Strong background in training and deploying large models in an applied setting. * Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field with a focus on machine learning or artificial intelligence, or equivalent experience. * Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to manage and inspire a team. * Deep understanding of machine learning concepts, frameworks, and best practices. **Benefits:** Take a peek at how we care for our employees' holistic well\-being with our benefits here. **Job Alerts:** Sign up for job alerts here. **Accommodations:** We will do everything we can within reason to make sure that your interview takes place in an environment that fairly and accurately assesses your skills. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact accommodations@duolingo.com. **Equal Employment Opportunity:** Duolingo is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. **Fraud Warning:** Unfortunately, there is a rise in scammers pretending to be real Duolingo employees. Duolingo and our employees will never ask for your Social Security number, bank details, or passport info, and we'll never ask you to deposit a check, purchase equipment, or exchange money during the interview process. Real Duolingo employees always use an email that ends in @duolingo.com or @recruiting.duolingo.com. Stay alert and double\-check these details before sharing any information. By applying for this position your data will be processed as per the Duolingo Applicant Privacy Notice.

The ideal candidate will take ownership of firmware design, development, and optimization for high\-performance embedded systems. maintain existing firmware systems while ensuring architecture integrity and a seamless user experience. * Evaluate current applications to identify areas for improvement, optimization, and scalability. * Refactor and optimize code for resource efficiency without compromising functionality. * Lead the selection and adoption of tools, technologies, coding standards, and best practices to Debugging** : Proficient with IDEs, debug emulators, and version control systems (e.g., SVN, Git).

jobs.title: AI Engineer – Generative AI and Agentic Systems
jobs.description: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing! *We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.* ERPA is seeking a hands\-on AI Engineer who can take inputs on business problems, translate them into practical AI use cases, design, deliver, and operate secure, production\-grade AI solutions. This role combines discovery, solution architecture, and engineering execution. You will partner with ERPA AI Team and stakeholders to develop AI powered solutions. **Responsibilities** * Engage stakeholders to gather business and technical outcomes needed and translate business use cases into solution designs, prototypes, delivery roadmaps, and production applications; lead demonstrations, workshops, technical discussions, and stakeholder feedback sessions. * Build AI solutions for enterprise use cases such as knowledge discovery, service\-desk ticket triage and resolution assistance, document processing, workflow automation, conversational analytics, enterprise search, data conversion and test automation. * Design and implement production RAG and agentic applications using LangGraph/LangChain or equivalent frameworks, MCP, tool calling, structured outputs, workflow orchestration, and human\-in\-the\-loop approvals where needed. * Connect AI applications safely to enterprise platforms such as PeopleSoft, Workday, Jira, Salesforce, and Microsoft 365 through APIs, MCP servers, and governed data\-access patterns. * Build cloud\-native applications primarily on AWS, including Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock Guardrails, AgentCore where applicable, OpenSearch, Lambda, S3, SQS, DynamoDB, Aurora PostgreSQL, and ECS/EKS. * Implement sound retrieval and data engineering practices: document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, keyword/vector hybrid search, metadata filtering, citations, SQL access controls, and incremental, idempotent pipelines. * Create evaluations using representative business scenarios, golden datasets, human review, LLM\-as\-judge where appropriate, regression testing, hallucination checks, and verification of agent tool behavior. * Engineer for production reliability and cost: observability, tracing, latency, model and token budgets, failure handling, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and incident response. * Protect customer information through least\-privilege access, tenant isolation, encryption, secrets management, PII safeguards, audit trails, and applicable privacy or regulatory controls. Partner with users through pilot rollout, training, feedback, adoption measurement, and iteration; report realized outcomes such as hours saved, cycle\-time reduction, cost avoidance, higher resolution accuracy, and improved user experience. * **Experience Required** * 2\+ years of industry experience engineering and deploying AI/ML or generative AI solutions used in production, including RAG, conversational agents, or agentic workflows. * Experience collaborating directly with business stakeholders or clients to gather requirements, shape solutions, communicate trade\-offs, and deliver measurable outcomes. * Demonstrated ability to move from an ambiguous business problem to a working prototype and a maintainable production solution. * Required skills * Strong Python development (e.g., FastAPI, Pydantic, pytest), SQL, APIs, data modeling, and software engineering fundamentals. * Hands\-on knowledge of LLM application patterns, RAG, prompt design, embeddings, vector/keyword search, agent orchestration, MCP/tool integration, and guardrails. * Experience with AWS or Azure OpenAI in production; willingness to work in an AWS\-first environment, preferably with Amazon Bedrock. * Ability to evaluate AI quality, security, latency, and cost through structured test datasets and production monitoring tools such as Langfuse or equivalents. * Experience with Docker, serverless or container deployment, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code (Terraform or AWS CDK). Strong analytical and consultative problem\-solving skills; able to translate between business needs and technical design and present effectively to senior client stakeholders. * **Preferred Experience** * Experience with ERP, IT service management, enterprise process improvement, or product development * Hands\-on experience with conversational BI, governed text\-to\-SQL, Playwright\-based testing, workflow automation, or data pipelines (Airflow/event\-driven). * Knowledge of model optimization or adaptation (LoRA, PEFT, QLoRA, quantization), classic ML, forecasting, or statistical methods. * Experience in higher education, government, healthcare, or other regulated environments; familiarity with FERPA and enterprise privacy requirements. * Open\-source contributions, AI experimentation, or experience building reusable AI solution accelerators. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities of this job. Applicants are considered for all positions in accordance with statutes and regulations concerning non\-discrimination on the basis of race, ancestry, age, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, non\-disqualifying disability, veteran status, or other protected classification. ERPA is an equal opportunity employer, as well as a substance and tobacco free workplace. All offers of employment are contingent on successfully passing the pre\-employment drug screen and background investigation which may include reference checks, criminal background investigation, and when applicable licensing verification. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. We will not consider any applicants that require sponsorship for employment visa status either now or in the future. *If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!* Notice: We use E\-Verify to confirm the identity and employment eligibility of all new hires.

jobs.description: Econolite® is an innovator of Intelligent Transportation System (ITS) solutions, products, and services. Our technology is helping save lives and making the Smart City a reality. If you want to be at the forefront of this intelligent technology revolution, we want to talk to you about being part of our team. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- **ABOUT DBI** For over 20 years, DBI has been a leader in the evaluation of damaged structures, consistently redefining the standards of excellence in our industry. We deliver independent analysis to clients in the insurance and legal industries. Hard evidence, expertise and accuracy drive our work. In a complex and ever\-evolving industry, our mission is to bring clarity to every client we serve. DBI is part of the Cor Partners family of companies, serving the insurance, risk management and legal communities. Headquartered in Midtown New York City, we have more than 30 locations across the United States, including Atlanta and Dallas, and both our footprint and our team are growing. We believe the best ideas come from looking at familiar problems in new ways. That forward\-thinking, innovative and people\-focused mindset is what sets us apart, and technology is central to how we grow. **SUMMARY OF JOB PURPOSE**: DBI is building new enterprise applications on two fronts: platforms for our clients, and the systems our own teams use every day. Both share one goal: to make complex work simple, clear and elegant for the people who use it. Our work runs on dense documents, site data, cost estimates and expert judgment, often thousands of pages for a single claim. It arrives as spreadsheets, CSVs, PDFs, reports and feeds from other systems, some well structured and some barely structured at all. Turning that into fast, clear and correct answers for clients and consultants is a data problem first, with AI and design challenges close behind. The Senior Software Engineer plays a central role in building these platforms end to end, from the data that feeds them through the services, APIs and screens clients use. The role is hands\-on: designing, building, shipping and supporting production software, and helping set the engineering standards the team builds on. The Senior Software Engineer is involved early, applies critical thinking from raw data through to what the client sees, and helps shape solutions rather than building to a fixed spec. The first major project is a new client\-facing enterprise application that DBI is building in house, which the Senior Software Engineer will help take from the first line of code through delivery, with a strong pipeline of projects to follow. The Senior Software Engineer reports directly to the Partner and Creative Director and is expected to travel 10–20% of the time for project work, training and company needs. **THE TECHNOLOGY TEAM** The Senior Software Engineer joins a small, close\-knit team that works collaboratively, with a strong culture and a high standard for quality, and works alongside: * The Partner and Creative Director, who leads the team and is hands\-on in project work. * The IT Director, who leads DBI's environments, infrastructure, and security, and brings deep engineering experience to the team. * The Senior Director of Data Science \& AI, who sets AI and engineering direction and is closely involved in the engineering itself, from approach and code to releases and data migration. * The Product Manager, who shapes the product, roadmap and priorities, and works with engineering at every stage, from requirements and data modeling through architecture and testing. * The IT team, who support DBI's systems, users and day\-to\-day operations. **PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**: * Design, build, ship and support production web applications end to end, including data models, backend services, APIs and the frontend screens clients use. * Build the ingestion and transformation layer that brings data from spreadsheets, CSVs, PDFs and other systems into a consistent data model shared across DBI's applications, working with the Senior Director of Data Science \& AI and the Product Manager. * Help maintain and evolve the schemas, contracts and APIs other applications depend on, changing them as the business and source data change. * Build validation, audit trails, versioning and lineage into the data flow, so any figure on screen can be traced back to the file it came from. * Build the checks, reconciliation, and monitoring that keep our data accurate and catch bad data before a client does. * Build frontend features from designer mockups, including import and validation screens, dashboards, reporting and document generation. * Work with the Senior Director of Data Science \& AI on AI\-assisted features, such as extracting and classifying data from documents, with human review where accuracy matters. * Implement secure authentication and role\-based access for staff and clients using Microsoft Entra ID. * Partner with the IT Director on environments, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, releases and security. Support deployments, monitor production, and resolve defects, data issues and performance problems. * Write and maintain automated tests, including data quality, API and UI tests. * Help define DBI's engineering standards for s ns such as MCP, and evaluating and monitoring model output. * Document processing at scale: OCR, PDF parsing, table extraction and the realities of scanned and inconsistent source files. * ETL or ELT pipelines across semi\-structured and unstructured sources. * Data governance in practice, including lineage, audit trails, versioning and data quality. * Node.js and TypeScript services, including GraphQL APIs. * Deployment with Docker and Azure services such as Blob Storage and Azure Database for PostgreSQL. * Application monitoring with Azure Application Insights or similar tools. * Experience integrating enterprise applications such as Workday and NetSuite, including APIs, identity, master data and transactional workflows. * Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth, or similar identity and access management for web applications. * Infrastructure as code, preferably Bicep. * Automated testing frameworks, preferably Playwright, and a working knowledge of computer\-use agents. * Advanced frontend work, including design systems, component libraries or data visualization. * Working with external development teams. * Experience in insurance, claims, forensics, engineering, legal, construction, regulated financial services or another field where accuracy and the ability to show your evidence matter. **SKILLS AND ABILITIES** * A drive to make complex things simple, with care for how people experience the software. * Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences, including clients. * Strong attention to quality and detail, and pride in delivering polished work. * Ability to work independently and as part of a small, collaborative team. * Strong time management and organizational skills; able to balance multiple projects and deadlines. * A security\-first approach, following secure development practices and treating sensitive client data with care and discretion. **WHAT WE OFFER** * Meaningful work: build the platforms DBI's clients and consultants rely on, with real data and real impact. * Room to grow: we are a growing Technology team and company * Modern tools and learning: current AI coding tools, cloud environments, and support for ongoing learning. * Stability with momentum: the backing of an established firm and the Cor Partners family, with the energy and close\-knit culture of a team building something new. **WORKING CONDITIONS**: This is a hybrid role, with work performed in a DBI office two days a week and remotely the rest of the week. This role may require flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, or holidays, to support releases, production issues, or project deadlines. The position also requires 10–20% travel to support projects, training, satellite office locations, and company operations. In addition, this role may involve visits to client sites, new office buildouts, and renovations, which can include active construction zones. While safety protocols will be followed, the employee may occasionally be exposed to noise, dust, or other environmental conditions typical of a construction site. **PHYSICAL ACTIVITIES AND REQUIREMENTS**: The work requires frequent use of a computer, keyboard, and other office equipment, requiring close visual acuity to view a computer screen, read printed documents, and review code. The employee must be able to sit or stand for extended periods of time, walk between office locations, and participate in meetings or project discussions. This role may also require handling and transporting equipment such as laptops, monitors, and other technology hardware. The employee should be able to lift, carry, push, or pull items weighing up to 40 pounds. Occasional bending, stooping, crouching, or reaching may be required. The employee may be required to work in active construction zones, which could involve exposure to noise, dust, or limited ventilation. Physical agility and awareness are required to safely move through these environments.

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About us:** The physical and digital worlds are merging. Vehicles, medical devices, industrial systems, critical infrastructure: security hasn't kept pace. AI is accelerating everything, from the capabilities of the systems we depend on to the sophistication of the threats targeting them. A software vulnerability can now have physical consequences. A physical breach can compromise entire digital ecosystems. Billions of devices operate with little to no protection, and traditional approaches can't keep up. Not at this scale, not at this speed, and not across this diversity of systems. Exein exists to solve this. We build the security layer for a world where physical and digital threats are no longer separate problems, from kernel\-level runtime protection on embedded devices to cloud\-native platforms that analyze, protect, and prove compliance across entire device fleets. We're not patching the old model. We're building security from the core out. **Job Overview** We are seeking a dedicated and technically proficient **Senior Forward Deployed Enginee**r to join our team in the Americas. This role involves presenting and demoing our software products to customers and partners, guiding them from initial discussions through to post\-deployment support. The ideal candidate will act as the chief technologist and trusted advisor, orchestrating Exein's overall technical approach for and with the customer across all phases of the customer lifecycle. **Responsibilities** * Act as the chief technologist for customer accounts and a trusted advisor to their technical teams. * Lead technical discussions, explaining how Exein's portfolio and architected solutions address customer requirements. * Engage with new and existing customers to understand their requirements and deployment environments. * Deliver our software products, ensuring they meet customer needs and specifications. * Provide post\-deployment support, troubleshooting, and resolving any issues that arise. * Collaborate closely with the Sales Account Manager and the R\&D team to ensure seamless communication and integration. * Document and plan for new features based on customer feedback and requirements. * Identify and mitigate any technical sales issues, influencing the overall account plan. **Requirements** * Strong experience with **Linux/Yocto, ESP32, Zephyr,** and other **embedded build systems**. * Prior experience in a **customer\-facing technical role**. * Ability to understand customer requirements and the environments where devices are deployed. * English Fluent, with excellent communication skills to effectively act as a liaison between customers and the R\&D team. * Experience in developing custom integration software for embedded systems. \- Familiarity with the entire lifecycle of an embedded product, from early\-stage discussions through to post\- deployment support. * Ability to translate technical knowledge into proposals, presentations, standard demos, and customer workshops. *Preferred Qualifications* * Experience in a cybersecurity company. * Experience with low\-level programming and integration of security technologies. * Knowledge of additional embedded systems and build environments. **Why Join Exein?** * Be part of a mission\-driven team dedicated to making **Physical AI** devices secure globally. * Work with cutting\-edge technology in the fields of data, machine learning, and open source. * Enjoy a dynamic and inclusive work environment that values innovation and quality. **Location**: Remote position (USA) *Exein is committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We evaluate all applications fairly regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, background, or orientation.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Software Engineer** **Location: Hoboken, NJ (on site)** **About Faropoint** Faropoint is a real estate investment firm that buys and operates industrial properties (smaller warehouses close to where people live and work) across 20\+ U.S. markets. We run the firm on software we build ourselves: our in\-house technology team builds the production apps our investment teams use to source, underwrite, and manage billions of dollars in real estate deals. **What We Build** * FarOS, our deal platform and system of record, where every acquisition is sourced, underwritten, and tracked. * REXy, our machine learning models that predict market rents, lease renewals, and sale prices. * AI agents that read broker emails and offering memos and turn them into deals in FarOS, help prepare lease negotiations, and take routine work off people’s plates. * The Faropoint Brain, our knowledge layer: an MCP server that gives Claude and our agents secure access to our leases, investment memos, data lake, and models. * Slack apps and dozens of internal tools that bring all of this to where people already work. **The Role** We’re a small team that ships fast. With AI coding agents, ideas go from a conversation with a user to production in days or weeks, not quarters. Writing code is no longer the hard part. The hard part is making sure what we ship is correct, tested, maintainable, and actually used. You’ll work day to day alongside a senior software engineer and a data engineer across FarOS, our data platform, and our AI tools. You’ll start with the work that makes those platforms solid: migrations, testing, bug fixes, and tech debt. As you learn the systems, you’ll build new features, agents, and integrations, and own more of the platform. We’re looking for an engineer, not a relay between us and an AI tool. You use coding agents every day, and you understand, check, and can explain everything they produce. **What You’ll Do** Ship and harden FarOS and our core platforms \- Build, test, and maintain production software that powers Faropoint’s data and investment platforms (TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL on AWS). \- Strengthen the reliability and quality of existing systems through rigorous testing, debugging, and continuous improvement: migrations, bug fixes, and tech debt. \- Take on scoped technical projects: dig into the problem, propose an approach and its trade\-offs, then carry it out. \- Help improve test automation, CI/CD, and developer tools such as automated AI code review. Build AI agents and integrations \- Extend our agents, MCP tools, and Slack apps so people can act without leaving the tools they use. \- Wire our machine learning models and data platform into the products that rely on them. Build with AI coding agents, and own the result \- Make effective use of AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code every day, while taking full ownership of the correctness of everything you ship. \- Review what agents produce for correctness, security, and fit with our existing patterns before it merges. \- Write the tests, plans, and docs that let the next engineer, or agent, pick up where you left off. Work with the people who use what you build \- Partner closely with engineering, data science, and business stakeholders to turn loosely defined problems into working solutions. \- Talk with users across the firm to understand their workflows, ship something small, and improve it based on feedback. \- Pick up the business context as you go. No real estate background needed. **What You’ll Bring** **Must\-haves:** 1 to 3 years of experience building and shipping production software. \- A degree in computer science, mathematics, physics, engineering, or a related discipline. \- Strong programming skills and solid computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and how a software project is organized. \- Working proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python, and comfort with SQL and relational databases. \- Comfort collaborating in Git: branches, pull requests, code review, and resolving merge conflicts. \- Daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar), and the judgment to verify their output. \- The ability to explain code you didn’t write, including an agent’s, and talk through design trade\-offs. \- A demonstrated ability to learn quickly and carry projects through from start to finish. You test your own work and ask for help when you’re stuck. \- A curious, self\-driven mindset, and the communication skills to explain technical work to non\-technical stakeholders. **Nice to have:** Experience building and testing a full\-stack web app (React, Node.js, PostgreSQL; Jest, pytest, or Playwright). \- Experience with database migrations or schema changes on a live system. \- Exposure to AWS (Lambda, containers, S3\) or CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions. \- Experience building with LLMs, agents, MCP servers, or Slack apps. \- Familiarity with financial models, spreadsheets, or an interest in finance, real estate, or investing. **Why Join?** * Real impact. Your code is used every day to find, price, and manage real buildings. * Speed. A small team and a short path to production. You’ll see your work in users’ hands quickly. * Room to grow. Start with well\-scoped work, then take on progressively greater technical ownership as you learn our systems. * Autonomy. You’ll choose how to solve problems, not just close tickets. **What We Offer** This position offers a base salary in the $120,000\-$160,000 range, plus discretionary bonus, competitive healthcare benefits, unlimited PTO, and a 401k match. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Faropoint is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by local law. We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce. **AI Notice to Candidates**. Faropoint Ventures LLC and its subsidiaries (the “Company”) and their recruiting vendors may use artificial intelligence and other automated tools (“AI Tools”) to parse, screen, rank, assess, and summarize resumes/CVs, applications, and interviews. No hiring or rejection decision will be made solely by automated means without meaningful human review by Company personnel, and any use of AI Tools will comply with applicable law, including anti\-discrimination laws and laws governing automated employment decision tools and algorithmic decision\-making. Personal information you submit will be kept confidential in accordance with our Privacy Policy and used for recruiting, hiring, and related legal, compliance, and recordkeeping purposes, including to evaluate you for employment opportunities with the Company and its affiliates.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer (Python)
jobs.description: FlexTrade Systems is a provider of customized multi\-asset execution and order management trading solutions for buy\- and sell\-side financial institutions. Through deep client partnerships with some of the world's largest, most complex and demanding capital markets firms, we develop flexible tools, technology and innovation that deliver our clients a competitive edge. Our globally distributed engineering teams focus on adaptable technology and open architecture to develop highly sophisticated trading solutions that can automate and scale with your business strategies. At FlexTrade, we hold our values close to heart, with pride and gratitude, as they guide us in everything that we do. We are dedicated to giving our clients a competitive edge, taking ownership of our responsibilities, being flexible to adapt to ever changing environment and technology, bringing integrity to every interaction and we continue to improve, grow together and collaborate as one team. All of these while having fun truly makes FlexTrade a wonderful place to work*.* **Overview** This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing Analytics and TCA group at FlexTrade at a genuine inflection point, as we expand our real\-time analytics footprint and bring machine learning and AI capabilities directly into the trading workflow. You will help shape what the next generation of FlexTCA looks like, with real ownership and visible impact across our global client base. FlexTrade is seeking an experienced Senior Python Developer to join the FlexTCA Analytics group to lead the architecture, development, and evolution of our real\-time analytics, machine learning, and AI platforms. The role sits at the intersection of quantitative research, large\-scale data engineering, API design, and real\-time trading analytics. The successful candidate will turn research concepts into production capabilities, build scalable services for model delivery, and lead the integration of next\-generation AI capabilities into the FlexTCA product suite. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys designing robust systems, mentoring others, solving difficult architectural challenges, and owning strategic initiatives from concept through production deployment. **Key Responsibilities** **Analytics Platform Architecture** * Design, build, and maintain the real\-time analytics infrastructure underpinning FlexTCA. * Own the architecture of low\-latency services responsible for market data enrichment, benchmark generation, pre\-trade analytics, and transaction cost analysis. * Drive modernization and refactoring of existing analytics services to improve scalability, resilience, observability, and maintainability. * Establish engineering standards, code quality practices, and architectural direction across analytics platforms. **Machine Learning Platform \& Research Productionization** * Partner closely with quantitative researchers and analytics teams to productionize machine learning models. * Design scalable frameworks for publishing predictive analytics and model outputs in real time. * Build systems that expose model results through APIs and event\-driven interfaces. * Improve deployment, monitoring, versioning, validation, and lifecycle management of production ML models. * Support ongoing research into execution cost models, participation rate forecasting, completion modeling, and related predictive analytics. **AI \& Next Generation Analytics** * Lead development of AI\-enabled analytics capabilities. * Build client\-facing interfaces leveraging LLMs and agent\-based workflows. * Enable natural language access to TCA, pre\-trade, and execution analytics. * Design infrastructure supporting scenario analysis, hypothetical orders, and what\-if simulations for pre\-trade decision support. * Collaborate with product and business stakeholders to transform AI concepts into production solutions. **API \& Integration Leadership** * Design and implement secure, high\-performance APIs for analytics consumption. * Create services enabling seamless integration between FlexTCA, FlexTrader, OEMS, EMS, and external client systems. * Define standards for API design, authentication, authorization, versioning, monitoring, and reliability. * Work closely with platform teams responsible for publishing analytics into trading workflows and front\-office applications. **Data \& Infrastructure Ownership** * Manage data pipelines supporting market data, execution analytics, benchmarking, and machine learning workflows. * Troubleshoot and optimize databases, containers, deployment pipelines, and production environments. * Own system performance, capacity planning, monitoring, and reliability. * Support event\-driven architectures utilizing messaging and streaming technologies. * Ensure security, governance, and operational excellence across all services, including protection of data at rest and in transit. **Technical Leadership** * Serve as a senior technical resource and trusted advisor across the organization. * Mentor junior engineers and promote engineering best practices. * Drive architectural reviews and long\-term platform strategy. * Produce high\-quality technical documentation and operational runbooks. * Collaborate across research, engineering, product, support, and infrastructure teams. **Required Qualifications** * 5–10 years of professional software engineering experience. * Expert\-level Python development experience in large\-scale production environments. * **Deep expertise with core Python tooling:** Python, NumPy, Pandas, Cython, async Python programming, REST, and gRPC services. * Strong background designing and deploying distributed systems. * Experience building and operating production APIs consumed by internal and external clients. * **Extensive systems and automation background:** Linux/Unix administration, shell scripting, and automation tooling. * Experience with SQL and large\-scale data processing systems. * Experience with containerized deployment environments. * Strong software architecture and system design skills, with sound fundamentals in data consistency and correctness. * Proven ability to troubleshoot performance, scalability, and reliability issues in production environments. * Experience with Git and disciplined refactoring of established codebases. * Excellent communication and technical documentation skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience within electronic trading, algorithmic trading, market structure, or financial technology. * Knowledge of transaction cost analysis (TCA), execution analytics, or pre\-trade cost modeling. * Experience deploying machine learning models into production, including modern ML platforms and MLOps practices. * **Messaging and publication frameworks:** RabbitMQ, ZeroMQ, and Kafka. * Experience with cloud\-native architecture and observability platforms. * **Proficiency in one or more systems languages:** Rust, C\+\+, or Go. * **Asset class experience a plus:** equities, futures, and fixed income. * **AI and LLM technologies:** large language models, AI agents, retrieval systems, and production AI services. * **Strong familiarity with core security principles:** SAST / DAST and encryption protocols for data in transit and at rest. * Graduation from a top CS / research university a plus. Does this sound like you? We would love to hear from you. Please use the link on this page to apply, and we will get back to you as soon as we are able. jobs.title: Senior / Lead Consultant, Manhattan WMOS (Techno-Functional Production Support)
jobs.description: **Description:** **Job Title:** Senior / Lead Consultant, Manhattan WMOS (Techno\-Functional Production Support) **Job Location:** Atlanta, GA, United States (Onsite/Hybrid) **Job Type:** Full\-time, Permanent **Hiring Timeline:** Immediate. **Reporting Line:** Co\-Founder, COO \& SVP Enterprise Systems. **Travel Expectations:** Up to 50% travel, based on customer requirements. **Existing Vacancy:** Yes **Application Deadline:** Open until filled **About Fulfillment IQ (FIQ):** Fulfillment IQ is a supply chain engineering and transformation company that helps brands, retailers, and 3PLs design, build, and scale high\-performance logistics operations. We work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology, solving complex, real\-world problems across warehouse design, automation, order management, transportation, and end\-to\-end supply chain execution. Our teams combine deep domain expertise with strong technical capability, delivering outcomes through consulting, systems implementation, and proprietary platforms that accelerate time\-to\-value and reduce delivery risk. If you enjoy working in complex environments, partnering closely with clients, and seeing your work make a tangible impact on how global commerce moves, this is the place where your skills and judgment truly come to life. **Role Overview:** Fulfillment IQ is expanding its Manhattan practice within our Enterprise Systems Implementation team. We are hiring Senior/Lead Manhattan WMOS Techno\-Functional Consultants to support live, high\-volume warehouse operations, including healthcare and life sciences distribution centers. This is a hands\-on production support role. When a wave aborts, tasks get stuck, labels fail to print, or an automation interface stops responding, you are the person who finds the root cause and gets the warehouse running again. You will work directly in the database, read server and application logs, analyze transactional data, and fix configuration, then confirm operations are back to normal. We are looking for battle\-tested WMOS professionals: people who have personally owned critical production incidents in a live Manhattan WMOS environment, from diagnosis through recovery. Implementation experience is valuable, but it must be paired with real post\-go\-live support. **Product note:** This role requires Manhattan WMOS (Warehouse Management for Open Systems), ideally version 2018 or later. Experience limited to Manhattan Active WM (MAWM) or Manhattan WMi (IBM i / AS/400\) does not meet the core requirement on its own. **Mandate:** * Keep live Manhattan WMOS warehouses running by owning L2/L3 techno\-functional production support. * Diagnose and resolve critical production issues quickly, with minimal disruption to receiving, picking, packing, and shipping. * Perform in\-depth data analysis on system and data abnormalities that cause operational issues. * Drive every incident through root cause, fix, verification, and prevention. * Support healthcare and life sciences operations with lot, expiry, and regulatory control requirements, including DSCSA. * Act as a trusted WMOS advisor to client warehouse operations and IT teams. * (Lead level) Guide other consultants, set triage standards, and own escalations end to end. **Key Responsibilities:** **Production support and incident resolution** * Triage, troubleshoot, and resolve WMOS production incidents such as wave aborts, stuck or failed tasks, allocation failures, order release issues, inventory discrepancies, label printing failures, and shipping failures. * Read and interpret server, application, and batch job logs to isolate failures. * Write SQL queries against WMOS transactional tables to trace orders, tasks, inventory, and allocations, and to correct data where appropriate. * Restore order flow and verify the warehouse has resumed normal operations after each fix. * Document root cause, resolution steps, and preventive actions for every critical incident. * Participate in on\-call rotations and respond to urgent issues outside business hours when required. **Healthcare and regulated operations** * Support lot tracking, expiry date tracking, and FEFO or consume\-priority\-date based allocation. * integration** * Diagnose and adjust WMOS configuration, including wave and allocation rules, replenishment, task generation, and label setup. * Troubleshoot integrations with ERP, middleware, WCS/MHE, ASRS, parcel, and label systems. * Support configuration changes, enhancements, and regression testing in production\-adjacent environments. **Reporting and analysis** * Build and maintain SCI (Supply Chain Intelligence) reports for operations and support teams. * Analyze recurring incidents and data patterns to identify systemic fixes. **Client and practice** * Communicate clea  root cause analysis documentation. * Data accuracy and compliance for lot, expiry, and DSCSA\-related transactions. * Client satisfaction and feedback from operations and IT stakeholders. * Contributions to practice assets and, at Lead level, consultant development. **Why You'll Love Working Here:** At Fulfillment IQ, we don't just build supply chain solutions; we build long\-term careers. jobs.title: Facility Process Engineering Lead
jobs.description: Business Introduction We manufacture and supply reliable, high\-quality medicines and vaccines to meet patients’ needs and drive our performance. Our network of 37 medicines and vaccines manufacturing sites delivered 1\.7 billion packs of medicines and 409 million vaccine doses in 2024 to help make a positive impact on the health of millions of people. Our supply chain is not just core to our operations; it’s vital to bringing our innovations to patients as quickly, efficiently and effectively as possible. Technology is transforming how we manufacture medicines and vaccines, enabling us to increase the speed, quality and scale of product supply. We need the very best minds and capability to help us on our journey to make more complex products, harnessing the power of smart manufacturing technologies including robotics, digital solutions and artificial intelligence to deliver for patients. Facility Process Engineering Lead Position Summary Help build a next\-generation biopharmaceutical facility from the ground up. GSK is making a significant investment in the Upper Merion Flex Factory, a state\-of\-the\-art facility designed to connect science, technology and manufacturing to deliver more medicines to patients, faster. This is a unique opportunity to help define how the facility will operate for years to come. As the Flex Facility Process Engineering Lead, you will turn ambitious manufacturing concepts into safe, compliant and operable process solutions and see them through from concept to operation. You will lead process engineering and process\-equipment delivery across design, procurement, construction, commissioning, qualification, start\-up and handover. Working closely with GSK, our design and delivery partners, equipment suppliers and site stakeholders, you will play a critical role in bringing the Flex Factory vision to life. Help shape the process foundation of a flexible, future\-ready biologics facility. You will integrate innovative process technology, advanced analytics and digitally enabled ways of working to create manufacturing capabilities that are safe, efficient, scalable and capable of supporting the next generation of medicines. Responsibilities This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following: * Lead process engineering and process\-equipment delivery for the Upper Merion Flex Factory across the full project lifecycle, from scope definition and early design through procurement, construction, commissioning, qualification, start\-up and handover. * Shape and deliver an integrated process design that is safe, compliant, constructible, operable, maintainable and cost\-effective, while meeting the facility’s approved scope and operational requirements. * Build, lead and develop a high\-performing process engineering team, including approximately 6–10 direct reports and an extended matrix of Design Partner, EPC\+ partner, equipment\-supplier and subcontract resources. * Serve as GSK’s principal process engineering interface with project partners, equipment suppliers and site stakeholders, providing technical direction and enabling effective decisions across engineering, science, manufacturing, Quality, Validation, EHS, Operations and Project Controls. * Lead the specification, design, procurement, fabrication, delivery and technical acceptance of process equipment, ensuring that equipment meets user requirements and is delivered in alignment with the approved project scope, schedule and budget. * Apply strong biopharmaceutical process\-engineering principles to equipment and facility design, including cleanability, bioburden control, hygienic design and CIP/SIP requirements, in accordance with applicable GSK standards, cGMP expectations and industry guidance such as ASME BPE and ISPE. * Own EHS in Design and process\-safety delivery for the process\-engineering scope, ensuring that applicable GSK requirements and national and local regulations are addressed and that identified risks are driven to timely closure. * Integrate process engineering and equipment delivery with the overall project execution strategy, ensuring that scope, resources, technical deliverables, procurement, fabrication, installation, commissioning, qualification and validation are properly sequenced within the integrated project plan. * Provide process engineering leadership for project governance and investment decisions, including scope development, funding requests, Stage Gate Reviews, Design Verification, value engineering, estimate development, cost forecasting and management of technical, schedule, cost and interface risks. * Monitor process\-engineering and equipment expenditures against approved estimates, maintain clear forecasts and support development and validation of project budgets with the EPC\+ partner, equipment suppliers and subcontract partners. * Own process commissioning, qualification and handover readines ry of the Upper Merion Flex Factory. The role requires meaningful on\-site engagement with the project team, site stakeholders, design and delivery partners, equipment suppliers and subcontract partners. This role requires, at minimum, three days per week on site, reflecting the importance of close partnership with on\-site engineering, operational and project\-delivery teams. We want to hear from you if you are motivated to lead engineering excellence in a meaningful, people\-focused environment. Apply now to join a team making a difference every day. **Skills** Asset Life Cycle Management, Data Integrity, Digital Fluency, GxP Regulations, Lean Management, Manufacturing Technologies, Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Problem Solving, Risk Awareness, Standards Compliance Please visit GSK US Benefits Summary to learn more about the comprehensive benefits program GSK offers US employees. **Why GSK?** **Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.** GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2\.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale. People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. This ensures that all qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information (including family medical history), military service or any basis prohibited under federal, state or local law. **Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies** GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.
