jobs.title: Embedded Software Designer (Networking)
jobs.description: **At** **Kepler Communications****, we're not just imagining the future of on\-demand space connectivity \-** ***we're leading it!*** Our mission is to provide real\-time on\-orbit connectivity for critical missions, enabling a new era of data\-driven intelligence and innovation. With **33 satellites launched to date,** Kepler operates the first commercial optical data relay constellation, enabling real\-time, continuous space communications while supporting advanced on\-orbit compute and hosted payload capabilities. Industry\-leading technology is only part of the story. **What sets Kepler apart is our team:** bold thinkers, skilled builders, and passionate problem\-solvers who thrive on pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in space. We believe great ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we’re committed to creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and make a global impact. If you’re ready to reach higher, move faster, and do work that shapes the future space economy \- this is your launchpad. **Come build the future with Kepler!** **What We Offer:** * **Competitive compensation** with a robust equity plan to share in our success. * **Comprehensive coverage for health, dental, and vision insurance**—including dependents. * **Unlimited vacation, supportive parental leave policy,** and company\-wide holiday shutdown. * **Semi\-annual company\-wide parties** and frequent in\-office team events. * **Relocation packages** available for approved roles. * **$1,500 annual professional development fund** to support your growth. * **Fully stocked Toronto office kitchen** with snacks, drinks, games and top\-notch kitchen appliances. * **Town Halls, Celebration Calls, and Company\-wide events** to stay connected and engaged. * **We’re a certified** **Great Place to Work**®, seven years in a row! We're on the hunt for a top\-tier **Embedded Software Designer**, who enjoys getting close to the hardware and wants to build the networking software that runs on it. You’ll work with network architects, FPGA developers, and fellow embedded software developers to build and debug networking features on embedded Linux, from customizing Yocto layers and working with memory\-mapped peripherals to profiling memory usage on target hardware. You’ll bring hands\-on embedded Linux experience and an active interest in networking. Maybe you’ve implemented or debugged a routing protocol, contributed to a networking stack, or built a home lab to experiment with routing and trace where packets get dropped. Experience with routing software or programmable packet processing is a plus, and we welcome experience across networking stacks. ### **Key Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, and maintain embedded Linux software that supports networking and application layers across spacecraft and ground systems * Develop, integrate, and debug networking protocols and features, including routing, packet forwarding, and secure communications * Build and maintain the low\-level software that connects the networking stack to the hardware, including device drivers, kernel modules, and interfaces to FPGA logic and memory\-mapped peripherals. Customize Yocto layers to integrate and deliver these components * Work with network architects, FPGA developers, and fellow embedded software developers to define requirements, review designs, and troubleshoot issues across software and hardware * Profile CPU and memory usage on target hardware, measure networking performance, and address bottlenecks and reliability risks across the stack * Develop automated tests and validation tools for both networking behaviour and hardware integration. Document designs and interfaces so others can maintain and extend them * Contribute to software architecture, design reviews, and code reviews. Mentor other engineers and help improve development and debugging practices * Use tools such as Containerlab to create repeatable network topologies for testing routing, packet forwarding, and failure recovery. Validate hardware\-dependent behaviour on target systems ### **Required Skills \& Qualifications:** * 4\+ years of experience developing embedded software for complex, high\-reliability systems * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience * Proficiency in C or C\+\+ for embedded systems, with a solid understanding of concurrency, interrupt handling, and working with memory\-mapped peripherals * Hands\-on embedded Linux development experience, including work with components such as device drivers, kernel modules, or device trees. Familiarity with using Yocto/OpenEmbedded recipes and layers to customize Linux images * Strong debugging and performance analysis skills, including the ability to diagnose hardware/software integration issues and profile CPU and memory usage on target hardware * A practical understanding of IP networking fundamentals, including addressing, routing, and packet forwarding, and an interest in developing and debugging networking software. Experience from a home lab, personal project, or open\-source contribution counts alongside professional experience * Experience with automated testing, validation tooling, or hardware/software integration testing, and familiarity with CI pipelines, Git, and code review * Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across networking, FPGA, and embedded software teams * Willingness to use AI\-assisted engineering tools with sound judgment and verify their output ### **Bonus Points:** * Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field * Experience developing software for aerospace applications * Experience implementing or extending networking protocols, developing routing or forwarding software, or programming packet\-processing pipelines * Familiarity with Containerlab or similar tools for building repeatable network test topologies, especially for automated validation in CI * Hands\-on debugging of packet flow across Linux and FPGA or other hardware datapaths * Experience validating network behaviour during link failures, route changes, or traffic bursts * Experience implementing embedded security features such as secure boot, hardware security modules (HSMs), certificate and key management, authentication, or encrypted communications **Employment Equity \& Accommodation Statement** Kepler Communications is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals, including women, Indigenous peoples, persons with disabilities, members of visible minorities, and people of all sexual orientations and gender identities. If you require accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, please contact our People \& Culture team at accommodation@kepler.space, and we will work with you to meet your needs. At Kepler Communications, all hiring decisions are made by people. Human recruiters are involved in every step of our recruitment process. We use AI\-based tools (such as Lever AI and HireEZ) to assist with the initial review of applications by ranking candidates based on job\-relevant criteria. These tools support \- but do not replace \- human judgment.

jobs.title: Architect, Ontology & AI Innovation
jobs.description: About Kinaxis: **About Kinaxis** Are you looking to join an innovative, market\-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you! In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best\-in\-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today. Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end\-to\-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers. About the team: **Location** Ottawa and Toronto, CA \- Hybrid All other locations across the North America \- Remote**About the team** We’re building a kind of enterprise software that wasn’t possible until recently. The AI Innovation team at Kinaxis builds the agentic platform that our forward deployed engineers and customers use to create solutions that coordinate how a business runs its supply chain — connecting the many systems it depends on and acting on what’s changing across them. We’re a small team with real autonomy inside an established company. Our forward deployed engineers bring us the problems they hit in real customer engagements, and we design the capabilities that solve them, then fold what we learn back into the platform’s architecture. You’ll shape how the platform represents the enterprise, and what customers can build with it. Every solution on the platform rests on an ontology, a formal model of the customer’s enterprise, and its quality determines what the solution can reliably do. As our applied ontologist, you will turn how enterprises describe and run their supply chains into models precise enough to act on and general enough to serve customers in industries as varied as aerospace and defense, automotive, consumer products, and life sciences. About the role: **Vacancy Status** This is an existing job vacancy **What you will do** * Turn deep supply chain expertise into domain models that ship with the platform, ready for customers to adopt and to adapt to their own operations, grounded in recognized industry reference models wherever they exist. * Take new domain models from idea to release, owning schema design, implementation, testing, and demonstration through working examples, and set the standards that keep models consistent as they evolve and as the number of contributors grows. * Lead the design and evolution of supply chain ontologies, semantic models, and taxonomies from planning through execution, using modeling patterns that reflect real operations and stay reusable across industries and customers. * Ensure that supply chain concepts, relationships, rules, and constraints are represented so that agentic solutions can act on them reliably, with outcomes that can be explained. **What we are looking for** * Deep practical knowledge of supply chain planning and operations, and of how large enterprises represent them across their systems, data, and processes. * Extensive hands\-on experience building ontologies or comparable data, process, or knowledge models of complex business domains that operational systems act on, including translating business terminology, processes, and needs into well\-defined entities, relationships, rules, and constraints. * Strong understanding of ontology modeling principles, including class hierarchies, relationships, constraints, modularity, extensibility, and reuse. * Comfort implementing, testing, and releasing your own models through a software development workflow, alongside engineers. * A master’s degree or PhD in Supply Chain Management, Operations Research, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Knowledge Representation, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. **Nice to Have** * Familiarity with formal ontology concepts, industry reference models such as SCOR, and the standards that enable interoperability. * Experience modeling temporal concepts, planning scenarios, or digital twins of operations. * Experience developing reusable capabilities within an enterprise SaaS product serving multiple customers. **\#Senior** Why join Kinaxis?: **Work With Impact:** Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:** Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P\&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more. **Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:** Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long\-term net\-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact. *People matter* at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee: * Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company\-wide days off) * Flexible work options * Physical and mental well\-being programs * Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes * Mentorship programs, training, and career development * Recognition programs and referral rewards * Hackathons For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com. Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. *Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Connected Fleet & Operations
jobs.description: **About The Landline Company** Landline is building infrastructure that lets passengers clear security and check in for their flight closer to home, before they ever reach the airport. We provide seamless ground connectivity on behalf of American Airlines, Air Canada, Jet Blue, Delta, and other major carriers, integrating booking, secure transport, and baggage handling into a single ticket across a growing North American network. Backed by top\-tier venture investors and partners like CLEAR, we've spent eight years making the travel day seamless for millions of passengers. **Job Summary** Our drivers and frontline teams run a live 24/7 operation across a growing North American network, and the tools in their hands have to work the first time, even for someone who got hired last week. As a Software Engineer, you'll own that layer. That includes the driver app at the center of every trip, the handheld tools our station staff run their shifts on, and the connections back into the platform, from booking systems to the operations backend, that keep everyone in sync in real time. Our operation runs inside the networks of major airline partners like American Airlines and Air Canada. You'll work at hub airports and partner stations, alongside their teams and ours, watching how the operation actually runs. When you find something slow, manual, or error\-prone, you'll ship the fix and iterate on it in days rather than quarters. We work on a modern, engineer\-friendly stack and build agentic workflows into how we develop and how our tools run, and you'll have a real voice in where it goes next. **What You'll Do** * Own the field software layer: the driver app and the handheld tools frontline staff use every shift for scanning, verification, photo capture, and real\-time status. * Design flows that hold up in real field conditions, including offline use, glare, gloves, and one\-handed operation. * Integrate device capabilities like camera, barcode/NFC scanning, and GPS so field events are verifiable and auditable without slowing anyone down. * Integrate IoT and vehicle telematics, working with platforms like Samsara, so vehicle, device, and operational data flow into one real\-time picture of the operation. * Work across the platform when the problem calls for it, from booking flows to dispatch visibility to the operations backend, so field tools and core systems behave as one product. * Use and build agentic workflows. We rely on LLM\-driven tooling in development and in production, and we want people who are excited to push that further. * Deploy forward: ride along with drivers, work station shifts at partner hub airports, and ship the fix that week. Your users include our own teams and the airline partner staff we operate alongside. **What We're Looking For** * You know how to build for spotty connectivity and make sync conflicts boring, with offline\-first instincts. * Device and IoT integration experience with camera, barcode/NFC scanning, and GPS. * Experience with telematics/IoT platforms (Samsara or similar), rugged devices, or BLE sensors is a plus. * Modern web fluency in a Next.js/Vercel environment working across the stack when a feature needs it. * Agentic or automation experience is a plus, whether that's LLM\-driven workflows, orchestration, or process automation that real users depend on. * Secure\-by\-design instincts as we operate in a security\-regulated environment and build to federal\-grade standards, so data integrity, least privilege, and auditability should come naturally to you. * Forward\-deployed experience embedded with users or operations teams (as an FDE, in solutions engineering, or on internal tools in a physical\-ops business) and you're at your best turning messy operational reality into shipped software. * Comfortable reaching into backend services or web frontends when the fix lives there, across the stack. * A travel or logistics startup background is a plus, and familiarity with regulated data environments will speed up your ramp. **Why Join** * Impact — Ground\-floor ownership of tools a live operation depends on every day * Proximity — You'll watch drivers use what you built the same week you shipped it * Culture — A small, ambitious team that values speed, creativity, autonomy, and bias for action **What We Offer** * Global flight privileges through airline partners * Flexible, remote\-friendly work environment (with regular travel to stations in the USA and Canada, including Montréal, Boston, Denver, and Philadelphia) * Competitive salary, 401(k), and PTO * Medical, dental, vision, and company\-paid life insurance * The opportunity to contribute to sustainable transportation and redefine how people travel **Location**: Remote in a major metro area within the USA or Canada, with occasional travel to station locations in the USA and Canada **Time Zone**: Standard business hours local time, targeting EST and CST **Pay Target:** $120,000 **Job Type**: Full Time Salary, Exempt The Landline Company is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. \#LI\-Remote

jobs.title: Sr DevOps Engineer – AI-First Development
jobs.description: **Position Overview** The primary responsibility of the Senior DevOps Engineer (AI\-First Development) is to create, maintain, and continuously improve the development pipelines and application cloud environments that support every change shipped through the AI\-First Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) for Central Development. This role owns end\-to\-end delivery for Central Development applications, from source control and continuous integration through build, test, release, and deployment, as well as the configuration and ongoing operation of the application cloud environments those pipelines deploy into, built on the shared delivery path and cloud foundations maintained with Central DevSecOps. The role operates within an AI\-First SDLC in which AI agents serve as primary producers of pipeline code, infrastructure\-as\-code, environment configuration, and deployment artifacts, while the engineer provides platform direction, context engineering, human\-in\-the\-loop governance, and final accountability for the reliability of Central Development’s delivery pipelines and environments. The Senior DevOps Engineer is an experienced DevOps, infrastructure, or platform engineer who has adopted modern AI\-assisted development tools as a core part of their daily workflow and is prepared to grow into deeper agent orchestration, context engineering, and verification responsibilities. Prior experience with every specific AI\-First practice listed below is not required; demonstrated pipeline and cloud engineering judgment, strong code review skills, and a track record of effective AI tool usage are. All duties are to be performed in accordance with departmental and Las Vegas Sands Corp.’s policies, practices, and procedures. All Las Vegas Sands Corp. Team Members are expected to conduct and carry themselves in a professional manner at all times. Team Members are required to observe the company’s standards, work requirements and rules of conduct. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities** * **Pipeline Ownership, Agent Workflow Design, and Orchestration** + Create, own, and maintain Central Development’s pipelines, including source control workflows and build, automated test, artifact packaging, release, and deployment pipelines across its applications and environments, using the shared CI/CD templates. + Design, build, and maintain AI agent workflows that produce CI/CD pipeline code, infrastructure\-as\-code, environment configuration, and deployment artifacts from specifications and platform requirements. + Decompose platform and delivery requirements into discrete, verifiable pipeline tasks and infrastructure changes that AI agents can execute effectively within defined boundaries. + Select and configure appropriate AI models, agent frameworks, and infrastructure tooling for each workflow based on blast radius, operational risk, and cost considerations. + Construct and maintain platform context that provides agents with approved pipeline and infrastructure patterns, environment standards, naming and tagging conventions, and operational rules needed to produce correct and consistent outputs. + Contribute to the platform toolchain, including reusable pipeline skills, automation hooks, and project memory files that provide persistent context across agent sessions. Authoring of advanced toolchain components may be developed on the job. + Systematically capture incident patterns, pipeline failures, and deployment issues from each delivery cycle and encode them back into shared context, platform skills, and agent configurations so that subsequent work becomes more reliable. + Participate in collaborative refinement sessions to align on platform requirements, environment constraints, and context packages before agent execution begins. * **Cloud Environment Setup and Operations** + Configure, and maintain Central Development’s application environments (development, test, staging, and production), including compute, storage, databases, and managed services, using infrastructure\-as\-code built on shared enterprise modules. + Work with Central DevSecOps on landing zones, resource organization, identity and access configuration, and environment baselines, and apply them consistently across Central Development’s environments. + Provision and manage Central Development’s use of the container platforms and hosting services that pipelines deploy into, such as Kubernetes clusters, container registries, and serverless or app services. + Manage environment configuration, pipeline credentials and secrets (using enterprise\-approved secrets management), and environment promotion workflows to keep environments consistent and free of configuration drift. + Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and backup and recovery for cloud environments, and lead troubleshooting, incident response, and root\-cause analysis for pipeline and environment issues. + Monitor and optimize cloud resource utilization and cost through rightsizing, autoscaling ion or license, as required by law or policy. * 5\+ years of professional DevOps, infrastructure, or platform engineering experience, including time in senior or lead positions where the candidate owned the design, delivery, and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines and production cloud infrastructure. * Demonstrated daily use, over the past 6 months or more, of at least one modern AI\-assisted development tool such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Windsurf, with the ability to speak concretely about effective usage patterns and failure modes. * Strong foundational knowledge in at least one major programming or scripting ecosystem (such as Python, Go, TypeScript, Bash, or PowerShell) and hands\-on experience with at least one modern infrastructure\-as\-code framework (such as Terraform, Pulumi, Bicep, or comparable). Familiarity with additional platform layers is a plus. * Experience setting up, configuring, and operating production cloud environments on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including networking, identity and access management, compute, and managed services. Azure experience is a plus. * Hands\-on experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or comparable), including build automation, automated test integration, artifact management, and deployment strategies such as blue\-green, canary, or rolling releases. * Demonstrated experience conducting thorough code reviews, identifying defects in both human\- and AI\-generated outputs, and providing constructive technical feedback. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical decisions and trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively and interact appropriately with management, other Team Members and outside contacts of different backgrounds and levels of experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * Practical experience constructing structured context for LLMs, including prompt design, RAG pipelines, context window optimization, project memory files (such as CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md), and integration with MCP servers. Familiarity with tactical context management techniques such as plan mode, context editing, and multi\-session splitting. * Experience authoring reusable skills, configuring automation hooks, building custom MCP servers, or otherwise assembling agent toolchains that enable repeatable, production\-grade pipeline and platform workflows. * Hands\-on experience with container ecosystems (Docker, Kubernetes) and related tooling such as Helm, container registries, and GitOps tools (such as Argo CD or Flux). * Experience with monitoring and observability tooling (such as Azure Monitor, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or comparable) and with incident management and on\-call practices. * Experience working within a regulated industry such as gaming, finance, healthcare, or hospitality. Understanding of data privacy and responsible AI principles. * Experience delivering to on\-premises, hybrid, or isolated environments with differing regulatory requirements, so the same pipelines and modules can be deployed across business units and jurisdictions. * Relevant cloud certifications (such as Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Azure Administrator Associate, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, or comparable), and familiarity with configuration management tools (such as Ansible), secrets management platforms (such as HashiCorp Vault or cloud\-native equivalents), and cloud cost management practices. **Physical Requirements** Must be able to: * Physically access assigned workspace areas with or without reasonable accommodation. * Work remotely as necessary. * Work indoors and be exposed to various environmental factors such as, but not limited to, CRT, noise, and dust. * Utilize laptop and standard keyboard to perform essential functions of the job.

jobs.title: Software Developer – ColdFusion and Database Development - Digital Inspections
jobs.description: **Overview** **Contract Software Developer – ColdFusion and Database Development** **Project:** Digital Inspection Development and CMMS Integration **Company:** Management and Engineering Services, LLC (MES) **Engagement Type:** Independent Contract Software Development **1\. Project Overview** Management and Engineering Services, LLC (MES) is seeking an experienced software developer with demonstrated ColdFusion and database development experience to design, develop, and integrate digital inspection functionality into MES's proprietary Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS). The project involves developing up to ten (10\) digital inspection forms that can be accessed through multiple identification methods, including room number, building FMSS ID, building name, or voice command. The digital inspections will allow authorized users to conduct inspections electronically, document compliance findings, and automatically initiate unscheduled maintenance work orders when an inspection item is identified as not in compliance. The functionality will integrate directly with the existing CMMS work order database and maintenance assignment structure. **2\. Scope of Services and Functional Requirements** **A. Digital Inspection Development** The developer shall design and develop up to ten (10\) digital inspection forms within MES's existing CMMS platform. Potential digital inspections include, but are not limited to: * Exterior Building Inspection * Interior Building Inspection * Fire and Life Safety Inspection * Integrated Pest Management (IPM) Daily Field Log * IPM Inspection Checklist * Weekly Trap Check Log * Hantavirus Cleanup Record * Bed Bug Room Inspection The final inspection list and associated questions, response options, and inspection requirements will be provided or approved by MES. Each digital inspection shall: * Provide a structured checklist with questions and designated response options. * Allow the end user to identify whether an inspection item is in compliance or not in compliance. * Capture and retain inspection results in the CMMS database. * Associate inspection records with the applicable building, room, or facility. * Record the inspection date and applicable inspection information. * Allow authorized users to retrieve completed inspection records. **B. Inspection Retrieval and Identification** The developer shall create functionality allowing an end user to retrieve the appropriate digital inspection using one or more of the following methods: * Room number. * Building FMSS ID. * Building name. * Voice Voice command or voice\-assisted search. Voice retrieval may require integration with a speech\-recognition service. Developer to identify the recommended approach and any associated licensing or recurring costs before implementation. For example, a user could state: "Interior room inspection for room 101 in the XX Motel." The system shall identify the appropriate building and room, retrieve the corresponding inspection form, and present it to the user for completion. The developer shall ensure that the inspection retrieval process accurately identifies the intended location and inspection type. If the system cannot confidently identify the requested location or inspection, it should prompt the user to clarify or select the correct record before proceeding. **C. Automated Unscheduled Work Order Creation** A primary requirement of this project is the automatic creation of an unscheduled repair work order when an inspection item is identified as not in compliance. When an end user identifies an inspection item as not in compliance, the system shall automatically initiate a corresponding work order within the existing CMMS. The work order database fields shall automatically populate as follows: **Work Order Field** **Required System Action** Work Order Title Automatically populate based on the inspection finding and associated issue Work Order Category Repairs Unscheduled Work Order Status Pending Creation Date Automatically populate with the date the work order is generated Priority Status Routine – 8 Hours Assigned Shop Automatically assign to the appropriate maintenance shop, such as IPM Shop, or another designated shop based on the inspection finding Standard Procedure Automatically attach the applicable standard procedure, when one exists Work Instructions Automatically populate the applicable instructions associated with the finding or standard procedure Additional requirements: · The work order shall be linked to the originating inspection record. The inspection will retain its original responses even after a work order is created. The work order is a separate maintenance record linked to the inspection, so the original compliance finding is never overwritten. * The work order shall be associated with the correct building, room, or facility. * The system shall retain the inspection finding that triggered the work order. * The work order shall be routed to the appropriate maint  before coding begins. **5\. Testing and Acceptance Criteria** The developer shall coordinate with MES to test all developed functionality before final acceptance. Testing shall include: * Successful retrieval of the correct inspection by room number, building FMSS ID, and building name. * Successful voice\-assisted inspection retrieval. * Accurate recording of inspection responses. * Confirmation that compliant inspection items do not generate unnecessary work orders. * Confirmation that items marked not in compliance automatically generate the appropriate unscheduled repair work order. * Accurate population of all required work order fields. * Correct assignment to the designated maintenance shop. * Successful attachment of applicable standard procedures and automatic population of work instructions. * Accurate linkage between the inspection record and generated work order. * Successful generation and retrieval of inspection reports. * Verification that historical inspection records remain accessible. Final acceptance will be determined by MES following successful testing and confirmation that the developed functionality meets the agreed\-upon requirements. **6\. Confidentiality and Non\-Disclosure Agreement** Due to the proprietary nature of MES's software platform, source code, database architecture, client information, and business processes, the contractor must execute an MES Non\-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) before receiving access to any software, databases, technical documentation, or confidential company information. The contractor shall: * Maintain strict confidentiality regarding all MES proprietary and confidential information. * Use confidential information solely for the purpose of completing the assigned development project. * Not disclose, copy, distribute, or use MES source code, database information, software designs, or business information outside the scope of this engagement. * Not share system access credentials or permit unauthorized access to MES systems. * Not use MES proprietary information or developed functionality for another client or project. * Return or securely dispose of confidential materials and access credentials upon completion or termination of the engagement, as directed by MES. All developed source code, software modifications, database enhancements, technical documentation, and project\-specific deliverables shall be subject to the intellectual property ownership provisions established in the contractor agreement. **7\. Project Coordination and Communication** The contractor shall coordinate directly with designated MES personnel throughout the engagement. The contractor shall: * Participate in an initial project kickoff and technical requirements review. * Review the existing CMMS architecture and database structure before beginning development. * Provide periodic progress updates and communicate development milestones. * Identify technical limitations, integration concerns, or additional requirements that may affect the project. * Obtain MES approval before implementing changes outside the agreed\-upon scope. * Demonstrate completed functionality to MES before final acceptance. **8\. Engagement Terms** This is a contract\-based software development engagement. Project schedule, estimated hours, compensation, payment milestones, and anticipated completion date will be established separately with the selected contractor. The contractor is expected to provide the technical expertise necessary to develop, test, document, and integrate the specified digital inspection functionality into MES's existing proprietary CMMS platform. **Required Qualifications:** Demonstrated ColdFusion and database development experience is required. Experience with CMMS platforms, automated work order workflows, voice\-assisted applications, and enterprise software integrations is strongly preferred. **To Apply:** Please submit a résumé highlighting your ColdFusion development experience,. Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Lead Artificial Intelligence Engineer (Hybrid)
jobs.description: Serves as a hands\-on technical leader responsible for designing, building, evaluating, deploying, and maintaining production AI, machine learning, and generative AI systems. Operating as a player\-coach, this role splits time between writing production code, architecting end\-to\-end ML/MLOps pipelines on Databricks and AWS, and technically leading a team of AI/ML engineers and data scientists. Rather than focusing solely on high\-level strategy, this lead also drives technical execution—translating complex business problems into benchmarked, scalable, and measurable production models. Responsibilities Essential Functions *The list of essential functions, as outlined herein, is intended to be representative of the duties and responsibilities performed within this classification. It is not necessarily descriptive of any one position in this class. The omission of an essential function does not preclude management from assigning duties not listed herein if such functions are a logical assignment to the position.* * Hands\-On Model Development: Designs, trains, tunes, and deploys classical machine learning models (e.g., XGBoost, Random Forest, gradient boosting, forecasting, and regression models) and deep learning solutions to solve high\-impact business problems. * Generative AI \& Agentic Systems: Builds and ships production generative AI applications, including Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, vector search implementations, embedding strategies, foundation model fine\-tuning, and multi\-agent / agentic AI architectures. * End\-to\-End MLOps \& Production Ownership: Architects and maintains scalable MLOps workflows covering CI/CD for ML, automated retraining, experiment tracking, model versioning, deployment, latency/cost optimization, and live production monitoring (data drift, model degradation, and business value measurement). * Databricks \& Cloud Pipeline Engineering: Develops and operationalizes production ML pipelines using Python, PySpark, and Databricks on AWS—leveraging MLflow (tracking and Model Registry), Model Serving, Vector Search, Feature Store, Unity Catalog, and Databricks Workflows. * Model Evaluation \& Benchmarking: Builds rigorous offline and online evaluation frameworks to benchmark model quality prior to and following release, tracking domain\-relevant metrics such as precision, recall, F1, AUC\-ROC, and ranking/retrieval metrics like nDCG. * Feature Engineering \& Data Readiness: Partners with data teams to design ML\-ready feature pipelines and reusable feature stores that support both predictive ML and generative AI workloads. * Engineering Excellence \& Code Quality: Leads by example through active code reviews, architectural design reviews, automated testing, version control, and reproducible experimentation standards across the team. * Technical Team Leadership: Mentors, coaches, and manages a team of AI/ML engineers and data scientists—providing hands\-on technical unblocking, career development, and delivery accountability. * Cross\-Functional Execution: Collaborates directly with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to scope technical feasibility, define measurable success criteria, and prioritize the AI/ML delivery roadmap. * Governance \& Responsible AI: Implements practical governance, security, lineage, documentation, and compliance controls directly within the ML platform (e.g., via Unity Catalog and model registries) to ensure transparent, auditable, and reliable AI systems. Education and/or Experience * Bachelor’s degree (Master of Science preferred) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field from an accredited college or university. * Six plus (6\+) years of progressive, hands\-on experience in AI/ML engineering or applied data science, with a proven track record of personally developing, deploying, and maintaining machine learning and/or generative AI models in production. *(Note: Experience solely in enterprise IT, AI strategy, or traditional data engineering/ETL without direct production ML model ownership is not sufficient.)* Certificates, Licenses, Registrations, and Designations * None required. *(Databricks Certified Machine Learning Professional or AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty is a plus.)* Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Core Programming \& ML Engineering * Expert\-level proficiency in Python and SQL, with strong software engineering fundamentals (version control/Git, unit/integration testing, CI/CD, modular production code, and code reviews). * Deep, hands\-on experience implementing and tuning specific machine learning algorithms (such as XGBoost, Random Forest, LightGBM, regression, classification, clustering, and time\-series forecasting) using modern ML frameworks (e.g., scikit\-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow). * Proven experience building distributed data and ML pipelines using PySpark. Databricks \& MLOps Platform * Strong hands\-on experience with Databricks (ideally on AWS), specifically utilizing MLflow (experiment tracking, model versioning, and Model Registry), Model Serving, Feature Engineering / Feature Store, Vector Search, Unity Catalog, and Databricks Workflows. * Comprehensive MLOps expertise across automated deployment, production model monitoring, drift detection, latency/cost optimization, benchmarking, and full model lifecycle management. Generative AI \& Evaluation * Hands\-on production experience building Generative AI solutions, including RAG architectures, LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and agentic AI workflows, as well as model customization techniques (supervised fine\-tuning, parameter\-efficient fine\-tuning/PEFT). * Demonstrated expertise designing model evaluation and benchmarking frameworks, including hands\-on application of classification, regression, and retrieval/ranking metrics (precision, recall, nDCG, MRR, hallucination/faithfulness metrics) and production A/B testing or shadow deployments. * Strong statistical foundation in experimental design, hypothesis testing, causal inference, and uncertainty quantification. Technical Leadership \& Communication * Ability to operate as a hands\-on technical lead who can both architect/code complex solutions as well as provide guidance and input to the rest of the AI/ML team. * Ability to translate model performance, technical trade\-offs, and production metrics into clear, measurable business outcomes for executive and non\-technical stakeholders. This is a hybrid role with 3 days a week in\-office. Please no third\-parties. And no sponsorship is offered for this role. Pay: $170,000\.00 \- $185,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * I confirm that I don't require sponsorship now, or will EVER require sponsorship, to work in the US. jobs.description: **Industrial Automation Controls Engineer (Robotics \& Motion)** ================================================================ Imagine your morning starts by refining PLC logic for a high‑speed cell, then moving to the floor to bring a six‑axis robot, a safety PLC, and coordinated servo axes to life. After lunch, you iterate on HMI screens for operator clarity, redline a schematic for a late‑breaking change, and close the day with a multi‑disciplinary huddle ensuring everything ships on time and to standard. If that rhythm sounds exciting, you’ll feel at home at Matrix Design. **Why Matrix Design** --------------------- We believe great outcomes come from great people. Our purpose is reflected in three commitments—Developing Great People, Building a Great Company, and Delivering Great Results—and lived daily through our six Core Values: * We Can Do That! * We Do It Right! * We Do What We Say * We Do It Better Next Time! * We Do It Together! * We Do It for a Greater Purpose We put the Right Person in the Right Seat so complex, cross‑industry automation challenges are met with creativity, perseverance, and teamwork. **What you’ll own** ------------------- * Design, program, and implement control systems for automated manufacturing, including PLC and HMI development. * Integrate industrial robots and motion platforms (servos, VFDs, coordinated motion) into custom solutions. * Partner with mechanical, electrical, robot programming, and software teams to achieve performance, quality, and uptime targets. * Commission systems on site; troubleshoot and debug controls during build, install, and startup. * Verify compliance to safety and quality standards and complete risk assessments. * Create and maintain detailed documentation: redlined electrical schematics, panel/layout drawings, user guides, and change logs. * Contribute to project planning with estimates for effort, schedule, and cost. **How you operate** ------------------- * Ideal team player mindset: humble (elevates others), hungry (self‑driven and proactive), and smart (emotionally intelligent and pragmatic). **Skills you’ll use** --------------------- * PLC programming proficiency (e.g., Allen‑Bradley, Siemens) and HMI development. * Hands‑on experience with industrial robots (e.g., FANUC, ABB, Yaskawa). * Strong command of motion control, VFDs, and servo drives. * Ability to read, critique, and contribute to electrical schematic design. * Fluency in industrial networking and protocols (e.g., Ethernet/IP, Modbus, ProfiNet). * Structured troubleshooting and problem‑solving under time constraints. * Clear communicator with strong organizational habits and attention to detail. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a closely related discipline. * 5\+ years leading controls engineering efforts focused on automation and robotics. * Proven experience delivering PLC, HMI, and robotic systems from concept through commissioning. * Knowledge of safety standards and risk assessments (e.g., ANSI, NFPA, ISO). * Experience programming safety controllers or safety‑rated PLCs. * Demonstrated skill troubleshooting industrial electrical control systems. * PE license or vendor certifications (e.g., Rockwell, Siemens) are a plus. **Travel** ---------- Up to 40% for installation, commissioning, and support. The posted salary range represents an estimate for this role. The final offer will be determined based on several factors, including the candidate’s specific skills, professional experience, and relevant certifications.

jobs.title: Program Manager Software and 3P AI
jobs.description: Employee Technology, Strategy \& Operations (ETSO) owns the strategy, commercial management, and operational running of the hardware, software, and telecommunications that Meta's full\-time and contingent workforce uses worldwide, with a charter to deliver one consistent employee technology experience at a predictable cost.You are an experienced Enterprise Program Manager with domain\-level depth in enterprise systems strategy and platform coherence. Business Operations runs a large estate of systems that cross team boundaries, and divergence between them creates a real cost. This role is the single accountable owner for system parity and coherence across Business Operations: deciding which common systems teams align on, publishing the rationale so that decisions are not relitigated, and driving the change management that makes those decisions stick. You own the platform coherence strategy in partnership with Enterprise Products, what stays, what goes, what merges, and the enhancements needed on the applications Enterprise Products supports across the team. You also run the hub\-and\-spoke operating model that keeps that coherence from becoming a bottleneck. The role is roughly 60% platform strategy, alignment, and governance, and 40% hands\-on delivery on named initiatives.This role is one of three pillars of ETSO's transformation layer, alongside Business Intelligence \& Operational Data Model, which owns data standards and model quality, and Agentic Transformation \& Business Enablement, which owns what gets automated. You own the platform layer that both run on. Enterprise Products builds and the domains own their backend business logic; you direct what gets built and why, at a level of specificity engineers can act on. Scope is deliberately limited to systems that more than one team depends on, and you own the test that admits a system to this scope. At this level you are expected to set the system's direction for the whole of Business Operations and to be a recognized point of authority in it. ### **Program Manager Software and 3P AI Responsibilities:** * Our system selection and parity across Business Operations: decide which common systems teams align on, make the tool selection, publish the rationale with the decision, and own the test that allows a system to cross\-team scope * Own the platform coherence strategy in partnership with Enterprise Products: decide what stays, what goes, and what merges, identify where stronger AI capabilities exist that the organization should be using, define the enhancements needed on the applications Enterprise Products supports, and influence their roadmap priority * Own engineering and product alignment: work requirements, trade\-offs, and sequencing with Enterprise Products and partner engineering to land the right tool, arbitrate where a domain declines to migrate off a deselected system, and escalate where consensus fails * Run the hub\-and\-spoke operating model: aggregate and arbitrate conflicting requirements, sequence decisions, push decision rights down to named spokes, and keep spokes unblocked. If teams are waiting on the hub, the model is failing * Own the canonical definitions at the systems layer and the process by which a canonical change is proposed, reviewed, and landed across teams * Own change management as the deliverable: convince and align teams on the direction and land large system changes across the organization. A decision that no team has adopted has delivered nothing * Define what cross\-team systems must produce for leadership, including the Command Center and equivalent surfaces, and hold the data and jobs.description: Software Engineer, Systems \& InfrastructureOur mission is to create high\-quality training data and evaluations so Meta's AI models become and stay state\-of\-the\-art. Our center of gravity is the hardest part of that problem: software that runs on real devices, under real power and timing constraints. Today's models are genuinely weak there, and it's one of the few gaps you cannot scrape your way out of — it takes real devices, real firmware, real bring\-up, and a working loop around all of it.That's the center of gravity, not the boundary. This work pulls on infrastructure, distributed systems, developer tooling, OS and kernel, and platform engineering, and the teams here draw on the full range of those capabilities across a broad variety of tracks.About This OpportunityMost infrastructure improves one product. software engineering with a focus on systems\-level development, including distributed systems, storage, networking, or platform infrastructure * Experience designing and implementing large\-scale technical requirements, aligning with stakeholders, and defining solutions in environments where the problem statement is not fully specified ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience applying jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud\-enabled world. Microsoft’s Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging \& real\-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform of AI, powering a new class of data\-first applications and driving a data culture. Within Microsoft Fabric, the Platform team builds and operates the unified foundation that brings together all Fabric workloads into a single, cohesive experience. The platform provides shared infrastructure, governance, security, and a unified data model that enables customers to manage their entire data estate in one place. This team is central to delivering Fabric as a complete, end\-to\-end intelligence platform. Every AI agent is only as good as the data it can reach. As a Software Engineer on the OneLake team, you'll design and lead the highly scalable systems that connect AI to data across clouds, platforms and formats. OneLake is the open data lake at the heart of Microsoft Fabric and the data foundation for the AI agents built on it. Enterprise data rarely lives in one place. Our team brings it together without copying it: with shortcuts, mirroring and catalog federation, data in Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Databricks and on\-premises systems shows up in OneLake as a single copy, ready for Spark, SQL, Power BI and AI. And the scale is real: OneLake handles over 110 billion interactions a day, more than 15 million shortcuts are in active use, and storage has grown over 300% in a year. That creates some of the hardest distributed systems problems in the industry. How do you make data in another cloud feel local, fast and secure? How do you keep metadata in sync with many external catalogs, bridge open table formats like Delta Lake and Apache Iceberg, and enforce one consistent security model across all of it? As a Engineer, you'll drive the architecture for these answers, own critical services end to end, work directly with our largest enterprise customers, and mentor engineers around you. If you have deep distributed systems experience and want to shape how the world's data connects to AI, join us. We do not just value differences or different perspectives. We seek them out and invite them in so we can tap into the collective power of everyone in the company. As a result, our customers are better served. **Responsibilities** * Design, build and operate highly scalable multi\-cloud services for shortcuts, mirroring and catalog federation, and lead technical design for features across the team. * Drive performance, caching, metadata sync and reliability improvements across open formats such as Delta Lake and Apache Iceberg. * Build secure\-by\-default systems for identity, credential brokering, permissions and network access across clouds. * Own services end to end, from design and code to deployment, monitoring and live\-site, and raise the team's engineering and operational quality bar. * Partner with Product Managers, partner teams and strategic enterprise customers to understand requirements, unblock adoption and turn feedback into product improvements. * Mentor engineers through design and code reviews and use AI tools such as GitHub Copilot to deliver clean, well\-tested code faster. jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect — Enterprise
jobs.description: **Company Description** **About Mirantis** Mirantis is the Kubernetes\-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data\-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production\-ready developer platforms across any environment—on\-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI\-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy\-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock\-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy. **Job Description** We're looking for a Solutions Architect who wants to own that transition inside real accounts: banking, insurance, telecom, government, pharma. This is enterprise infrastructure, not experimental AI — the customer's platform and security teams will be in the room, and your technical credibility is what earns their trust. This is not a support role. You own the architecture conversation, the proof\-of\-concept, and the depth of the customer relationship. Account Executives partner with you — the technical trust is yours to build. **What You'll Actually Do** * Own the technical relationship. Be the person CTOs, platform teams, and infrastructure leaders trust for a straight answer — not just the one who runs the demo. * Architect real solutions. Translate a customer's constraints — regulatory, operational, organizational — into deployable architecture across our Container, OpenStack, and Enterprise AI offerings. * Lead the proof. Run PoCs that prove fit under real conditions: deploy the platform, prototype workloads, debug live, and show what running it operationally actually looks like. * Tell the story. Turn infrastructure complexity into a narrative a CIO and a platform engineer can each act on — in a boardroom, a workshop, or on a whiteboard. * Build and protect the account. Carry technical continuity from discovery through PoC through expansion — especially in regulated environments where trust is earned slowly and lost fast. * Win net\-new. Bring the same credibility to greenfield opportunities across all verticals, where the AI infrastructure conversation is often just starting. * Shape what we build. Feed field insight back into product and GTM as our Enterprise AI infrastructure evolves — your input carries real weight. **Who You Are** * You've lived the cloud native rise. Containers, Kubernetes, OpenStack, platform engineering — you've built and operated this, likely as a Platform engineer, DevOps engineer, or Cloud Architect, before moving toward the customer. * You're pulled toward AI infrastructure. GPU orchestration, inferencing, model serving — you're already leaning in, not waiting to be asked. * You think in platforms, not tools. Compute, networking, storage, and now inference and governance — one architecture, not a checklist. * You can deploy what you sell. You stand up clusters, run live demos, build PoCs, and debug them yourself when something breaks in front of the customer. * You own relationships, not tickets. You've managed accounts in regulated, high\-scrutiny environments and know that technical trust is the actual sales cycle. * You're a natural technical evangelist. Conference talks, open\-source contributions, technical writing, demo\-building — this is already how you show up. **Qualifications** Driving demonstrable outcomes and results is what we care about most. We want someone with a proven track record of leading technical evaluations that turn into signed deals — and who can tell you exactly how they did it. Equally important: proven technical authority in highly complex enterprise environments, where the sales cycle runs through platform and security review as much as procurement. This is relationship development and technical account management as much as it is architecture. **Practical Requirements** * 5–12 years combined experience across infrastructure engineering and solutions architecture / sales engineering. * Hands\-on experience designing or operating Kubernetes and/or OpenStack\-based systems in production. * Proven track record supporting enterprise sales cycles for infrastructure or cloud platforms. * Experience managing accounts in regulated industries (banking/FSI, telecom, government, pharma/manufacturing) strongly preferred. * Location, language, and account assignment are set per territory. **Additional Information** **Why you’ll love Mirantis** * Work with an established leader in the cloud infrastructure industry. * Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next\-generation cloud technologies. * Be a part of cutting\-edge, open\-source innovation. * Thrive in the high\-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk\-taking, and continuous growth are valued. * Receive a competitive compensation package with strong benefits plan. **It is understood that Mirantis, Inc. may use automated decision\-making technology (ADMT) for specific employment\-related decisions. Opting out of ADMT use is requested for decisions about evaluation and review connected with the specific employment decision for the position applied for. You also have the right to appeal any decisions made by ADMT by sending your request to isamoylova@mirantis.com** By submitting your resume, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, for the purposes of considering your application for current and future job opportunities. We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (\#2 after AWS)!

jobs.title: Manufacturing Process & Quality Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **Design the process. Prove the capability. Scale the impact.** --------------------------------------------------------------- Autocam/NN Inc. advances precision manufacturing through innovative thinking and state\-of\-the\-art machining. Our empowered teams are the heart of our success. We’re seeking a Manufacturing Process \& Quality Systems Engineer to architect reliable, cost\-effective production and lead quality planning from concept to sustained run. ### **Imagine this challenge** A new customer program lands. You translate intricate prints using GD\&T, stand up an APQP plan with the Project Launch Guide, and map APS\-driven improvements. You evaluate capital equipment needs, finalize tooling strategies, and publish process documentation and work instructions. Operators are trained on SPC and interpretation of docs. You finalize cost standards, quote a variant part, and confirm QMS/EMS conformance—all before first article approval. ### **Your responsibilities** * Partner with product teams to develop standardized procedures and documentation for consistent, high\-quality, and cost\-effective manufacturing. * Support capital equipment planning and implementation with technical rigor. * Engineer and optimize processes and tooling for current production and new launches. * Lead APQP teams and continuous improvement leveraging the Project Launch Guide and the Autocam Production System (APS). * Maintain accurate process documentation, work instructions, and cost standards. * Prepare precise quotes for new parts and update customer quotations as needed. * Train operators on machine operations, SPC, document interpretation, and process improvement techniques. * Interpret technical drawings and apply GD\&T principles to ensure capability. * Safeguard adherence to the Quality Management System (QMS) and Environmental Management System (EMS). ### **What you’ll need to succeed** * BS in Engineering or equivalent technical training with 3\+ years of experience. * Strong problem\-solving ability; continuous improvement and lean\-focused mindset. * Proficiency in technical documentation, cost estimation, and manufacturing software systems. * Comfort reading complex technical documents and communicating across all levels. * Experience with APQP and GD\&T in a production setting. ### **Expertise we value** * GD\&T * Bachelor's Degree * Industrial and Manufacturing Engineering * Continuous Improvement * Statistical process control (SPC) * Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) * Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) * Process Engineering * Experience in a Manufacturing Environment * PPAP Process Experience * Root Cause Analysis ### **Machining platforms you’ll influence** * CNC Lathe (2\-4 axis) (Mazak, Haas) * CNC Swiss Lathe (Citizen, Tornos) * CNC Lathe (5\+ axis) (Mazak, Index, Miyano) If building scalable, document\-driven, and statistically capable processes motivates you, we’d like to meet you.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, User Simulation and Advanced Synthetic Data Generation
jobs.description: Today, NVIDIA is tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what's never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you'll be immersed in an inclusive, encouraging environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how we can make a lasting impact on the world. We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our new User Simulation and Advanced Synthetic Data Generation team. You will own the systems our research runs on: the architecture, scale, and releases of our open\-source framework. You'll also build the environments where simulated users meet models and agents. User simulation is quickly becoming core infrastructure for evaluating and training AI models and agents. They are judged by how they work with users, people or other agents, over many turns: holding a conversation, using tools, or collaborating on code in a real repository. Real data is thinnest here: slow and costly to collect, skewed toward existing users, and missing the long tail of languages, domains, and safety scenarios. We build grounded synthetic users and simulators, then use both to find capability gaps and close them with targeted training data and RL environments. A lot of our work ships as open source, including NeMo User Sim, Nemotron\-Personas, and the data and environments we generate. We build our own systems on these same tools. We publish and present at top conferences, and we organize UserSim @ NeurIPS 2026, the first NeurIPS workshop on user simulation. The team serves three groups: * **Internal partners** , including Nemotron and other model, agent, and product teams who evaluate and train their models with our simulators. * **Open\-source users and contributors** who build on the framework for their own models, agents, and languages. * **The research community** , through work that pushes the state of the art and is published at top venues. The mission is the boss. We organize around the problem, not titles or ownership. Researchers write production code, engineers shape research, and everyone works directly with partner teams. We share credit, review each other's work candidly, and pick up whatever moves the mission forward. **What you'll be doing:** * Own the architecture of NeMo User Sim: the conversation engine, configuration\-driven pipelines, and extension API. * Scale simulation to tens of thousands of concurrent multi\-turn episodes against hosted and self\-served models (e.g., vLLM, NIM), sharded across Slurm or Kubernetes. Runs must survive rate limits and partial failures, resume cleanly, and reproduce down to the row. * Build and run environments for agents. These include stateful simulated tool services, and sandboxed coding environments where simulated users work with coding agents on real repositories. Verifiers and hidden tests grade the results. * Connect simulated users to NeMo Gym and RL training, and keep the loop fast and cheap. * Turn research prototypes into reliable, tested features together with research scientists. Run the open\-source project: versioned releases, CI/CD, dependency and license hygiene, issue triage, and contributor reviews. Build the pipelines behind our open data releases, onboard internal partner teams, and present the framework at conferences. * **What we need to see:** * BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). * 6\+ years building production ML systems, data pipelines, or developer libraries. * Expert Python skills, with a track record of typed, tested libraries that other teams depend on. * Experience running LLM workloads at scale: serving (e.g., vLLM, TensorRT\-LLM, NIM), concurrency, and cost. * Experience with LLM evaluation, training\-data pipelines, or agents that use tools. Strong software design judgment on interfaces, versioning, and backward compatibility, with the mission ahead of ownership and credit. * **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Maintaining a widely used open\-source ML library. * RL training infrastructure or environments, such as NeMo Gym or NeMo RL. * Infrastructure for coding agents: container sandboxes and SWE\-bench\-style harnesses. * Inference optimization: distillation, quantization, or speculative decoding. Experience with NeMo Data Designer, Ray, or Spark and experience with multilingual text processing, such as language identification, scripts, and localization. * NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, and you want to build the open\-source infrastructure behind trustworthy user simulation, we want to hear from you! jobs.description: We're looking for an experienced Tax Manager to support our growing network of offices. You'll focus on tax review and technical guidance, and you'll help each office's Principal deliver high\-quality client service. You'll work with teams in multiple locations, so a strong reviewer who enjoys developing people will have impact across the firm, not just one office. This position is fully remote.
