We are bringing together established practices and running them on a modern, AI\-assisted platform, keeping the clients and team culture that made each firm successful and adding tools no independent firm could build alone. We're venture\-backed and growing: six offices, with 3,000\+ clients across California, New York, New Jersey, Texas, and Florida. With a team of software engineers and accountants, Numica is bringing innovative technology to accounting while staying committed to being long\-term stewards of our clients, our people, and the work. Technology handles the grind so our team can spend its time advising and supporting clients, with a sustainable busy\-season pacing. Pay: $105,000\.00 \- $144,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Windows Software Engineer
jobs.description: Sunnyvale, CA **OLOID · Sunnyvale, in office · Full time · $170,000 to $210,000 base** **A new Sunnyvale tech hub, built from day one** ------------------------------------------------ We are building a brand new tech hub in Sunnyvale, and you would be one of its founding hires, reporting into our core executive team. It is a lean team, so you own a workflow end to end and have real influence over your scope of work, how the team is built and who joins next. Our Windows client runs on the shared workstations frontline teams depend on every shift. When it works, nobody notices. When it does not, a ward or a production line is waiting. This is a hands on product engineering seat in both C\#/.NET and C\+\+. **Why now** ----------- 2027 is a big year for us. Revenue is up 600 percent since our Series A and we are going after seven figure enterprise deals. Microsoft retires SMS and voice MFA in Entra ID in February 2027, which pushes every enterprise toward exactly what we build. Healthcare is our next big market, and Aura, our AI identity assurance agent, is already part of Workday’s Agent System of Record. The Sunnyvale hub is where that next chapter gets built, and the people who join now are the ones who shape it. **Is this you?** ---------------- Be honest with yourself on this one: it is not for the faint hearted. You will wear many hats, move between building, fixing and talking to customers, and make calls without a playbook to lean on. If you have worked in a high growth environment and bring a growth mindset, you will thrive here, and you will be part of building something at a genuinely exciting moment. **Why OLOID** ------------- OLOID builds passwordless identity for the 1\.8 billion people who work on the frontline: the nurse, the line worker, the store associate who moves between shared workstations all shift, often with no work smartphone. They sign in with a face, a badge tap or NFC, on Windows, Linux and Android, layered onto Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Ping Identity and the systems a company already runs. Tyson Foods, PepsiCo, GE, Takeda, Flex and Honeywell are customers, and we are backed by Dell Technologies Capital, Okta Ventures and Honeywell Ventures. **What you will do** -------------------- * Design and ship Windows features, background services and integrations in C\#/.NET and C\+\+ * Own threading, performance, IPC, permissions and failure recovery * Track down field issues through logs, crash dumps and reproducible lab environments * Review code, improve installs and upgrades, and explain root causes clearly to customers and colleagues **What you bring** ------------------ * Recent hands on delivery of complex Windows applications, desktop clients, services or endpoint agents * Production code in both C\#/.NET and C\+\+, with clear examples of what you wrote in each * Strong Windows internals: processes, services, threads, permissions and the relevant Windows APIs * Credible debugging of crashes, hangs and resource issues with the right Windows tools **Great if you also have** -------------------------- Credential providers, Active Directory or Entra ID; WPF, WinUI or COM; MSI, WiX or MSIX; Citrix or shared workstation environments. **Where you work** ------------------ Full time in our new Sunnyvale office. You must live in the San Francisco Bay Area or be prepared to relocate. We are investing in building an in person team, and Sunnyvale is our technical SME hub. **Pay and the rest** -------------------- Guideline $170,000 to $210,000 base, set on experience. Equity is part of every offer. You must be authorised to work in the US without employer visa sponsorship, now or in the future. OLOID is an equal opportunity employer. **Interview stages** -------------------- * **Intro call with our talent team.** About 30 minutes on your background, what you are looking for and the role. * **First interview with the hiring lead.** A deeper conversation about your experience and the work you have owned. * **Conversations with the wider leadership team.** Meet the product, engineering and commercial leaders you would build with. * **One day onsite in Sunnyvale.** Time with the team in person, including a hands on practical based on real work. You will hear where you stand at every stage. **Come ready** -------------- Come ready to show real examples of your work: things you built, configured, designed, shipped or wrote yourself. Be confident in your ownership and execution. We want to hear what you personally owned, the calls you made and how you got it over the line.

jobs.title: Manager, Site Reliability Engineering
jobs.description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is building some of the world's largest and most advanced GPU clusters to power the next generation of AI. The Strategic Customer Engineering (SCE) Core Infrastructure team—also known as the AI/ML Forward Deployed Infrastructure Engineering team—provides white\-glove engineering and operational support to OCI's most strategic AI/ML infrastructure customers. As a trusted partner to our customers, we play a critical role in designing, deploying, operating, and optimizing the infrastructure that powers some of the largest and most demanding GPU and AI/ML environments in the world. Our team works closely with customers and internal engineering organizations to ensure exceptional reliability, performance, and scalability for mission\-critical AI workloads. We are seeking a Manager to lead and develop a class of early\-career Infrastructure Engineers. This leader will create the conditions for new professionals to build sound technical judgment, strong customer habits, and the practical skills required to support strategic AI/ML infrastructure customers on OCI. The manager will combine people leadership with hands\-on operational guidance, helping the class grow into effective engineers who can independently contribute to customer execution, automation, troubleshooting, and infrastructure performance. Lead, mentor, and develop a class of early\-career Engineers, setting clear expectations for technical growth, customer engagement, quality, and ownership. Design and run an onboarding and development program that gives early\-career professionals progressive experience with GPU cluster deployment, Slurm and/or Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE), automation, monitoring, multicloud, database and operational readiness. Provide regular coaching, feedback, career guidance, and practical learning opportunities. Pair team members with appropriate mentors and create stretch assignments that build confidence and sound engineering judgment. Guide the team in building collaborative relationships with OCI Services, customers, sales, and core engineering teams. Model clear technical communication and help team members become effective, trusted customer partners. Establish a safe, accountable environment where early\-career professionals learn to take ownership of problems, investigate issues thoroughly, document risks, and escalate with context when needed. Coach team members on infrastructure performance fundamentals, including parameter tuning, resource utilization, caching, and data pre\-processing techniques for AI/ML workloads. Oversee the team's approach to troubleshooting performance, scalability, and reliability issues. Review complex cases, remove barriers, and ensure lessons learned are incorporated into team practices. Ensure the team documents infrastructure designs, configurations, runbooks, and procedures so knowledge is shared, work is maintainable, and new professionals can learn from repeatable practices. Help team members develop into credible customer advocates who can explain advanced GPU solution best practices and support customers and partners as they migrate workloads to the cloud. Partner with senior technical leaders to calibrate the class's development progress, staffing needs, and readiness for increasingly independent customer\-facing and engineering responsibilities. **Qualifications:** 7\+ years of relevant infrastructure, cloud, platform, or software engineering experience, including experience leading or mentoring engineers. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to coach early\-career professionals and translate technical concepts for customers, partners, and non\-technical stakeholders. Demonstrated people\-management, mentoring, or talent\-development skills, with a thoughtful and consistent approach to feedback and performance management. Experience building, operating, or supporting distributed and cloud infrastructure solutions in a customer\-focused environment. Demonstrated ability to: * Develop short\-, medium\-, and long\-term development plans that connect individual growth to team and business objectives. * Work across functional areas with senior leaders and technical partners to secure opportunities, support, and clear expectations for an early\-career class. Influence through coaching, sound judgment, and clear communication in situations involving competing priorities or sensitive feedback. * BS or MS degree, or equivalent experience, relevant to the functional area. Working knowledge of infrastructure automation and orchestration tools such as Ansible, Terraform, Python, Docker, Kubernetes, and related tooling. Solid understanding of networking concepts, security principles, and operational best practices. Excellent problem\-solving skills, with the ability to guide others through structured troubleshooting and drive timely resolution in a fast\-paced environment. Strong Linux skills with hands\-on experience in Oracle Linux/RHEL/CentOS, Ubuntu, or Debian, including system administration, package management, shell scripting, and performance optimization. Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Rust, Go, Java, or Scala, and the ability to use code reviews and pairing to develop others. Experience designing, implementing, managing, or supporting infrastructure for AI/ML, HPC, GPU, or similarly complex cloud workloads. **Core Responsibilities** **Planning \& Execution:** Plan and guide the class's work across onboarding, customer support, automation, and development goals. Set clear priorities, assign work that matches each person's readiness, monitor delivery, and adjust learning plans as business needs change. **Collaboration \& Partnership:** Build productive cross\-functional partnerships that give early\-career professionals access to the expertise and context they need. Model inclusive collaboration, actively seek diverse perspectives, and help the team communicate expectations clearly with stakeholders and customers. **Problem Solving:** Coach the team to analyze operational and technical issues using sound problem\-solving practices. Review complex or ambiguous cases, help identify root causes, and turn lessons learned into guidance that prevents recurrence. **Continuous Learning:** Create structured opportunities for team members to build expertise through training, paired work, technical reviews, and hands\-on customer scenarios. Track individual skill growth, identify gaps early, and reinforce a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous learning. **Continuous Improvement:** Enable the team to improve processes, protocols, runbooks, and workflows. Gather feedback from early\-career professionals and partners, prioritize practical improvements, and help the team learn how to turn ideas into durable operational practices. **Performance and Development:** Drive consistent performance and development through timely, specific feedback, regular coaching, and clear growth expectations. Support hiring, onboarding, talent reviews, and promotion readiness in partnership with leadership and HR, while aligning individual development plans to organizational needs.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Ideally, the candidate will possess several of the following skills:** **Note:** The candidate is required to be in Oracle’s Nashville office – **5 days/week.** This role strengthens the security and resilience of Enterprise Engineering services that support enterprise operations and engineering productivity. The engineer applies security judgment, automates operational workflows, identifies weaknesses, and contributes to compliance assessments and remediation. They own assigned deliverables, collaborate with service owners, and escalate complex security issues to senior team members. * **Automation and Scripting — Required:** Develops and maintains scripts using Python, Bash, or similar languages to automate security assessments, vulnerability tracking, evidence collection, and reporting. Can troubleshoot automation and integrate tools through APIs. jobs.title: Mobile Engineer
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote \- United States \& Canada **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Engineering Small businesses represent 99\.9% of all companies, yet they're still forced to choose between clunky, outdated enterprise phone systems or their personal phones. This multi\-billion dollar market has been overlooked for decades, left to cobble together solutions that slow them down instead of helping them grow. Quo is changing that. We bring calls, texts, and customer information together into one easy\-to\-use, AI\-powered platform. We're not just building a phone system. We're setting a new standard for how businesses connect with their customers. Driven by our values, we move fast, build with determination, and obsess over delivering value to the businesses that have been underserved for far too long. Today, Quo is trusted by more than 120,000 companies and rated \#1 in customer satisfaction on G2\. We're backed by Y Combinator, Tiger Global, Craft Ventures, Slow Ventures, and other top\-tier investors. It's safe to say we're onto something big. ### **About the role** We're growing Quo's mobile engineering team as we invest seriously in mobile for the first time in years. You'll join an established, close\-knit team of mobile engineers shipping our iOS and Android apps, reporting into our mobile Engineering Manager. Mobile is becoming a first\-class surface at Quo: we're moving the team closer to our core phone workstream (the calling experience itself — low latency, high call quality, no dropped connections) and making sure mobile keeps pace as we ship new AI, revenue management, and task management features across the product. This isn't a platform\-architecture role — the big technical direction decisions for mobile are already staffed and largely mapped out for the next 6\-12 months. This is a hands\-on, feature\-delivery role: shipping real product improvements, working across shared Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) modules and native iOS/Android code, and partnering closely with product, design, and backend teams. Some of the things you'll do: * Feature Development: Shipping new features and improving existing functionality across iOS and Android to keep mobile at or near parity with our web and desktop experience. * Shared Module Work: Building and adapting shared Kotlin Multiplatform modules so they integrate smoothly and feel native on both iOS and Android. * Cross\-Platform Collaboration: Partnering with the rest of the mobile team (iOS and Android engineers) and our Mobile Foundations platform team to extend and integrate shared functionality. * Reliability \& Quality: Helping raise the bar on our core phone experience on mobile — call quality, reliability, and performance are a real differentiator for Quo. * Cross\-functional Delivery: Working closely with PMs, designers, and backend teams to ship customer\-facing work, often jumping into an existing workstream and building context quickly. Technical stack and tools: * Android is built in Kotlin, adapted to support Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) following clean architecture principles * iOS development is primarily in Swift with SwiftUI for new features, UIKit where necessary * Shared KMP modules include Apollo GraphQL, Ktor networking, OpenTelemetry, and feature\-specific modules (conversations, contacts, alerts, etc.) * Persistence layers today are Room (Android/KMP) and Realm (iOS) — how these reconcile long\-term is an active discussion, not yet locked * Dependency injection via kotlin\-inject; testing with JUnit, Mockk, Turbine, and Maestro for cross\-platform E2E * Collaboration tools: Linear, Slack, Notion, Figma ### **About you** * High agency and ownership. Our mobile team is small (currently 3 product\-focused engineers, growing significantly) and fully distributed across time zones. You're comfortable operating with fewer frameworks and more ambiguity than you'd find at a larger organization, and you go solve problems rather than waiting to be told to. * Strong communicator. You collaborate well cross\-functionally with PMs, designers, backend engineers, and other mobile engineers, and you're comfortable working async across time zones. * Solid mobile engineering fundamentals, whether that's native iOS (Swift/SwiftUI), native Android (Kotlin), or cross\-platform via KMP. * Low ego, direct communicator, ready to jump into a problem space, build context fast, and coordinate with the team as you go. * Comfortable with, or genuinely curious about, using AI tools to work faster and better. Nice to have: * Direct production experience with Kotlin Multiplatform * Experience with GraphQL (Apollo Client) and modern async/networking patterns (Ktor) * Familiarity with mobile observability/telemetry (e.g., OpenTelemetry) * Experience with E2E testing (Maestro) and modern build tooling (Gradle, KSP) * Experience with feature flags and gradual rollouts * Knowledge of mobile performance optimization and memory management ### **Compensation** The annual base salary range for this position is as follow, plus equity and benefits: * SF Bay Area, Los Angeles, Seattle, Portland, Boston, New York, and Washington, DC Metro: $170,000 \- $200,000 USD * All other US Locations: $153,000 \- $180,000 USD * Canada: $156,100 \- $183,600 CAD The ranges displayed reflect the target for new hire salaries, and within each range, individual pay is determined by your skills and experience, as well as relevant education. Your recruiter can share more and answer questions about the specific salary range during the hiring process. Salary is just one component of Quo's total compensation package. Your total rewards package will include equity, extensive medical coverage, a monthly lifestyle stipend, and a flexible PTO policy. **Who we are** ============== We're a remote\-first company with a culture of trust, autonomy, and action. As we rapidly grow, we're intentionally building communities in a handful of hub cities while continuing to hire great talent wherever they happen to live. If you're looking for a place to do your best work, we'd love to hear from you. And remember, there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. We're looking for optimists with grit and determination, who are excited to face the challenges of a growing startup. Quo is the type of company where you can grow, and we encourage you to apply for this role even if you don't think you meet all the requirements. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse work environment. It is important that you are able to bring your authentic self to work every day. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. \#LI\-Remote \#PostLI

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Full time \| Remote\-friendly, NYC and New Orleans \| Reports to the CTO** **What is Rima** ================ Rima's mission is to improve population health by giving people technology to make navigating their employer sponsored health plans easy. We see a world where it is possible to reduce the economic burden on employees and employers without sacrificing quality of care. This is both a moral imperative and a business opportunity. Rima is building an agentic navigation platform for self insured health plans to tackle the root cause underlying rising healthcare costs. We are empowering the individuals on which the entire system depends. We’re a small, fast\-moving team based in NYC and New Orleans. We are all in. **The Role** ============ We're looking for a senior engineer to join the Platform team. Platform owns the core of Rima: the member experience, member management, the agent harness, the channels members reach it through, and the infrastructure underneath it all. A parent texts our agent at 9pm. Their son has a fever and the pediatrician is closed. Where should they go tonight, and what will it cost? Guiding them well depends on his coverage as a dependent, the family's deductible, and which urgent care and telehealth options their plan includes. It has to come together in seconds, from protected health data, and be right every time. That's the problem the Platform team exists to solve. At a larger company, each system you'll own would have its own team. Here it's yours: the architecture, the trade\-offs, and the results. You'll know these systems better than anyone and help decide where they go next. **Minimum qualifications** ========================== * You've built production software for 4\+ years, or built more in less time. We are impressed by results, not years and logos. * You've shipped complex, user\-facing systems end to end that you designed, from data model to API to UI. * You understand software design deeply. You model domains carefully, draw clean boundaries, plan for how things fail, and change systems without breaking what depends on them. * You've spent at least a year shipping production code mainly through coding agents, and you've built the tooling that keeps their output correct: rules, skills, tests, and evals. * You've built on regulated or sensitive data, with access control, audit trails, and least privilege designed in from the start. * You're an expert in TypeScript. * You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and you can take a trade\-off from discussion to decision with an engineer, a designer, or a customer. **Nice to have** ================ Bonus if you've: * Built LLM\-powered product features: agent tool design, context engineering, evals, guardrails, and trace interpretation. * Worked on multi\-tenant SaaS: tenancy, white\-labeling, and SSO (OIDC, SAML). * Used durable execution or workflow engines, such as Temporal, or built event\-driven systems. * Shipped across web, iOS, Android, browser extensions, and internal admin tooling. * Worked in healthcare, benefits, insurance, or payroll, including FHIR, EDI, or HL7\. * Built or maintained HIPAA\- or SOC 2\-compliant systems. **What you'll do** ================== **Member experience and member management** ------------------------------------------- * Build the features members expect from their health plan: insurance cards, claims, accumulators, dependents, and provider search. * Model benefits and entitlements precisely enough that a member reading the app and an agent answering a question reach the same correct answer. * Build member and company management for admins: onboarding, benefits configuration, and usage analytics. * Build internal admin tooling so our team can configure and support customers without an engineer. * Ship across web, iOS, Android, and our browser extension. * Work out requirements and trade\-offs with product and design before build. Talk to members and admins to see how the product actually gets used. **Agents and channels** ----------------------- * Build the features and data the member agent depends on, such as agent tools, entitlement data, and plan data, so it answers from what each member actually has. You'll work closely with the engineers who build the agent harness. * Build the channels the agent reaches members through, including web, mobile, SMS, Slack, Teams, and MCP clients, so it behaves the same in each one. * Add evals and tracing to the features you ship, so we know an answer is wrong before a member does. **Platform infrastructure and observability** --------------------------------------------- * Own parts of our AWS infrastructure, CI/CD, and the pipeline from dev to production. * Strengthen observability: structured logs, metrics, traces, alerting, and incident response. * Treat security as architecture: PII minimization, envelope encryption with key rotation, least\-privilege access, purpose\-of\-use audit trails, and break\-glass workflows. **Developer tooling and practice** ---------------------------------- * Improve our developer tooling, including agent rules and skills, linting, CLI, and automated tests, so every engineer and agent ships faster and more safely. * Make good practice the default. When you find a better way to build, turn it into a rule, skill, or check so the whole team and every agent picks it up. * Bring consequential trade\-offs to the team early, with a recommendation. * Lead incident response for the systems you own. Our stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Vite, Hono, PostgreSQL, Temporal, Capacitor (web, iOS, Android), AWS with Terraform, Sentry, and Amplitude. **What success looks like in your first 90 days** ================================================= * You own two or three platform systems. You know them better than anyone and are the first call when something goes wrong. * You've shipped at least one member\-facing feature end to end, from requirements through production monitoring. * You've closed one gap in observability, CI, or our developer tooling that makes the whole team faster. **How we work** =============== * **Love and excellence.** We strive to win at the highest level and hold an extremely high bar, without losing the humanity that makes us who we are. * **High ownership.** You own problems end to end. No hand\-offs, no "not my problem." * **Crisp communication.** We say what we mean, raise problems early, and keep decisions easy to find. * **Fast iteration.** We ship in small batches, learn from members, and improve quickly. * **Results over process.** We care about what ships and how well it works, not how many meetings you attended. **Why work at Rima** ==================== * **Hard problems.** Health plans are complex, the data is regulated, and agents are capable, but new. You'll work where all three meet. * **Early in a category being reinvented.** Benefits navigation is being rebuilt around agents that reach members wherever they are. We're early, and you'll help shape what it becomes. * **Push agentic development forward.** We treat building software with agents as a system to engineer, and you'll help design it. * **Real impact, fast.** Our agents serve tens of thousands of members, and what you ship reaches them in days. * **Close to users.** You'll hear directly from the members and admins using what you built, not through layers of tickets. * **A team that pushes the tools.** Everyone here builds at the edge of what agents can do and shares what works. * **Competitive comp and benefits.** Base salary range $125,000\-$175,000, plus an equity package, flexible PTO, health insurance, dental, vision and more. Compensation Range: $125K \- $175K

You model domains carefully, draw clean boundaries, plan for how things fail, and change systems without breaking what depends on them. * You've spent at least a year shipping production code mainly through coding agents, and you've built the tooling that keeps their output correct: rules, skills, tests, and evals. * You've built on regulated or sensitive data, with access control, audit trails, and least privilege designed in from the start. * You're an expert in TypeScript. * You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and you can take a trade\-off from discussion to decision with an engineer, a designer, or a customer. **Nice to have** ================ **Bonus if you've:** -------------------- * Built LLM\-powered product features: agent tool design, context engineering, evals, guardrails, and trace interpretation. * Worked on multi\-tenant SaaS: tenancy, white\-labeling, and SSO (OIDC, SAML). * Used durable execution or workflow engines, such as Temporal, or built event\-driven systems. * Shipped across web, iOS, Android, browser extensions, and internal admin tooling. * Worked in healthcare, benefits, insurance, or payroll, including FHIR, EDI, or HL7\. * Built or maintained HIPAA\- or SOC 2\-compliant systems. **What you'll do** ================== **Member experience and member management** ------------------------------------------- * Build the features members expect from their health plan: insurance cards, claims, accumulators, dependents, and provider search. * Model benefits and entitlements precisely enough that a member reading the app and an agent answering a question reach the same correct answer. * Build member and company management for admins: onboarding, benefits configuration, and usage analytics. * Build internal admin tooling so our team can configure and support customers without an engineer. * Ship across web, iOS, Android, and our browser extension. * Work out requirements and trade\-offs with product and design before build. Talk to members and admins to see how the product actually gets used. **Agents and channels** ----------------------- * Build the features and data the member agent depends on, such as agent tools, entitlement data, and plan data, so it answers from what each member actually has. You'll work closely with the engineers who build the agent harness. * Build the channels the agent reaches members through, including web, mobile, SMS, Slack, Teams, and MCP clients, so it behaves the same in each one. * Add evals and tracing to the features you ship, so we know an answer is wrong before a member does. **Platform infrastructure and observability** --------------------------------------------- * Own parts of our AWS infrastructure, CI/CD, and the pipeline from dev to production. * Strengthen observability: structured logs, metrics, traces, alerting, and incident response. * Treat security as architecture: PII minimization, envelope encryption with key rotation, least\-privilege access, purpose\-of\-use audit trails, and break\-glass workflows. **Developer tooling and practice** ---------------------------------- * Improve our developer tooling, including agent rules and skills, linting, CLI, and automated tests, so every engineer and agent ships faster and more safely. * Make good practice the default. When you find a better way to build, turn it into a rule, skill, or check so the whole team and every agent picks it up. * Bring consequential trade\-offs to the team early, with a recommendation. * Lead incident response for the systems you own. Our stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Vite, Hono, PostgreSQL, Temporal, Capacitor (web, iOS, Android), AWS with Terraform, Sentry, and Amplitude. **What success looks like in your first 90 days** ================================================= * You own two or three platform systems. You know them better than anyone and are the first call when something goes wrong. * You've shipped at least one member\-facing feature end to end, from requirements through production monitoring. * You've closed one gap in observability, CI, or our developer tooling that makes the whole team faster. **How we work** =============== * **Love and excellence.** We strive to win at the highest level and hold an extremely high bar, without losing the humanity that makes us who we are. * **High ownership.** You own problems end to end. No hand\-offs, no "not my problem." * **Crisp communication.** We say what we mean, raise problems early, and keep decisions easy to find. * **Fast iteration.** We ship in small batches, learn from members, and improve quickly. * **Results over process.** We care about what ships and how well it works, not how many meetings you attended. **Why work at Rima** ==================== * **Hard problems.** Health plans are complex, the data is regulated, and agents are capable, but new. You'll work where all three meet. * **Early in a category being reinvented.** Benefits navigation is being rebuilt around agents that reach members wherever they are. We're early, and you'll help shape what it becomes. * **Push agentic development forward.** We treat building software with agents as a system to engineer, and you'll help design it. * **Real impact, fast.** Our agents serve tens of thousands of members, and what you ship reaches them in days. * **Close to users.** You'll hear directly from the members and admins using what you built, not through layers of tickets. * **A team that pushes the tools.** Everyone here builds at the edge of what agents can do and shares what works. * **Competitive comp and benefits.** Base salary range $175,000\-$200,000, plus an equity package, flexible PTO, health insurance, dental, vision and more. Compensation Range: $175K \- $200K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** **Team:** RamseyTrusted, Protections Please note that applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. **Location:** Franklin, TN—on\-site, relocation assistance available, flexible schedules available **Salary:** $95,400\-$150,000/year\* \+ profit sharing \+ benefits * Range depends on skill level and overall experience. **A Little Bit About Us:** You might know us from our founder and CEO, Dave Ramsey, who’s given no\-nonsense money advice on the radio since 1992\. Three decades later, Ramsey Solutions is a household name in personal finance, with a mission to change the toxic money culture for good. **Our Mission: Ramsey Solutions provides biblically based, commonsense education and empowerment that give HOPE to everyone in every walk of life.** **Here’s a Taste of Our Benefits:** * Health insurance (includes plans eligible for an HSA—with a company match up to $500!) * 401(k) retirement plan with 4% match/company contribution * Annual wellness, counseling and grocery membership reimbursement * On\-campus cafe with subsidized pricing for breakfast, lunch and coffee bar * Dependent care FSA * Tons of cultural activities, like weekly devotional, leadership development courses, Battle of the Bands, and one epic Christmas party! **Where and How You’d Work:** Ramsey Solutions Headquarters is located just outside of Nashville in Franklin, Tennessee. We value our strong, unified company culture because we believe the best work is done together. That’s why all of our team members work on\-site under the same roof. But work\-life balance is also important to us, so we offer flexible work schedules to take the stress out of appointments, family obligations and other needs that may pop up. While every team member has a designated workspace (with an electronic sit\-stand desk), our campus was designed to house a variety of unique work and play zones (e.g., quiet library space, coffee bar/lounge areas, recreational game zone, and outside/patio work and break areas). **What You’d Do in This Role:** We’re seeking a technically exceptional, mission\-driven Senior Software Engineer to lead the technology behind one of our teams for RamseyTrusted Protections, building secure, scalable digital product that help millions of people confidently protect what matters most. From insurance to identity theft protection and other trusted solutions, you'll play a key role in creating experiences that connect customers with products that bring peace of mind and move them closer to financial freedom. This is a role for a proven engineer who loves building. You'll partner with product, design, and business leaders to solve complex technical challenges, modernize critical platforms, and deliver seamless customer experiences that drive meaningful business outcomes. You'll spend time in the code and mentor engineers to grow their craft while fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We're looking for a builder who leads with credibility, thrives in ambiguity, and brings positive, solutions\-oriented mindset to every challenge. If you're energized by solving meaningful technical problems, and using technology to help people, this may be for you. **You’re Probably a Match If:** * You have progressed through hands\-on software engineering roles, developing strong technical depth, and earning influence through demonstrated engineering excellence. * You operate at a Senior Developer level or higher, with a track record of delivering complex, production\-grade systems. * You bring full\-stack development experience, with strength in either backend or frontend and working knowledge across the stack. * You leverage AI\-powered development tools, including Claude Code, to accelerate development, improve code quality, and solve complex technical challenges. * You take ownership of major technical initiatives from discovery through delivery and ongoing support, using AI to improve efficiency without compromising engineering standards. * You effectively partner across the business, translating business needs into high\-impact technical solutions. * You balance hands\-on technical contribution, communication on technical decisions clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **What Winning Looks Like:** * Mentor and develop engineers, fostering a high\-trust, high\-performance culture. * Drive alignment between engineering strategy and company objectives, ensuring technical investments support long\-term business outcomes. * Partner with Product, Design, and Business leaders to shape roadmaps, define priorities, and deliver measurable results. * Establish and evolve technical standards within Java and Kotlin, and engineering best practices to ensure scalability, resilience, and long\-term system health. * Oversee delivery execution, improving flow, predictability, and quality while removing systemic impediments. * Proactively identify risks and tradeoffs at the portfolio level, ensuring transparency and strong cross\-functional alignment. **Other Stuff to Know:** We’re looking for people who are passionate about our mission. This isn’t just a J\-O\-B. We experience resistance every day because what we believe is absolutely countercultural. We actually hate debt. We actually cut up our credit cards . . . like, for real. Some of us are still fighting our way out of debt, but we aren’t going back. If you don’t know much about Ramsey Solutions and our founder, Dave Ramsey, we encourage you to download the Ramsey Network mobile app and consume our content. **If Ramsey Solutions sounds like a workplace where you can get excited about Mondays, apply today. We can’t wait to hear from you!** **EOE, including disability/vets** **\#LI\-onsite** We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Backend - Platform Team
jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. **About the Platform Team** --------------------------- The Platform Engineering team is the invisible engine that powers all of Rippling's integrated products—HR, IT, and Finance. Our mission is to build the core infrastructure, tools, and shared services that allow every other engineering team to ship highly reliable, secure, and globally scalable features with maximum velocity. We manage the foundational components that ensure Rippling's single, unified platform operates efficiently and securely. **Our Scope:** Foundational Systems for 1,000\+ Engineers Operating as a critical scaled team, we own and operate a variety of mission\-critical systems that directly support close to 1,000 engineers building products and internal platforms across Rippling. We deliver the most foundational shared systems inside the Platform organization. **What you will do** * Design, implement, and test reliable backend services and APIs that power core product features and business logic at scale. * Work across key technical domains, including API design, data modeling, event modeling, and optimizing service performance. * Own the development lifecycle for defined features, from implementation and testing to deployment, monitoring, and support in a production environment. * Effectively integrate into cross\-functional teams, contribute to technical discovery, and rapidly learn from code and system feedback. **What you will need** ---------------------- * 2\+ years of professional experience as a backend engineer, preferably with Python, Go, or a similar production language, and strong experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL). * Care about business impact, balancing technical craft with speed and the bottom line to deliver value quickly. * Ability to thrive in fast\-paced, dynamic environments, demonstrating resilience and agility in the face of changing product needs. * Excellent skills in communicating complex technical ideas with clarity to enable effective collaboration with peers and stakeholders. **Additional Information** -------------------------- Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role. This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here. *The final compensation offered to a successful candidate will depend on several factors, including but not limited to, location, experience, education, training, and business need. This position may also be eligible for bonuses, commissions, and/or equity, subject to applicable plan documents and company policy. Successful candidates hired for this role may also be eligible to participate in the company's benefits programs, which may include, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, retirement benefits, and/or paid time off, as determined by company policy.* **The pay range for this role is:** 152,000 \- 225,000 USD per year(US Tier 1\)

jobs.title: Principal Security Software Engineer - Identity Access Management (IAM)
jobs.description: San Mateo, CA, United StatesEngineeringID: 47707 Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. As a Principal Security Software Engineer on the Production IAM team, you will set the technical direction for how identity and access work across Roblox's production infrastructure, from the mTLS\-based identity that services use to authenticate to one another, to the privileged access controls that govern how engineers reach production. The team is accountable for Roblox's machine and workload identity platform, its centralized authorization engine, its production access management platform, production PKI and certificate lifecycle, and just\-in\-time privileged access for engineers. As an individual contributor in Production IAM, you will define multi\-year strategy, drive alignment across Roblox Platform, mentor senior and staff engineers, and personally build the hardest parts of these systems. As AI agents become first\-class actors in production, you will also help pioneer how they get identity, prove who they are, and receive safely\-scoped access. **You will** ------------ * **Lead the architecture for production identity and access.** Define and evolve the end\-to\-end design for machine, workload, human, and AI\-agent identity across our hybrid on\-prem and cloud fleet, making secure access invisible when it can be and intuitive when it needs attention. * **Drive mTLS and workload identity to full production enforcement.** Lead the technical strategy for our SPIFFE/SPIRE\-based identity platform, service\-mesh integration, managed service accounts, and certificate issuance, storage, and rotation. * **Advance just\-in\-time, least\-privilege access for engineers.** Architect just\-in\-time, least\-privilege, and break\-glass access to production, replacing static, long\-lived credentials with short\-lived, auditable access that stays reliable even during dependency or identity\-provider outages. * **Evolve the centralized authorization engine and a secure golden path.** Mature our centralized authorization engine and the access\-control models behind it (RBAC/ABAC and risk\-based access) so decisions are consistent, fine\-grained, and testable. * **Pioneer identity and access for AI agents.** Define how agents obtain credentials, receive scoped permissions, and have their sessions managed across their lifecycle, setting the patterns for agentic identity at Roblox.. * **Lead across the org and raise the bar.** Author RFCs and multi\-year roadmaps, align stakeholders across Roblox Platform, mentor senior and staff engineers, and raise the technical bar through design review, on\-call ownership, and hiring. **You have** ------------ * 8\+ years of relevant professional experience building scalable, distributed backend systems, with a track record of driving architecture end to end. * Deep expertise in identity and access management — authentication, authorization, and access\-control models such as RBAC, ABAC, or risk\-based access control. * Hands\-on experience with several of: PKI and certificate/key lifecycle management, mTLS, SPIFFE/SPIRE or comparable workload\-identity systems, service mesh, secret management (e.g., Vault), and privileged access management (PAM). * Proficiency in at least one systems language such as Go, Rust, Java, C\+\+, Python, or C\# .NET, and a habit of building systems rather than only configuring vendor tools. * Experience leading the technical work of other multi\-agent workflows (e.g., planner / verifier) that turn heterogeneous seller data into verified data\-mapping plans and published listings, with humans in control of high\-risk decisions. * Build workflow automation — from requirements and data\-source changes through rollout, stakeholder onboarding, and ongoing maintenance. * Serve as a technical point of contact for SHEIN Open Platform partners (API support, UAT, acceptance, and coordination with SHEIN engineering in China), and work directly with U.S. Marketplace stakeholders and pilot sellers to prioritize features, run demos, and drive adoption from internal tool to seller\-facing product. **Job Requirements** * Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field — or equivalent practical agentic systems on LLMs — multi\-step tool use, structured output, multi\-agent orchestration, and designing around non\-deterministic behavior; ability to build eval datasets from real business data, separate training and blind holdout sets, and catch regressions when models, prompts, or data change. design structured, repeatable AI\-assisted development workflows. * Ability to turn ambiguous business needs and messy real\-world data into reliable solutions, and to explain model behavior and limitations clearly to non\-engineering stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Recursive Self\-Improvement (RSI) for AI agents — building closed loops in which an agent's own jobs.title: Staff AI/ML Engineer, Edge Intelligence (Perception)
jobs.description: Job Description Help shape the future of physical AI in defense by building perception models for unmanned autonomous systems across aerial, maritime, land, and space domains. We’re looking for a deeply technical engineer who can turn emerging research into reliable autonomous capabilities and shares our conviction that AI can protect service members and civilians. As a Staff Engineer on the Model Development team within Applied AI, you’ll drive the design, training, adaptation, and evaluation of multimodal deep\-learning and foundation models for unmanned platforms. You’ll take hands\-on ownership of models that help autonomous systems understand their surroundings, recognize unfamiliar objects, and interpret scenes over time. Your work will account for limited compute, real\-time latency, noisy sensors, and changing environments, with rigorous evaluation of how perception performance affects downstream reasoning and autonomy. You’ll partner closely with teams in reasoning, MLOps, large\-scale simulation, autonomy, and inference to deliver capabilities as part of Hivemind Enterprise. What you’ll do * Design, implement, train, adapt, and evaluate perception models, with an emphasis on vision and multimodal foundation models for autonomous platforms. * Make and validate tradeoffs among vision foundation models, vision\-language models (VLMs), specialized deep\-learning models, and traditional computer vision methods. * Develop capabilities for detection, segmentation, tracking, and spatial and temporal scene understanding, including representations that support downstream reasoning and autonomy. * Build reproducible training and adaptation workflows using self\-supervised learning, supervised fine\-tuning, transfer learning, and distillation as appropriate. * Define data requirements, curation and annotation strategies, training objectives, and evaluation datasets that support meaningful comparisons across models and operating conditions. * Establish rigorous evaluations with real and simulated sensor data, measuring missed detections, false alarms, localization accuracy, temporal consistency, uncertainty, and generalization. * Incorporate latency, memory, compute, and power constraints into model architecture and training decisions in partnership with hardware, autonomy, and inference teams. * Diagnose model failures across environments and sensor conditions; use data mining, targeted curation, and training experiments to close performance gaps. * Deliver trained models, reproducible experiments, and clear performance evidence to partner teams, including documented limitations and interfaces for downstream use. * Set technical direction for perception model development, mentor engineers, and communicate experimental findings and tradeoffs to research, engineering, product, and organizational leadership. Required Qualifications * BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, and/or similar degree, or equivalent practical experience. Typically requires a minimum of 7 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or 4 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience. * Demonstrated track record of developing and deploying perception models in production, with substantial hands\-on contributions to model design, training, and evaluation. jobs.description: Akura Medical, a Shifamed portfolio company, is advancing a differentiated platform for the treatment of venous thromboembolism (VTE), which affects up to 900,000 Americans each year. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About SimpliSafe** We're a high\-tech home security company that's passionate about protecting the life you've built and our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. And we've created a culture here that cares just as deeply about the career you're building. Ours is a no ego culture of collaboration and innovation where those seeking their next challenge can find big opportunities and make a huge impact on the lives of all those who we protect. We don't just want you to work here. We want you to grow and thrive here. We're embracing a hybrid work model that enables our teams to split their time between office and home. Hybrid for us means we expect our teams to come together in our state\-of\-the\-art office on two core days, typically Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday – working together in person and choosing where they work for the remainder of the week. We all benefit from flexibility and get to use the best of both worlds to get our work done. **Why are we hiring?** Well, we're growing and thriving. So, we need smart, talented, and humble people who share our values to join us as we disrupt the home security space and relentlessly pursue our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. **About the role** You'll build and maintain internal tools and platform(s) for our Customer Support Engineering (CSE) team. The role calls for solid full\-stack design and deployment experience, plus the acumen to use AI\-driven development to supercharge both the implementation and the ongoing maintenance of what you ship. The role will require a self\-driven, lean approach to developing critical tooling for the team(s) to aid in discovering and investigating customer impactful issues with our products. In the future this role may also expand into identifying and proposing fixes as well in an effort to further reduce cost\-to\-fix for core engineering teams. **What you'll do** * **Expand and maintain existing tools.** Own the suite of internal tools used by CSE (and collaborating teams). * **Create the right tools to solve the problem.** Shadow CSE and iLab team members, recognize pain points, and choose the right solutions (agent, tool, automation, data change, or nothing) to enhance the discovery and investigation of customer friction with our products. * **Drive a new agentic platform from vision to production.** One form this role could take is to create and own a new platform that moves us from custom tools to purpose\-built agents. Shape the vision and business case, then design and build its core services: an agent controller backed by a persistent case store, an LLM gateway with policy and auditing, a knowledge service, and a capabilities service. * **Build the agents.** Implement the purpose\-built agents that run on the platform, and review AI\-generated code for correctness and security. * **Own the data and keep it all running.** Build pipelines and tune queries across Loki, Athena, Amplitude, S3, Databricks and Amazon Connect, add evaluation, observability and audit trails, and keep AI context current. **What you bring** We don't expect you to tick every box below. We're looking for enough coverage to be effective quickly, and the drive to level up in the areas where you're less experienced. * 5\+ years of software engineering, including full\-stack apps and backend services shipped to real users (auth, deployment, monitoring). * Experience taking an ambiguous idea to production: shaping the vision, making the business case, and carrying it through implementation and operations. * Experience designing APIs and services that other engineers build on: clear contracts, permissions, observability. * Hands\-on experience building with LLMs and AI coding assistants (tool use, prompting, evaluation), and the discipline to test, review and secure what they produce. * Solid fundamentals in data querying and manipulation: strong SQL, and comfort investigating logs and event data and reshaping it across sources such as Loki, Athena, Amplitude, S3, Databricks and Amazon Connect. * An understanding of what makes queries fast and cheap on different kinds of sources (for example partitioning, columnar formats, label and time\-range filters), and how to measure the improvement. * Good judgment on when to build, reuse or say no. **Nice to have:** building and maintaining data pipelines and tables (incremental loads, backfills, data quality checks, alerting), agent or workflow orchestration (including MCP), policy and audit systems, support or contact\-center workflows, Airflow, dbt or Databricks Workflows, and handling customer data under access controls. **What Values You'll Share** * Customer Obsessed \- Building deep empathy for our customers, putting them at the core of our work, and developing strong, long\-term relationships with them. * Aim High \- Always challenging ourselves and others to raise the bar. * No Ego \- Maintaining a "no job too small" attitude, and an open, inclusive and humble style. * One Team \- Taking a highly collaborative approach to achieving success. * Lift As We Climb \- Investing in developing others and helping others around us succeed. * Lean \& Nimble \- Working with agility and efficiency to experiment in an often ambiguous environment. **What We Offer** * A mission\- and values\-driven culture and a safe, inclusive environment where you can build, grow and thrive * A comprehensive total rewards package that supports your wellness and provides security for SimpliSafers and their families *(For more information on our total rewards please* *click here**)* * Free SimpliSafe system and professional monitoring for your home. * Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that bring people together, give opportunities to network, mentor and develop, and advocate for change. The target annual base pay range for this role is $146,600 to $195,500 This target annual base pay range represents our good\-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role. We use a market\-based compensation approach to set our target annual base pay ranges and make adjustments annually. We carefully tailor individual compensation packages, including base pay, taking into consideration employees' job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and other relevant business factors. Beyond base pay, we offer a Total Rewards package that may include participation in our annual bonus program, equity, and other forms of compensation, in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and lifestyle benefits. More details can be found here. We're committed to fair and equitable pay practices, as well as pay transparency. We regularly review our programs to ensure they remain competitive and aligned with our values. *We wholeheartedly embrace and actively seek applications from all individuals, no matter how they identify. We are committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we believe our work is enriched when we incorporate a multitude of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We want everyone who works here to thrive and contribute to not only our mission of keeping every home secure, but also to making our workplace safe and supportive for others. If a reasonable accommodation may be needed to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of a position, or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact* *careers@simplisafe.com**.*

jobs.title: Staff Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Description** We’re SmartThings, one of the leading IoT ecosystems in the world, creating the most effortless way for anyone to create a smart home. We're a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung with corporate offices in Minneapolis and the Bay Area. More than 430 million people worldwide use SmartThings to control and manage their connected life. SmartThings delivers simple, powerful experiences across Samsung’s leading portfolio of phones, TVs, and appliances. We also offer the most versatile smart home experience as an open platform with a rich partner ecosystem (think IKEA, SONOS, Honeywell, and so many more). As a founding member of Matter, we are a leader in the industry to help make smart homes more secure, reliable and seamless to use. Come be a part of the leading edge of IoT innovation! **About The Team:** The Hub Platform team owns foundational software, infrastructure, and operational practices that power SmartThings hubs in the field, and we're building the architecture that lets us support future hub platforms as they come online. The SmartThings Hub acts as a secure edge gateway that translates and bridges local, cross\-protocol IoT devices to the SmartThings cloud, enabling centralized routing and execution across a unified ecosystem. We work across three pillars:* Hub Systems \& Architecture: the embedded Linux OS, secure boot chain, firmware rollout process, and hardware platform abstraction * Hub to Cloud Connections \& Attestation: secure hub\-to\-cloud connectivity, device claim, and attestation so every hub in the field is uniquely identified and trusted * Hub Developer Operations: the CI/build infrastructure that keeps the entire hub engineering org shipping reliably and the tooling that keeps engineers developing efficiently Our work sits at the intersection of embedded firmware and cloud services, and it directly determines the stability, security, and update reliability that millions of connected homes rely on every day. **About The Role:** We're looking for a **Staff Embedded Software Engineer** to be a technical owner and leader for the Hub Platform team. You'll help drive long\-term technical strategies for our core domains. You'll operate with autonomy to bring clarity to complex, cross\-functional challenges. You’ll act as a go\-to expert and point of contact for major initiatives, and partner closely with firmware, security, cloud, and product teams to shape how SmartThings hubs evolve. You'll also mentor engineers across the team, including senior engineers, and help guide how the team adopts AI\-assisted development and operational practices. This role is **hybrid, 3 days/week in our Minneapolis Office** (on iconic St Anthony Main across from Downtown...with paid attached parking!). The pay range for this role is **$139,000 to $198,000,** with an annual bonus target of 20%.### **Key Responsibilities** This position is a hybrid role, based onsite 3 days a week at our office in Minneapolis, MN. In this role, your primary responsibilities will include the following:* **Technical Strategy Ownership:** Define and drive long\-term technical vision for one or more Hub Platform team domains so that our solutions scale to support future hub platforms. * **Lead Complex Initiatives:** Act as a technical owner for large, complex, cross\-functional projects, architecting scalable solutions for evolving domain needs. * **Architect for Reliability \& Security:** Guide architecture and design decisions for systems like the firmware update pipeline, hub OS platform abstraction, B2B partner integrations, or hub\-to\-cloud connectivity, with stability, security, and operational excellence as first\-class concerns. * **AI Practices \& Vision Collaboration:** Help define how the team uses AI\-assisted development and operational tooling, evaluating where AI can meaningfully improve velocity and quality, and set a forward\-looking vision for responsible AI adoption in the organization. * **Cross\-Functional Partnership:** Collaborate with firmware, security, cloud infrastructure, and product management to keep technical direction aligned with product requirements and business needs. * **Mentor \& Elevate the Team:** Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers at every level, including senior engineers, and help build engineering practices that raise the bar across the org. * **Operational Excellence \& On\-Call:** Participate in observability, incident response, and on\-call rotations supporting the production firmware delivery, hub connectivity, and attestation services that the global hub fleet depends on. ### **Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise** **What You Bring On Day One (Required Qualifications)*** Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field * 8\+ years of production software engineering experience, with a demonstrated track record operating at a Staff\-level technical leadership capacity * Strong knowledge of embedded Linux systems and boot chain validation, including kernel/system\-level security, secure boot, and firmware signing * Strong knowledge of device security fundamentals: mTLS/PKI, attestation, secure provisioning, and trusted execution environments (e.g. TrustZone/OP\-TEE) * Strong experience designing and operating distributed, cloud\-based backend systems (AWS) that support firmware delivery, device connectivity, or IoT fleets at scale * Strong knowledge of AI development tools and practices * Experience with software virtualization and packaging (Docker or similar containerization tools) for building, testing, and deploying services * Proven ability to lead architecture and design reviews, set technical direction across teams, and bring about simple solutions to complex problems * Strong track record of cross\-functional collaboration with firmware, security, product, and partner engineering teams * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience translating technical strategy for both technical and non\-technical audiences **Desired Skills*** Proficiency in Rust * Experience with IoT fleet management: device provisioning, monitoring, and lifecycle management at scale * Experience with IoT connectivity protocols and standards (Matter, Thread, MQTT) * Experience with CI/CD infrastructure and build systems supporting embedded firmware (e.g. GitHub Actions runners, reproducible build pipelines) * Experience supporting partner ecosystem programs (e.g. OEM/partner integration models) ### **SmartThings Benefits** * We offer an attractive compensation package with comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and mental health; an HSA with employer contribution; life \& disability insurance; FSAs for health and dependent care expenses; a competitive 401k with a 5% employer match, and more. * All of our employees enjoy unlimited PTO, 12 paid holidays, and a generous parental leave policy (8 weeks fully paid parental leave and 8 more fully paid weeks for childbirth recovery leave). * Eligible employees benefit from our education reimbursement program, and all employees enjoy access to learning resources through O’Reilly. * Our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging is embedded into our culture and our work, and everyone has frequent opportunities to join forums and groups and participate in ongoing projects. * We offer a parking stipend to cover the monthly garage cost. EV chargers are also onsite. * In\-office catered lunches on Thursdays. * Access to the onsite gym. Base compensation range for this position is $139,000 to $198,000 annually. Actual base within this range will depend on many factors including experience, skills, technical expertise and market alignment. In addition, this role is eligible for a 20% annual target bonus based heavily on individual performance. At SmartThings, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible environment for all. If you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process or to perform the requirements of the job, we will work with you to meet your needs in compliance with applicable laws. Please reach out to talent@smartthings.com and a member of our Talent Acquisition team will connect with you further!### **About SmartThings** **Creating a safer, smarter world with you.** SmartThings brings your home to life by being the leading open platform for the consumer Internet of Things. Bringing together developers, device makers, and service providers to make the world a smarter place. From a door that knows when to lock itself, to a living room that can get the party started or a sink that can help to call a plumber; the opportunities are endless to make everyday objects around us more useful. So if you’re innovative, not afraid to challenge status quo, collaborative and have a passion for technology, then you’ve found your next home with SmartThings!

Preferred Experience: * Experience with Smile CDR or HAPI FHIR . * Knowledge of US Core, FHIR IGs, and healthcare terminologies (LOINC, SNOMED CT, RxNorm, ValueSets). * Exposure to HL7 v2, CDA, or legacy FHIR integrations. * Familiarity with CMS interoperability mandates (Patient Access, P2P, Provider Access, PA). * Experience authoring FHIR Implementation Guides or using Inferno for testing. * Familiarity with AWS/Azure cloud environments and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform). **Some of the benefits we offer:*** Remote Work Environment * Flexible Time Away From Work Policy including PTO, Personal and Sick Days * Competitive Salary and Health/Medical Benefits * RRSP/TFSA/401K Employee Contribution * Life and Disability * Employee Assistance Program * FHIR Study Program and Skillsoft Learning * Super HAPI Fun Club Smile's core values include respect, inclusion, embracing our differences, and celebrating shared values because our people are the foundation of our success.
