jobs.title: Business Systems Engineer – People Systems & AI Automation
jobs.description: ### **Who is Sonar?** Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. ### **Position description** The Business Technology team is composed of passionate technologists who are fully engaged in delivering the best products that help teams deliver their best work. We are focused on reducing friction and getting the most value from solutions to enhance outcomes, and we are building an AI\-first approach to how Sonar runs its internal operations. This role sits at the intersection of People operations, enterprise integration, and AI\-driven automation. You will be the technical owner of Sonar’s People technology stack: our new global HR information system (HRIS), our recruiting and applicant tracking platform, time and attendance, performance and compensation tools, and the HR service desk in Jira Service Management. You will connect these systems to identity management, IT, finance, and our data warehouse, so that employee data is accurate, secure, and available wherever it is needed. AI is a core part of the job. You will design and build AI assistants, agents, and automations that answer employee and manager questions, triage HR requests, support recruiters, and remove manual work across the employee lifecycle, always with the right controls for sensitive data. As Sonar grows, your scope will extend to further business applications in the BizTech portfolio. Your success will give Sonar one trusted employee record, a seamless experience from candidate to new hire to alumni, and People teams who spend their time on people rather than on systems. ### **What you will do** You are confident in owning and evolving business applications for a fast\-growing, multi\-site, and multi\-national organization. You combine hands\-on platform administration with strong integration and data skills, and you treat AI as a practical tool to make systems smarter and processes lighter. As such, you bring proven, multi\-year experience in: * Own the administration, configuration, and security of our HRIS and related People tools, including roles, permissions, workflows, custom fields, and release management. * Lead the implementation and phased rollout of our new HRIS together with the People team (Core HR, Time \& Attendance, Performance, Compensation, and more), from requirements and design through testing, go\-live, and hypercare. * Lead data migration from legacy HR and time\-off systems, including field mapping, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation. * Own the technical side of our recruiting platform: job requisition and approval workflows, offer processes, candidate data retention, and integrations with the HRIS so a hired candidate becomes an employee record without manual re\-entry. * Design and run the HR service desk in Jira Service Management: request types, queues, SLAs, approvals, automation rules, and a knowledge base, so employees get fast, consistent answers and HR requests are tracked end to end. * Automate joiner\-mover\-leaver processes end to end, from offer accepted through onboarding tickets, account provisioning, role changes, and offboarding, in partnership with IT Operations and Workplace teams. * Design, build, and maintain integrations between People systems and identity management, IT service management, ERP, payroll, travel and expense, and the data warehouse, using APIs, webhooks, SCIM, and native connectors. * Own the employee data model and make the HRIS the trusted source of truth for attributes such as department, cost center, manager, location, and title. * Build AI assistants and agents for People processes, for example answering policy and benefits questions from the knowledge base, triaging and routing HR tickets, summarizing cases, and drafting job descriptions or interview materials for recruiters. * Connect AI tools (such as Claude, Rovo, or Glean) to People systems through MCP and enterprise connectors, using least\-privilege access, clear governance, and testing in sandbox before production. * Identify automation opportunities across the employee lifecycle, prototype quickly, and turn w integration * Hands\-on experience configuring Jira Service Management or a similar service desk tool (e.g. ServiceNow HRSD, Zendesk) for HR or IT: request types, queues, SLAs, automation, and knowledge base * Strong experience building integrations with REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON, using middleware or iPaaS tools (e.g. Workato, Make, or AWS Lambda); scripting in Python or JavaScript is a plus * Hands\-on experience building with AI: LLM assistants, agents, MCP, prompt\-based workflows, or AI features in enterprise tools (e.g. Claude, Rovo, Glean). You have shipped something real, not just experimented * Understanding of responsible AI use with personal data: access controls, data minimization, human review, and avoiding bias in recruiting and HR decisions * Solid data skills: data modeling, migration, reporting, and SQL; experience feeding a data warehouse is a plus * Good understanding of HR processes across the employee lifecycle: recruiting, onboarding, Core HR, time off, performance, compensation, and offboarding * Experience with SSO and automated user provisioning (SCIM) to an identity provider (e.g. JumpCloud, Okta, or Microsoft Entra ID) * Experience handling sensitive employee data under GDPR and supporting ITGC or external audits * A plus: HRIS or Atlassian certifications (e.g. ACP\-620 Jira Service Management), ITIL Foundation, or payroll integration experience (e.g. ADP) * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field * Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and problem\-solving abilities. * Effective communication and interpersonal skills * Highly autonomous and pragmatic * Open\-minded and very positive can\-do attitude * Prefer to work in a team, share information, and ideas and understand the power of collective thinking to get the best solutions * Comfortable in dealing with change and complexity * Self\-confident enough to challenge the status quo as well as to receive and give feedback to improve the team and yourself * Leadership: Taking the initiative and demonstrating your ability to lead a subject from beginning to end Valuing “done” over “perfect” * ### **In\-office culture** We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person. ### **We value diversity, equity, and inclusion** At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com. All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Junior Software Development Engineer, Web
jobs.description: At Sonos we want to create the ultimate listening experience for our customers and know that it starts by listening to each other. As part of the Sonos team, you’ll collaborate with people of all styles, skill sets, and backgrounds to realize our vision while fostering a community where everyone feels included and empowered to do the best work of their lives. This position is considered hybrid, allowing for a combination of remote work and in\-office collaboration. Qualified applicants must live within commuting distance of our Boston or Seattle office locations and should expect to be in office 3 days per week. As a Software Development Engineer on the Web team, you will help deliver the interfaces that power the core Sonos experience on play.sonos.com and a growing portfolio of web applications serving different segments of the Sonos customer base. Your work will directly shape how listeners around the world interact with Sonos products through the browser, contributing to a seamless, high\-quality experience across the web platform. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Build and maintain front\-end features and components for play.sonos.com and other Sonos web applications, working across the full web application stack from UI to data layer. * Develop software that adapts the Sonos experience to different user roles and personas, ensuring interfaces are intuitive and relevant for each audience segment. * Instrument code to provide visibility into usage patterns, application health, and performance in production environments. * Partner with cross\-functional teams to understand requirements, integrate with existing systems, and deliver high\-value features. * Write reliable, extensible, and maintainable code that meets quality and performance standards. * Participate in code reviews, contributing to team standards and shared codebase quality. * Contribute to technical discussions and help evaluate tradeoffs in approach, tooling, and implementation. * Stay current with advances in web development frameworks and tooling, and bring relevant improvements back to the team. **What You'll Need** -------------------- ### **Basic Qualifications** * 0\-2 years of professional software development experience. * Proficiency in modern JavaScript frameworks, HTML, CSS, and standard web application development tools. * Demonstrated experience shipping reliable, extensible, and maintainable web applications. * Degree in computer science, computer engineering, a related engineering discipline, or equivalent professional experience. * Qualified applicants must be able to work from a Sonos office 3 days per week. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with modern declarative JavaScript frameworks such as React, Angular, and/or Vue. * Experience with strong typing via TypeScript or Flow. * Familiarity with front\-end performance monitoring and observability tooling. * Strong focus on the end\-user experience and a track record of building with the customer in mind. * Comfort working across multiple problem spaces and picking up new technologies as needed. Inclusion: Research shows that some candidates may not apply for roles if they don't meet all the criteria. If you don't have 100% of the skills listed, we still strongly encourage you to apply if interested. Visa Sponsorship: Sonos is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role at this time. We ask that applicants be authorized to work for us in the country of role posting, both now and in the future. \#LI\-Hybrid Your profile will be reviewed and you'll hear from us once we have an update. At Sonos we take the time to hire right and appreciate your patience. The base pay range for this role based off geographic location is: $93,000 and $115,900 The specific pay offered will depend on the candidate’s geographic location, as well as qualifications and experience. We apply geographic pay differentials based on the cost of labor in the market. Employees in high\-cost locations may be compensated at the upper end of the range, while those in medium or low cost markets may be compensated at the lower end of the range. Your recruiter can provide more details about the specific salary range for your location during the hiring process. Please note that compensation details listed in US job postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits. We also offer a comprehensive benefits program with choice and flexibility in mind to help support the health, wealth, and overall well\-being of our employees. Regular full time employees in the US are eligible for benefits on day one, including: * Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * A 401(k) plan with company matching and immediate vesting * An Open Time Off policy (OTO) so you have maximum opportunity to disconnect and recharge, with no tenure\-based vacation accruals required * 80 hours of sick time upon hire, refreshed annually * Up to 12 paid holidays per calendar year * Sonos offers a generous paid leave program for new parents or to care for a family member with a serious health condition, as well as short\- and long\-term disability for your own medical condition * Company\-paid Disability, Life, and AD\&D Insurance * Voluntary benefits, including Voluntary Life, AD\&D, Accident, and Pet Insurance * Mental health benefits to support your holistic well\-being * A generous employee discount program \& Sonos Radio HD \- on us! Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law. Notice to U.S. Job Applicants: Sonos is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please send an e\-mail to accommodations@sonos.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, X Chat
jobs.description: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. #### **PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER, X CHAT** We're building X Chat into a secure, real\-time collaboration platform (channels, threads, DMs, presence, search, and integrations) used by hundreds of millions of people. A core requirement is end\-to\-end encryption with multi\-device support, forward secrecy, and strong performance at scale. You'll own the messaging systems that deliver low\-latency encrypted chat while integrating calling and live media, and you'll ship privacy\-preserving AI features without compromising E2EE. #### **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Lead implementation of core chat features (channels, threads, DMs, presence, search, notifications, media/file sharing) * Implement and operationalize end\-to\-end encryption for messaging (key exchange, multi\-device support, performance) * Own delivery of backend services and cross\-platform clients (iOS, Android, web) * Integrate calling and live media experiences from the Voice \& Media stack into chat * Ship privacy\-preserving AI features (summaries, translation, etc.) that respect E2EE * Drive reliability, latency, and operational metrics for assigned workstreams #### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:** * 6\+ years building distributed systems or large\-scale product features * Experience with real\-time messaging or encrypted communication systems #### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * Hands\-on E2EE messaging implementation * Experience shipping features in Slack\-like or similar collaboration products * Strong backend (Rust/Go/C\+\+) and/or mobile client skills * Prior technical leadership of workstreams or small teams **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:** $240,000 \- $350,000 USD Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short \& long\-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks. *SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

jobs.title: Project Manager I, II, III - Civil Engineer
jobs.description: **Discover Your Future with Opportunity Central!** **Job Description Summary:** Are you seeking a meaningful career where your technical expertise directly improves community infrastructure and supports responsible development across St. Louis County? This role offers the opportunity to protect public safety, ensure high quality engineering standards, and contribute to sustainable growth throughout the region. **Job Description:** As a Project Manager in Civil Plan Review, you will play a key role in upholding St. Louis County’s mission of delivering equitable, accessible, and accountable services to residents. Ideal candidates are detail‑oriented problem solvers who enjoy collaborative work, communicating with diverse stakeholders, and applying engineering principles to real‑world challenges. **Starting Salary:** Project Manager I: $61,193 – $73,424 annually Project Manager II: $65,790 – $78,956 annually Project Manager III: $70,720 – $84,864 annually **Why You Should Consider a Career in Civil Plan Review:** **Impactful Work:** Ensure the safety, functionality, and compliance of infrastructure improvements that affect thousands of residents. **Community Contribution:** Support responsible growth by reviewing plans for subdivisions, commercial developments, public projects, and utility work. **Professional Development:** Gain broad experience in engineering review, permitting, floodplain analysis, and multi‑agency coordination. **Varied Experience:** Work on a wide range of project types—from site development to utility installations—creating a dynamic and engaging environment. **Team Environment:** Collaborate with engineers, planners, inspectors, developers, and community partners committed to high‑quality public service. **Comprehensive Benefits:** St. Louis County provides a robust benefits package including affordable medical, dental, and vision insurance; generous PTO beginning in the first year; 11 paid holidays; and a deferred benefit retirement plan. Employees may also qualify for Public Service Loan Forgiveness. **Key Responsibilities:** * Review engineering plans for work in County rights‑of‑way and for land disturbance to ensure compliance with engineering specifications, codes, and standards. * Evaluate dedications, quantities, estimates, calculations, and specifications for accuracy and compliance with regulations. * Review floodplain development studies. * Coordinate with the public, consultants, developers, applicants, inspection staff, and internal departments to resolve design and permitting issues. * Conduct research and maintain accurate records. * Prepare reports and documentation of work. * Perform site visits during plan review and construction phases. * Provide assistance and information to the general public and various agencies. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Minimum Qualifications:** **Project Manager I:** Candidates should possess one of the following: * College Senior status in a Bachelor's Degree program in Civil Engineering or Architecture. Degree must be from an accredited college or university and conferred on or before the agreed‑upon start date; if these parameters are not satisfied, any contingent offer of employment will be rescinded. OR * Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering or a related Engineering field from an ABET‑accredited school. Progression to Project Manager II will occur upon obtaining qualifications for the level II position. **Project Manager II:** Candidates should possess a Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering field and should have passed the Fundamentals of Engineering Exam (FE) and be registered as an Engineering Intern with the Missouri Board of Engineers, Architects and Land Surveyors. Progression to Project Manager III will occur upon obtaining qualifications for the level III position. **Project Manager III:** Candidates should possess a Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering field and be a Registered Professional Engineer by the Missouri Board of Engineers, Architects and Land Surveyors; or be a Registered Professional Architect by the Missouri Board of Engineers, Architects and Land Surveyors, and have five years of practical experience. **Pre\-Employment Process Requirements:** Applicants will be evaluated based on relevant education, experience, responses to supplemental questions, and other work\-related information provided on the application. Status updates are provided via email and can be found within each candidate’s Workday profile. Responses that qualified candidates provide to the application questions will count as 100% of their final evaluation score. A candidate must earn a qualifying grade of 70 or more on the interview to be eligible for appointment. The five highest\-ranking candidates will be referred to the Department Director/Appointing Authority for final selection. **Pre\-Employment Screening:** Candidates extended a conditional offer must successfully complete all required pre‑employment screenings. These screenings include a drug test administered at no cost to the candidate by a certified laboratory and a background check evaluating the recency and relevance of the candidate’s history to the position. Candidates must complete the drug test within 48 hours of receiving a conditional offer; failure to do so may result in withdrawal of the offer. **At St. Louis County, we're not just about jobs, we're about opportunity.** **Equal Opportunity Employer:** **St. Louis County is committed to fair and equitable employment opportunities for all, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, veteran status, or political affiliation.** **St. Louis County is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.description: **Description** --------------- The Office of Secretary of State (OSOS) offers some of the most unique and diverse job opportunities in state government. Its critical responsibilities include: ensuring a fair and accurate elections process; connecting Washingtonians through the power of libraries; protecting our important government records; and registering corporations and charities. The Secretary of State also administers vital community programs that inspire giving, document our history, and assist crime survivors in avoiding further abuse. This independent office under the state Constitution operates from facilities in the Olympia area and statewide. The OSOS is looking for top\-performing employees who embody its core values of integrity, service excellence, visionary leadership, collaboration and teamwork. It is committed to both employee growth and work\-life balance. The benefits of working in state government also include potential eligibility for the federal Public Service Loan Forgiveness program. Visit our website at: www.sos.wa.gov. The Division of Information Technology (IT) ensures that all technology systems within OSOS business programs run smoothly, securely, and efficiently. We are the strategic partner in driving business goals, improving operational efficiency, and safeguarding critical data and systems. IT is deeply involved in ensuring the seamless flow of information, providing scalability and innovation, handling everything from hardware, software and tools to complex systems delivering valuable customer experience. **IT Application Development \- Entry** **Permanent, Full\-Time** The Application and Data Management program is responsible to provide core IT application and data management maintenance and support, while striving for continuous modernization and innovation of existing systems supported within OSOS IT in partnership with Business. This position reports to the Corporation and Charities Filing System (CCFS) Application Developer Senior Supervisor. **Duties** ---------- **Software Development for IT applications** **Tasks include:** * Writes Angular, C\#, Structured Query Language (SQL) (stored procedures, views, functions, and table definitions), JavaScript, SSRS Reports, VBScript, ASP.Net, Python. PowerShell and other language(s) programming code. * Employs industry standard application development tools to develop, code, test and implement changes related to the applications or the enhancement of these mission critical business systems. * Uses Microsoft Visual Studio, Visual Studio Code, and other appropriate integrated development environments to develop, unit test, analyze, debug, and optimize application and database code. * Uses design patterns such as but not limited to dependency injection, repository\-service, and redux to ensure application code can be tested and remains adaptable to future business needs and technological advances. * Implements easy to consume and understand RESTful services following REST principles. * Remains current and up to date on web technologies including but not limited to the latest Angular version and reactive forms, typescript, CSS/CSS extensions, and ASP.NET. * Employs basic understanding of web services internal and external to assist with enhancements and maintenance both on the service and DB. * Understands basic handling of code in Azure DevOps (ADO), GIT to track tasks, check\-in changes and checkout code. * Participates in unit and interface testing of the application with direction from the development team. * Uses experience and knowledge of the system to resolve system defects, escalating issues to senior developers when necessary. * Consults with stakeholders to determine business requirements, design and create models and modules for application. Uses knowledge of basic database design to construct simple prototypes and to determine hardware requirements. * Provides backup support to other application developers in their absence. **Develops and documents automated testing frameworks, tools, and processes** **Tasks include:** * Creates and maintains automation test code and framework to cover all layers of application components such as database, API and user interface. * Creates / refines internal testing processes for automated tests on applications and documents them. **Actively participates in application development sprint cycles** **Tasks include:** * Participate in Agile practices such as sprint planning, grooming, scrum, retrospectives and other meetings to support the sprint cycle. * Uses ADO to track work assignments. Provides adequate documentation on assigned user stories, tasks, and other metrics. * Provides feedback for areas for improvement and proposing actionable steps for the next sprint * Works directly with users in gathering and analyzing requirements. * Creates technical documentation, such as system diagrams, code comments or change logs, for system changes, planning and other needs. * Researches,  esting. * Experience with agile development and CI/CD Pipelines. At the Office of the Secretary of State, we are dedicated to building a diverse and authentic work force with a foundation of belonging. If you are excited about this role and have relevant experience and skills, but question whether your experience aligns perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply regardless. You may just be the ideal candidate this office needs. **Supplemental Information** ---------------------------- **Working Conditions** The role necessitates working in an office environment were sitting for long periods of time and extensive use of the keyboard is required. Standard office hours Monday – Friday, 8am – 5pm though work can be required outside of standard hours to include evenings, weekends, and holidays, particularly when emergency situations arise. The role includes the physical ability to handle objects weighing up to 50 lbs, with or without reasonable accommodation. Additionally, regular travel to local offices is required. **Remote work is allowed per office policy, however,** **occasional** **travel to local offices is required. The office has the right to revoke the remote only designation at discretion.** **Special Requirements** * **Prior to a new hire, a background check including criminal record history will be conducted.** Information from the background check will not necessarily preclude employment but will be considered in determining the applicant’s suitability and competence to perform in the position. * Must have current Washington state driver's license or have requested and obtained an appropriate accommodation. * **This position is in a bargaining unit represented by the Washington Federation of State Employees (WFSE) and is subject to the terms of the Collective Bargaining Agreement between the State of Washington, The Office of the Secretary of State, and the WFSE.** **How to Apply:** * To be considered for this position you must attach the following: + **Letter of interest** describing how your experience and qualifications relate to the duties and qualifications of the position. + **Current Resume** * **Three Professional references.** Personal references will not be considered. * You must complete the supplemental questions at the end of this application. Incomplete responses such as "see resume" will not be considered. * All veterans must include a copy of your DD214 to receive preference in the hiring process. You must redact your social security number before attaching it to your application. * Candidates who are offered a job with OSOS must possess work authorization that does not require sponsorship by the employer for a visa now or in the future. * *OSOS complies with the employment eligibility verification requirements of the federal government eligibility verification I\-9 form. jobs.title: FDE
jobs.description: **Forward Deployed Engineer (Founding) \| Healthcare AI** ========================================================= **Location:** New York City **Employment:** Full\-time **Working Model:** Hybrid (3 days/week in office) **Compensation:** $150,000–$275,000 \+ Equity **Overview** ------------ We’re a venture\-backed healthcare AI company building advanced agents that operate in the real world to solve one of the most painful problems in provider operations: **getting paid accurately and on time.** Healthcare revenue is often lost to fragmented data, manual workflows, and complex payer systems that don’t talk to each other, creating financial stress for practices and, ultimately, patients. We take a field\-first approach. Before writing software, we worked alongside practices to understand how revenue actually moves through their systems. Now we’re scaling our engineering team to deploy agent\-powered workflows that drive measurable outcomes. **About the Role** ------------------ We’re hiring one of our first **Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs)** to build out this function. You’ll sit between our largest customers and our product team, embedding with healthcare practices to understand workflows, translate real\-world requirements into robust agent behavior, and ship production\-grade integrations and tooling. This is an engineering role with a commercial edge. You’ll write code, run working sessions with customer teams, and help turn successful account\-specific solutions into reusable product capabilities. As an early FDE, you’ll help define how deployments work end\-to\-end, including what gets standardized, what stays bespoke, and how we measure success. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Own customer deployments end\-to\-end, from post\-signature onboarding to a live, measurable outcome. * Integrate customer data sources into our platform, including APIs, data pipelines, exports, and messy real\-world systems. * Configure and refine agent workflows based on payer rules, operational reality, and performance feedback. * Build account\-specific solutions quickly, including agent logic, analyses, automations, dashboards, and internal tooling, then partner with engineering to generalize what works into the core platform. * Lead working sessions with customer revenue cycle and operations teams to map workflows, identify leakage, and translate that into scoped implementation plans. * Create and improve SOPs with internal domain specialists to continuously improve agent behavior. * Partner with the account team on renewals and expansion by communicating outcomes, insights, and technical trade\-offs clearly. * Act as the voice of the customer internally, turning field learnings into clear problem statements, specifications, and roadmap input. * Help build the FDE function, including playbooks, reusable patterns, success metrics, and, over time, team growth. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * **3\+ years of professional experience** in software engineering, AI engineering, data engineering, solutions engineering, or similar. * Strong execution across backend systems, APIs, data pipelines, and practical integration work. * **AI\-native mindset:** Hands\-on experience with LLMs and agents, including translating business rules into agent logic and debugging failures when outputs are wrong. * **Fluency in Python and SQL.** * Comfort working directly with customers, running technical workshops, scoping work to outcomes, and communicating trade\-offs. * High ownership and comfort in ambiguity. You can turn one customer conversation into a plan and a working prototype. * Low ego, growth mindset, and enthusiasm for shaping culture and operating cadence as an early team member. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (or related field) or equivalent practical experience. **Bonus Points** ---------------- * Founder or early\-stage startup engineering experience. * Familiarity with healthcare data, revenue cycle management, or payer workflows (not required, but you’ll need to ramp quickly). * Experience doing the unglamorous data work that makes messy inputs usable. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- * **Competitive base salary:** $150,000–$275,000 depending on experience, plus meaningful equity. * Comprehensive healthcare benefits. * Unlimited PTO, with a minimum expectation of 10 days off per year. * Professional development support, including courses and books. * Team off\-sites and events.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: **Product Manager, AI Platform \| Healthcare AI** ================================================= **Location:** San Francisco, California **Employment:** Full\-time **Working Model:** Hybrid (3 days per week on site) **Compensation:** $160,000–$220,000 \+ Equity **Department:** Product **About the Company** --------------------- Our client is a fast\-growing healthcare AI company building a platform that frees home health clinicians from administrative paperwork, allowing them to focus on delivering life\-changing care to elderly patients in their homes. Backed by leading healthcare investors, including **SignalFire**, the company has already powered millions of patient visits and deployed its technology to thousands of clinicians across the US. The company is continuing to scale its AI platform, with a focus on improving clinical workflows, reducing administrative burden, and helping healthcare providers spend more time with patients. **About the Role** ------------------ Our client is looking for a **Product Manager, AI Platform** to take ownership of product discovery, direction, and delivery. The company’s AI platform sits at the centre of how clinicians and administrative teams document care. Product decisions directly impact how much time healthcare professionals spend on paperwork versus delivering patient care. This is a hands\-on product role requiring close collaboration with clinicians, healthcare operators, and engineering teams to identify meaningful problems and deliver solutions that drive measurable operational improvements. As an early product hire, you’ll have significant ownership over product direction and the opportunity to help shape how the product function operates as the company scales. The role offers: * **Product Ownership:** Take responsibility for identifying problems, defining priorities, and delivering impactful solutions. * **Customer Exposure:** Work directly with clinicians and healthcare operators to understand real\-world workflows. * **Technical Collaboration:** Partner closely with engineers to build and improve AI\-powered products. * **Strategic Influence:** Help shape product direction, development processes, and future platform capabilities. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Customer Discovery:** Work directly with clinicians and healthcare leaders to understand their workflows, challenges, and operational needs. * **Own Product Direction:** Identify high\-impact problems, translate customer requirements into clear product specifications, and define success metrics. * **Partner with Engineering:** Collaborate closely with engineers to build and ship high\-quality solutions, remaining involved from initial specification through to launch. * **Work Cross\-Functionally:** Partner with sales, customer success, and operations teams to validate priorities and ensure products deliver value in real\-world environments. * **Drive Product Outcomes:** Define and monitor success metrics, analyse product usage, and continuously improve solutions based on customer feedback. * **Shape Product Processes:** Contribute to how product discovery, prioritisation, and development operate as the company grows. **What They’re Looking For** ---------------------------- * **3\+ years of product management experience**, ideally within an early\-stage or high\-growth startup. * **Strong Technical Background:** Experience in engineering, computer science, or working closely with technical teams, with the ability to engage in meaningful discussions around AI/ML systems. * **First\-Principles Thinking:** Ability to break complex problems down and develop solutions rather than relying on existing approaches. * **Strong Customer Instincts:** Comfortable spending significant time with customers, understanding their workflows, and using feedback to inform product decisions. * Experience owning **workflow\-heavy or operational products** where attention to detail is critical. * Ability to make informed trade\-offs with incomplete information and move quickly without sacrificing quality. * **Clear Communication:** Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to align stakeholders and write effective product specifications. * High ownership mentality and comfort operating independently in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments. * **Mission\-Driven Mindset:** Genuine interest in healthcare and building technology that improves the lives of clinicians and patients. **Why Join?** ------------- * **Proven Product Adoption:** The platform has already supported millions of patient visits and thousands of clinicians. * **Strong Investor Backing:** Supported by leading healthcare technology investors, including SignalFire. * **Early Product Ownership:** Join as an early product hire with meaningful influence over product direction and strategy. * **AI Innovation:** Work closely with engineering teams developing AI\-powered solutions for complex healthcare workflows. * **Direct Customer Impact:** Build products that reduce administrative workloads and give clinicians more time to care for patients. * **Career Growth:** Significant opportunity to grow alongside the business and help shape the future product organisation. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- * **Base Salary:** $160,000–$220,000, depending on experience. * **Equity:** Meaningful ownership in a growing healthcare AI company. * **Healthcare:** Platinum health, dental, and vision insurance. * **Paid Time Off:** Unlimited PTO. * **Retirement:** 401(k) plan. * **Career Development:** Significant growth opportunities as an early product hire. * **Working Environment:** On\-site collaboration with product and engineering teams in San Francisco.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Software Engineer (Backend) Location: New York City, NY (Hybrid — 3 days/week in office) Employment Type: Full\-time Compensation: $150,000–$275,000 base \+ equity About the company We build AI agents that help healthcare providers get paid for the care they deliver by reducing the operational and financial complexity behind claims and reimbursement. Our team works on automating fragmented workflows and data\-heavy processes so healthcare organizations can operate more efficiently and predictably. We’re in a high\-growth phase and expanding the engineering team. About the role We’re looking for a talented and ambitious Software Engineer with 4\+ years of backend experience to build the internal engines and systems that help us scale. As we grow, every new customer adds claims volume, users, and operational complexity. jobs.description: Sunnyvale, California, United States **Date posted** 11/24/2026 ### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19435****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **11/24/2026** ### **We Are**Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. ### **You Are** You have spent over a decade building firmware and digital logic that lives at the edge of what is physically possible, where nanoseconds matter and a single design decision ripples through an entire SoC. SerDes is not just another IP block to you. It is the critical path, the bottleneck, the thing that either enables 100G connectivity or becomes the reason a chip does not ship. You have debugged enough silicon to know that the best designs are the ones that anticipate failure modes three layers deep, and you build with that in mind. You are equally comfortable architecting a new PHY feature, writing the Verilog that implements it, and sitting in a customer lab at 11pm tracing down why their bring\-up is failing. Leadership for you is not about titles. It is about being the person who sees the problem no one else has named yet, who asks the question that changes the design review, and who can translate between what the analog team needs and what the verification team can actually test. You do not wait for perfect specs. You work with what you have, fill the gaps with smart questions, and move the design forward while keeping everyone aligned. ### **What You'll Be Doing** * Architect, design, implement, and verify complex firmware components for next\-generation PAM\-based SerDes PHY IP used in high\-performance SoCs * Define microarchitecture that translates system\-level SerDes requirements into implementable, testable digital logic and firmware flows * Debug and resolve complex integration, simulation, and post\-silicon issues across digital, analog, and mixed\-signal boundaries * Enhance and extend existing SerDes PHY IP to support multiple protocols, data rates, and customer\-specific requirements * Provide technical leadership and hands\-on mentorship to engineers across digital design, verification, and physical implementation teams * Collaborate directly with Application Engineering and customer\-facing teams to solve complex technical issues during customer integration and silicon bring\-up * Travel to customer sites as needed to support silicon bring\-up, debug production issues, and ensure successful productization of SerDes IP in customer chips ### **The Impact You Will Have** * Enable next\-generation high\-speed connectivity in AI accelerators, data center chips, and advanced computing platforms through robust SerDes IP * Reduce customer time\-to\-market by delivering PHY IP that works correctly the first time in silicon, with fewer respins and faster bring\-up cycles * Influence the technical direction of Synopsys SerDes roadmap through architectural decisions that balance performance, power, area, and manufacturability * Elevate the technical capability of the engineering team through mentorship, design reviews, and establishing best practices that scale across projects * Solve problems that directly affect whether a customer's chip meets their performance targets, which in turn affects product launches worth hundreds of millions of dollars * Strengthen customer relationships by being the technical expert who shows up when things are hard and helps get chips into production * Contribute to IP reuse and design efficiency improvements that compound across multiple product generations and customer engagements. ### **What You'll Need** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or closely related field, with at least 12 years of direct industry experience in firmware or ASIC design * Significant hands\-on experience with structured firmware development, testing, and documentation in production environments * Strong foundation in digital logic design, systems architecture, and RTL implementation * Proven experience with Verilog simulation and debug using VCS, Verdi, or equivalent industry\-standard tools * Solid understanding of DSP concepts, SerDes architectures, clock and data recovery, and high\-speed signaling fundamentals * Experience with high\-speed SerDes or PHY architecture and design is a strong plus * Familiarity with PAM\-based signaling, equalization, or DSP implementation in SerDes contexts is highly valued * Background in mixed\-signal integration, silicon bring\-up, or post\-silicon validation is a differentiator * Scripting ability in Python, Tcl, Perl, or Shell to automate workflows and improve productivity is beneficial. ### **Who You Are** * You take full ownership of complex designs from initial architecture through silicon validation, and you do not hand off problems you can solve yourself * You can walk into a room with digital, analog, verification, and physical design engineers, understand each perspective, and drive the group toward a decision that works for the whole chip. * When a customer's silicon is not behaving as expected, you are the engineer who can look at waveforms, schematics, and firmware logs simultaneously and find the root cause others missed. * You provide technical mentorship that actually changes how engineers think, not just what they know, because you take the time to explain the why behind design decisions * You are comfortable making technical tradeoffs under uncertainty, and you can articulate those tradeoffs clearly to both junior engineers and senior leadership * You treat travel to customer sites as part of the job, not an inconvenience, because you understand that real learning happens when you see how your IP behaves in someone else's system. ### **The Team You'll Be Part Of** You will join the Interface PHY team at Synopsys, a multidisciplinary group developing leading\-edge PAM\-based SerDes technologies. The team brings together digital, analog, mixed\-signal, verification, and physical design expertise to deliver advanced Silicon IP that powers the next generation of high\-performance SoCs. You will work closely with engineers across these disciplines, as well as with Application Engineering and customer\-facing teams who rely on your technical depth to solve complex integration and bring\-up challenges. ### **Rewards and Benefits** We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. jobs.description: **Location:** San Antonio, TX **Regular/Temporary:** Regular **Job ID:** 16895 **Full/Part Time:** Full Time **Position Information** ------------------------ **Assistant/Associate/Full Professor** The Department of Computer Engineering in the College of AI, Cyber and Computing at The University of Texas at San Antonio invites applications for four open\-rank (Assistant, Associate, or Full Professor) tenured or tenure\-track faculty positions beginning Fall 2027\. **The University of Texas at San Antonio** (UT San Antonio) is a nationally recognized, top\-tier public research university that unites the power of higher education, biomedical discovery and healthcare within one visionary institution. As the third\-largest research university in Texas and a Carnegie R1\-designated institution, UT San Antonio is a model of access and excellence — advancing knowledge, social mobility and public health across South Texas and beyond. UT San Antonio serves approximately 42,000 students in 320 academic programs spanning science, engineering, medicine, health, liberal arts, AI, cybersecurity, business, education and more. With 17,000 faculty and staff, UT San Antonio has also been recognized as a Top Employer in Texas by Forbes Magazine. Learn more online, on UT San Antonio Today or on X, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube or LinkedIn. **College of AI, Cyber and Computing** Established in September 2025, the College of AI, Cyber and Computing unites the Departments of Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems and Cybersecurity, and Statistics and Data Science. The college serves more than 5,400 students and is located in the San Pedro I and San Pedro II buildings in downtown San Antonio. It provides a collaborative environment for interdisciplinary research and education in artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, computing, and data science. Learn more at https://caicc.utsa.edu. **Department of Computer Engineering** Established in September 2025, the Department of Computer Engineering is in a period of substantial growth. It currently has an inaugural cohort of nine tenured and tenure\-track faculty and serves approximately 400 students. The department offers an ABET\-accredited B.S. in Computer Engineering, M.S. programs in Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence, and a Ph.D. in Computer Engineering. Faculty are nationally recognized leaders whose distinctions include the NSF CAREER Award, the AFOSR Young Investigator Program (YIP) Award, the University of Texas Regents' Outstanding Teaching Award, election as Fellow of the National Academy of Inventors, appointment to the Texas Quantum Initiative Advisory Committee, and selection to the World Economic Forum Global Future Council on Next\-Generation Computing, to name a few. Several hold endowed chairs and direct major research centers, including the MATRIX AI Consortium and the Open Cloud Institute, while maintaining strong collaborations with other UT San Antonio centers such as the National Security Collaboration Center, the Institute for Cyber Security, and the Center for Infrastructure Assurance and Security. Research spans a broad range of computer engineering areas including AI/ML systems, computer architecture, low\-power VLSI design, neuromorphic computing, quantum engineering, communication systems, and cybersecurity. These efforts are supported by robust federal and industry funding. Faculty and students have access to state\-of\-the\-art research laboratories and high\-performance computing resources. **Salary Range:** Commensurate with education, experience, and qualifications. **Job Type:** Full Time **Position Summary** The Department of Computer Engineering seeks applications for four open\-rank tenured or tenure\-track faculty positions, with a preference for the rank of Assistant Professor. Exceptional candidates at the Associate or Full Professor ranks are strongly encouraged to apply. Successful candidates will develop and sustain high\-impact, externally funded research programs; contribute to teaching and mentoring at the undergraduate and graduate levels; and collaborate across the college and university. Candidates' research interests should align with one or more of the following four thrusts: * **Thrust 1 – Semiconductors and AI Hardware/Systems**: VLSI, advanced packaging, chiplets and heterogeneous integration; electronic design automation including AI\-assisted design and verification; chip design and computer architecture for AI acceleration; and AI/ML methods aware of or co\-designed with hardware and systems for efficient and scalable AI, including edge and embedded systems. * **Thrust 2 – Hardware Security and System Assurance**: Secure processor design, embedded security, trusted computing, IoT security, and cyber\-physical system security, securing systems from the silicon level upward. * **Thrust 3 – Intelligent Next\-Generation Networking**: Computer networks, wireless communications, IoT, and cloud infrastructure supporting 5G/6G, edge computing, smart manufacturing, autonomous vehicles, and distributed AI. * **Thrust 4 – Quantum Engineering**: Quantum information systems and algorithms, devices and architecture, sensing, computing, and communications and networking. The successful candidate will: * Develop and sustain an independent, high\-impact, externally funded research program aligned with one or more of the department's research thrusts. * Teach undergraduate and graduate courses in computer engineering and related areas. * Mentor and supervise graduate and undergraduate students in research activities. * Collaborate with faculty across the department, college, and university to advance interdisciplinary initiatives. * Contribute to department, college, and university service and governance. **Qualifications** * Ph.D. in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related field by the time of appointment. * Research accomplishments or potential appropriate to the rank of appointment, as demonstrated by scholarly publications, presentations, external funding, or related achievements. * Commitment to high\-quality teaching and mentoring of undergraduate and graduate students. * Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in an academic community. This position may require the ability to maintain the security and integrity of UT San Antonio and its infrastructure per Texas EO\-GA\-48\. **Application Process** To apply, applicants must upload the following: * A cover letter clearly identifying one or more of the research thrusts above and the preferred rank of appointment. * Current curriculum vitae. * Complete contact information for at least three professional references. * A research statement (5\-page limit). * A teaching statement (5\-page limit). For candidates at the level of Associate or Full Professor, tenure is contingent upon Board of Regents approval. Timeline: Review of applications will begin on January 5, 2027\. For full consideration, please apply by this date. Applications received after this date may be considered until the positions are filled or closed. Contact: Questions about the positions or the application process may be directed to Dr. Panagiotis Markopoulos at Panagiotis.Markopoulos@utsa.edu. At the discretion of the hiring department, this posting may close once a sufficient number of qualified applications have been received. This position will work primarily **on campus**. Travel and parking expenses are the employee's responsibility. This position is contingent upon a successful background check. Verification of a valid driver's license and Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) may be completed as applicable. Applicants selected must be able to show proof of eligibility to work in the United States by time of hire. **Equal Employment Opportunity** As an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer, it is the policy of The University of Texas at San Antonio to promote and ensure equal employment opportunity for all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or genetic information, and veteran status. Thomson Reuters complies with local laws that require upfront disclosure of the expected pay range for a position. The base compensation range varies across locations.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;Eligible office location(s) for this role include one or more of the following: New York City, San Francisco, Los Angeles, and/or Irvine, CA; McLean, VA; Washington, DC. The base compensation range for the role in any of those locations is $183,100 USD \- $340,000 USD.\&\#xa;For any eligible US locations, unless otherwise noted, the base compensation range for this role is $158,900 USD \- $295,100 USD.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;Base pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills and experience with consideration given to internal equity. Base pay is one part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs.\&\#xa;This role may also be eligible for an Annual Bonus based on a combination of enterprise and individual performance.\&\#xa; **About Us** Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. jobs.title: General Autonomy Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Thoro AI** Thoro AI builds autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) for different verticals, including commercial floor cleaning and pallet logistics, plus the cloud platform that manages them. Thoro AI is a small, senior engineering team shipping an end\-to\-end robotics product: a flexible autonomy stack that runs on the robot, a cloud portal that manages fleets, and the infrastructure that ties them together. Our robots map and navigate real warehouses and retail floors, coordinate pick and drop missions across a fleet, and report telemetry to the cloud over MQTT. You will work across the whole system, not one narrow slice of it. ### **The Role** We are looking for early\-career to mid\-level engineers who want to grow into strong autonomy generalists. You will work across localization, planning, perception, fleet behavior, and everything in between, learning the stack by shipping real fixes and features on robots that are already running on customer sites. You do not need to know every part of the stack on day one. We are looking for strong fundamentals, curiosity, and a habit of digging until you find out what is actually wrong. You will be paired with senior engineers, get real ownership quickly, and see your work running on real hardware. We are hiring for multiple openings. This role is based in Pittsburgh, PA. ### **What You Will Do** * Pick up autonomy problems across the stack, whether that is localization, motion planning, sensor fusion, point cloud processing, or fleet logic, and get productive on them with support from senior engineers. * Ship features and fixes in a production C\+\+ and Python codebase, with tests, so changes do not cause regressions on deployed robots. * Help debug field issues using logs, replay tools, and time with robots in our test facility and at customer sites. * Write unit and integration tests and help improve our test and simulation tooling. * Write short design notes for non\-trivial changes and take part in code reviews. * Work closely with hardware, cloud and fleet, and controls engineers, and explain what you found clearly to engineers and non\-engineers. ### **Must\-Haves** * B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 0 to 4 years of professional experience. Internships, research, and competition robotics count. * Solid programming skills in C\+\+ and/or Python. * Comfort developing and building code in Linux\-based environments. * Familiarity with version control (Git) and automated testing. * Foundations in at least one of: localization/SLAM, motion planning, perception, controls, or sensor fusion, through coursework, research, or projects. * A track record of working through unfamiliar problems and taking ownership of them. * Clear written and verbal communication. * Daily use of AI coding agents and automation, with good judgment about checking their output. Eager to help build a fully automated path from request to release. ### **Nice\-to\-Haves** * Hands\-on experience with ROS or ROS 2, or another publisher/subscriber framework. * Robotics projects that ran on real hardware: research, capstone, FIRST, or other competitions. * Exposure to point cloud processing, 3D reconstruction, or mapping. * Familiarity with fleet management protocols like VDA5050\. * Experience using AI agents to assist with daily development work. ### **What We Will Teach You** * Our message\-passing and pipeline framework, and the conventions of our autonomy stack. * How each part of the stack works, from mapping and localization through planning, perception, and fleet behavior. * The domain: how work zones, waypoints, missions, and action zones fit together, and how robots coordinate at a site. * Our field test and regression workflow, including log replay and virtual simulation. ### **How We Hire** We hire for fundamentals and judgment, not exact keyword matches. * We hire for potential. Coursework, research, internships, and competition robots all count as experience. * Experience with our exact framework or tools is not required. We will teach you the stack. * We value people who ask good questions, read other people's code, write clear notes, and keep digging until they find the real cause of a problem. ### **How We Work** Small team, senior engineers, short feedback loops. Every change goes through a PR with CI; non\-trivial work starts with a short design note. We keep durable notes alongside the code so the next person can pick up where you left off. Engineers talk directly to the people deploying robots and see their work running on real hardware. ### **Why You'll Like It Here** * Competitive salary \& equity packages * 401(k) retirement plan * Pre\-tax health care, dependent care, and commuter benefits (FSA) * Flexible medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family * Life insurance \& disability insurance * Complimentary lunch buffet \& beverages * Awesome, encouraging team atmosphere * Unlimited paid time off * Option to work remotely part\-time * Office social events, including happy hours, parties, and community service projects * Fully paid on\-site parking, local commuter pass * A casual, laid\-back work environment * High\-sensory environment immersed in technology and robotics ### **Physical Requirements** * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer * Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times ### **Compensation** The base pay range for this role is $100,000 – $140,000 per year. Thoro.ai is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, military or veteran status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

jobs.title: Hardware Integration Engineer (Mechatronics)
jobs.description: ### **About Thoro AI** Thoro AI builds autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) for different verticals, including commercial floor cleaning and pallet logistics, plus the cloud platform that manages them. Thoro AI is a small, senior engineering team shipping an end\-to\-end robotics product: a flexible autonomy stack that runs on the robot, a cloud portal that manages fleets, and the infrastructure that ties them together. Our robots map and navigate real warehouses and retail floors, coordinate pick and drop missions across a fleet, and report telemetry to the cloud over MQTT. You will work across the whole system, not one narrow slice of it. ### **The Role** You will bridge the physical and digital worlds: getting our autonomy hardware onto industrial vehicles while keeping the parts pipeline organized and efficient. You will work side by side with our hardware integration team to design and build the mounts, brackets, and cable routing that carry sensors and compute on OEM equipment. This role is designed as a 75/25 split. You will spend most of your time (about 75%) in the shop and on vehicles doing hands\-on mechanical design, electro\-mechanical assembly, and troubleshooting. The rest (about 25%) goes to technical documentation, maintaining BOMs, sourcing hardware alternates, and managing logistics so every install is predictable. You will collaborate closely with software, autonomy, and platform engineers to deliver hardware kits that install cleanly, hold up in real industrial environments, and can be built repeatedly as we scale. This role is based in Pittsburgh, PA. ### **What You Will Do** ### **Hardware \& Electrical Integration (\~75%)** * Install and commission autonomy hardware on OEM vehicles, both in our Pittsburgh shop and at partner and customer sites. * Design, fabricate, and iterate mounting solutions, brackets, and enclosures for sensors, compute, and other components using CAD. * Assemble and test cable harnesses, power distribution, and connectors, and support electrical troubleshooting across the system. * Evaluate new sensors, compute, and other hardware through bench testing and physical fit checks on vehicles. * Collaborate with software, autonomy, and platform teams to define mechanical and electrical interfaces. * Contribute to design reviews, install guides, and engineering standards. ### **Technical Administration \& Logistics (\~25%)** * Own and maintain the hardware bill of materials (BOM), including part numbers, revisions, costs, and approved alternates for critical components. * Source hardware, track inventory, and manage technical relationships with suppliers, distributors, and machine shops. * Produce clear drawings and work instructions so parts can be built by outside fabricators and replicated efficiently. * Identify and implement process improvements in technical logistics and BOM management to reduce lead times and streamline integration. ### **Must\-Haves** * 3 to 5 years of professional experience in mechatronics, hardware integration, or electro\-mechanical engineering. * Broad hands\-on experience designing and building mounts, brackets, or fixtures, with working knowledge of sheet metal, machined, and welded parts and common fasteners. * Proficiency in a 3D CAD tool (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or Onshape) and the ability to produce manufacturing\-ready drawings. * Working knowledge of electrical integration, including wiring, connectors, crimping, power distribution, and reading schematics. * Strong system\-level troubleshooting skills, with the ability to debug issues across mechanical, electrical, and basic software boundaries. * Working knowledge of design for manufacturing (DFM), GD\&T, and working with outside fabricators and machine shops. * Understanding of ruggedization for industrial environments, including vibration, ingress protection, and thermal considerations. * Experience managing BOMs, tracking inventory, and working with vendors for technical sourcing and hardware alternates. * Comfort working in a shop with hand tools, power tools, and basic fabrication equipment. * Ability to work independently on assigned projects while supporting the broader team's goals. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Uses AI agents and automation for BOMs, sourcing, vendor tracking and documentation. Builds repeatable, automated workflows wherever practical. ### **Nice\-to\-Haves** * Experience with robotics, AMRs, AGVs, forklifts, or other industrial and off\-highway vehicles. * Familiarity with compute hardware, common industrial data protocols, and basic scripting or Linux. * Experience with rapid prototyping, including 3D printing and laser or waterjet cut parts. * Awareness of sourcing compliance requirements such as NDAA and trade restrictions. ### **What We Will Teach You** * Our autonomy hardware kit: the sensors, compute, and power architecture, and how it connects to each OEM vehicle. * The OEM platforms we integrate with and where our kit plugs into them. * Our sourcing rules, including the compliance requirements behind our approved parts list. ### **How We Hire** We hire for fundamentals and judgment, not exact keyword matches. * Industrial vehicle experience is a plus but not required. Strong hands\-on fundamentals transfer. * We value people who are as comfortable in the shop as they are in a BOM or a vendor email. * We value clean drawings, clear notes, and installs the next person can repeat. ### **How We Work** Small team, short feedback loops. Hardware designs go through a review before they go on a vehicle, and every install is documented so the next one is faster than the last. You will work directly with the software and autonomy engineers whose code runs on the hardware you build, and with the OEM partners and customers who run it every day. ### **Why You'll Like It Here** * Competitive salary \& equity packages * 401(k) retirement plan * Pre\-tax health care, dependent care, and commuter benefits (FSA) * Flexible medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family * Life insurance \& disability insurance * Complimentary lunch buffet \& beverages * Awesome, encouraging team atmosphere * Unlimited paid time off * Option to work remotely part\-time * Office social events, including happy hours, parties, and community service projects * Fully paid on\-site parking, local commuter pass * A casual, laid\-back work environment * High\-sensory environment immersed in technology and robotics ### **Physical Requirements** * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer * Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds at times * Ability to work around industrial vehicles and equipment, including bending, kneeling, climbing, and working in tight spaces * Some travel to partner and customer sites may be required ### **Compensation** The base pay range for this role is $90,000 – $115,000 per year. Thoro.ai is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, military or veteran status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

This is a unique opportunity to be the first Customer Success Engineer in the US market at a rapidly scaling cybersecurity company. You'll have support to define the function your way and directly impact how security teams detect breaches. Your work in the first 12 months will shape how we deliver customer success in the US for years to come. **FAQs** -------- **Where is the office?** We have an office in Union Square, Manhattan. You'll work closely with our London team and other US team members as we grow. **Are you doing hybrid/remote?** This role can be based either in our New York office or fully remote in the US. jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: Build the product where anyone with expertise trains their own intelligence. Today that takes a builder and a benchmark. We're heading to a product where a lawyer or a banker describes what good looks like, and the platform does the research for them. **About Trajectory** -------------------- Trajectory is a research and product lab building the platform for continual learning, where agents get smarter with every interaction. AI is the most capable software ever built, and the least able to learn. Every correction and edit that happens in a product evaporates at the next session. Our platform turns the signal already sitting in product usage into continuously post\-trained models, and lets anyone train a large\-scale model with just a few agent prompts. We just launched self\-serve and work with Harvey, Rogo, Decagon, and NVIDIA. Our researchers worked on Gemini 3 at DeepMind and GPT\-4o at OpenAI, and our product team comes from Apple Vision Pro, Netflix, and Stripe. We've raised $60M in a Sequoia\-led Series A, alongside Conviction, Bessemer, NVIDIA, Jeff Dean, and Fei\-Fei Li. **The role** ------------ Trajectory makes it simple to train a model on production data. You can do it from the web app, with one click to train and evaluate and a live view of every run, or by connecting a coding agent and doing the same thing with a couple of prompts. As a Product Engineer, you'll build both of those interfaces, and both should be equally clean. You'll iterate quickly on feedback from the customers we work with every week, and work directly with our researchers to bring new research paradigms from a customer demo into the mainline product. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Build the platform frontend: training and eval flows, run monitoring, model comparison, and the in\-platform agent. * Design and own the agent SDK and its abstractions, so customers and coding agents can do everything the UI can. * Ship fast against real customer feedback, and tell customer\-specific requests apart from things that belong in the product. * Partner with researchers to turn new methods into product features. * Hold a high bar for craft in both the pixels and the API surface. **Who you are** --------------- * Strong full\-stack engineer with real product taste. You care how things look and feel, and how they read in code. * You've shipped high\-quality product to real users, or designed SDKs and developer primitives people love to use. * Comfortable working directly with customers and turning ambiguous feedback into shipped work. * You build with AI daily and are curious about how models are trained. * You move quickly and own problems end to end. **Nice to have** ---------------- * You've worked at a product company known for craft, or on a widely used SDK or API. * Experience with data\-dense interfaces, observability, or developer tools. * Founding or early engineer at a 0 1 AI product.
