Today, Uniphore’s technology empowers over 750,000 end\-users across 1,600 enterprises in 20 countries. Discover the unmatched capabilities of Uniphore —because there’s no AI like it™. **About the role:** As a SR AI Engineer , you will positively impact our customers and end users by utilizing machine learning (ML) and Generative AI techniques. The ideal candidate will have strong foundations in computer science, algorithms, ML/NLP, superb communication skills, relevant industry experience and a proven track record of delivery under tight deadlines. **Responsibilities:** * Evaluate, adapt, and develop new state of the art language and/or multimodal foundation models for enterprise applications * Perform thorough empirical analysis of the approach and write production ready code * Develop, modify and fine\-tune ML/NLP and pre\-trained enterprise\-grade large language models (LLMs) and multi\-modal models * Ensure the developed models seamlessly integrate with other tools and company products and are aligned with the feedback that will be generated from enterprise customers * Specify guidelines and design annotation processes for data; collaborate with data team on data preprocessing, consumption, and automated/manual annotations * Evaluate product and algorithm performance using industry standard approaches and develop new evaluation paradigms; build up competencies comparing results of more complex approaches * Collaborate with other teams, provide input, and contribute to the delivery of AI services for critical projects * Write concise, readable, and modular code, continually improving the code, requiring minimal revision when moved to production * Manage large datasets, address and resolve quality issues, and interpret data with a focus on business goals * Develop clear documentation of the work plan, its evolution, and results * Regularly read and assess publications on existing methods, and compare internal solutions to alternative method **Qualifications \& Skills** * Master’s degree in Computer Science , Engineering, or related fields * Plus minimum of 5 years relevant experience * OR Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Engineering or related experience plus a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience * Minimum of 5 years of industry experience in artificial intelligence (AI), Natural Language Processing (NLP), Vision and Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) * In\-depth knowledge of deep learning (DL) with expertise in PyTorch /TensorFlow * In\-depth understanding of Transformers, hands\-on experience with the Hugging Face library, and the ability to solve NLP and ASR problems using LLMs * Experience working with large datasets, addressing quality issues, and interpreting data with a focus on business goals * Expertise in Python programming * Hands\-on experience in developing production\-ready, scalable code * Ability to lead projects independently and mentor and guide other team members * Knowledge of deployment using environments such as: Docker, AWS, or Kubernetes * Good communication skills **Benefits** Uniphore offers a competitive offer and premium benefits, including insurance, pre\-IPO options, leave and other perks . **Hiring Range** **:** $169,800 \- $233,500 \- for Primary Location of USA \- CA \- Palo Alto The specific rate will depend on the successful candidate's qualifications and prior experience. In addition to competitive base pay, this position also includes an annual incentive opportunity based on target achievement, pre\-IPO stock options, benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with a match, and more, plus generous paid time off, paid holidays, paid day off for your birthday and other paid leave policies to support employees through all phases of life. **Location preference:** USA \- CA \- Palo Alto Uniphore is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity in the workplace. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. For more information on how Uniphore uses AI to unify—and humanize—every enterprise experience, please visit www.uniphore.com.

We empower every worker to boost productivity and help businesses grow faster, operate smarter and reduce costs. jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Title of Position**: Security Engineer **Department:** Risk \& Compliance **Reports to (Title):** Assistant Director, Information Security **Grade:** P2/Zone 4 **Position Description** The Security Engineer will champion information security throughout the organization to ensure the confidentiality, availability, and integrity of the nation’s only organ match list, which directs lifesaving organs to people in need. **Key Responsibilities** * Verify and work to improve the UNOS’ security posture by implementing best practices, and by ensuring regulatory and policy compliance requirements are met. * Work with technical and non\-technical groups to ensure current and pending systems are implemented in a secure fashion. * Identify and analyze areas of potential risk to assets, resources, or success of UNOS’ lifesaving work. * Perform analyses to validate established security requirements and to recommend additional security requirements and safeguards. * Document security procedures and processes, as well as system and configuration baselines. * Evaluate technology and usage trends for impact on security. * Ensure that endpoint protection is current and active on all workstation and servers. * Monitor and respond to security events and incidents. * Participate in network security audits, analyze results, and make recommendations for remediation. * Consult with system owners on methods for meeting information security requirements and remediate identified vulnerabilities. * Develop recommendations for system security upgrades and improvements. * Partner with system owners and Enterprise Technology remediation engineers to plan patch cycles, report current status, and ensure all systems are patched within required timelines without impacting system availability. * Operate and administer the Tenable vulnerability management platform (Tenable Vulnerability Management, Tenable Security Center, Nessus scanners and agents), including scan policy design, scheduling, and authenticated scanning across on\-premises, Azure, and endpoint assets. * Maintain complete scan coverage by reconciling Tenable asset data against authoritative inventories, deploying and troubleshooting Nessus agents, and identifying unscanned or unmanaged assets. * Triage and prioritize findings using CVSS, Tenable Vulnerability Priority Rating (VPR), exploitability, asset criticality, and the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, and assign remediation to the responsible system owners. * Track remediation against defined SLAs and federal timelines, including CISA Binding Operational Directives, and escalate overdue or at\-risk items. * Validate remediation through rescans and close findings only after the fix is verified. * Manage vulnerability exceptions, risk acceptances, and false\-positive dispositions, and maintain the related POA\&M entries in support of NIST SP 800\-53 RA\-5, SI\-2, and CM\-6 requirements. * Perform configuration compliance auditing against CIS Benchmarks and DISA STIGs using Tenable audit policies. * Produce vulnerability metrics and dashboards (e.g., mean time to remediate, SLA compliance, vulnerability aging, scan coverage) for leadership, audit, and federal reporting. * Assist with definition, selection and implementation of security tools, technologies, and processes in a NIST\-800\-53 and HIPAA/HITRUST environment. * Review violations of computer security procedures and discuss procedures with violators to ensure violations are not repeated. * Perform other duties and support additional administrative priorities as assigned, consistent with the general scope and level of the position. **Minimum Requirements** * 2 years of technical experience working in the Information Security field. * 1\+ year of hands\-on experience operating an enterprise vulnerability scanning platform, preferably Tenable (Tenable Vulnerability Management, Tenable Security Center, or Nessus. **Critical Skills** * Engineering secure cloud solutions in an Azure environment. * Administering Tenable vulnerability management tools, including scan configuration, authenticated scanning, Nessus agent deployment, and reporting and dashboards. * Running the full vulnerability management lifecycle (discovery, prioritization, remediation tracking, and verification) against defined remediation SLAs. * Working knowledge of Windows, Linux, and endpoint patching and hardening sufficient to interpret findings and guide remediation. * Implementing Privilege Access Management (PAM) solution. * Configuring and maintaining an automated PKI infrastructure. **Additional Skills \& Qualifications** * Experience working with security technologies, such as IDS/IPS, SIEM, access controls, encryption, and forensic tools. * Scripting or automation experience (e.g., Python, PowerShell) using the Tenable API to automate reporting, ticketing, and asset reconciliation. * Experience integrating vulnerability findings with ITSM ticketing workflows (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira). * Familiarity with Azure\-native security tooling (e.g., Microsoft Defender for Cloud) and how its findings complement Tenable data. * Tenable certification (e.g., Tenable Certified Nessus Auditor) or industry certifications such as CompTIA Security\+, CySA\+, or GIAC GEVA preferred. **Education** 4\-year Degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent IT Information Security experience **Physical Requirements** * Ability to work on\-call rotational hours (1st shift). * General office demands + Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. + Frequent reaching, handling, and fine manipulation for using office equipment, filing, and managing paperwork. + Manual dexterity sufficient to operate a keyboard, mouse, and other office tools. + Occasional standing, walking, and bending. + Ability to lift up to 10\-20 pounds occasionally. + Vision abilities required include close vision for computer work and reading documents. + Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.description: **Job Description:** **Mission:** In the Senate Community tradition of service, we strive to improve the financial wellness of our members throughout all stages of life by integrating sustainability and security into every financial solution. **Culture Competencies: S.T.R.I.V.E** * Maintains our members' and employees' trust by safeguarding their financial data and information. * Values and respects everyone's abilities, opinions and feedback to achieve trust, safety, and well\-being in a friendly, welcoming and cooperative environment. Actively devoted to our motto of 'better together'. * Is honest, professional, authentic, and genuine in creating relationships that are uncompromising and true to ethical principles. * Generates new ideas, supports change, provides new efficient solutions and solves problems creatively while balancing risk. **General Summary** At Senate Federal Credit Union, we're building the future of member\-owned banking, and we're doing it AI\-first. As a Software Engineer, you'll help design, build, and ship the digital products our members and employees use every day, from member\-facing apps to internal tools that make our teams faster and smarter. You'll work alongside experienced engineers, product managers, designers, and data analysts, using modern AI tools as a core part of how you write, test, and ship code. We're looking for an early\-career engineer who sees AI as a real teammate: someone who moves fast with it, knows when not to trust it, and wants to help shape how a regulated financial institution existing systems and identify opportunities where AI can improve the member or employee experience. * Follow security, privacy, and regulatory requirements, and complete assigned compliance training. * Perform other duties as assigned. * Comply with regulatory compliance and assigned training requirements. **Non\-essential Duties \& Responsibilities** * Performs other duties as assigned. * Working knowledge of Git and core software engineering practices. * Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences. * A self\-starter mindset: curious, accountable, and comfortable in a fast\-moving, high\-ownership environment. **Additional Skills that will Set You Apart****:** * Experience in fintech, banking, credit unions, or another regulated industry. * Experience building or launching customer\-facing products with a strong focus on user experience. * Experience building with LLM APIs, agents, MCP servers, or retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG). * Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS or Azure) and CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps). * Experience writing automated tests (unit, integration, end\-to\-end). * Awareness of security and data privacy practices for handling sensitive financial data. **Communication:** Must have superior interpersonal skills and be comfortable engaging with people from a wide variety of roles, cultures, and economic backgrounds. **Location**: Remote opportunities in the following states ONLY: MD \& DC ($104,253\.52 \- $156,380\.28\), VA, CT ($92,435\.31 \- $138,652\.96\); FL, NC, SC, TX, LA; Chicago, IL ($92,013\.23 \- $138,019\.85\); Somerville, MA ($98,344\.62 \- $189,473\.43\); New York, NY ($105,519\.76 \- $158,279\.28\) and Seattle, WA ($99,610\.65 \- $149,415\.98\). jobs.title: Développeur(se) logiciel sénior, écosystème Android | Senior Software Developer, Android Ecosystem
jobs.description: **L'opportunité** Nous recherchons un(e) développeur(se) logiciel sénior, établi(e) à Montréal, au Canada, ou travaillant à distance dans le fuseau horaire de la côte Est des États\-Unis, pour se joindre à une nouvelle équipe de développement chargée d’assurer la prise en charge de la plateforme Unity pour un écosystème Android englobant les appareils mobiles, les ordinateurs portables et les appareils hybrides. L’objectif principal de cette équipe est de permettre aux développeur(se)s Unity de déployer leurs titres de façon fluide sur ces appareils, tout en tirant pleinement parti de leurs capacités matérielles et logicielles uniques, notamment l’utilisation optimisée de l’affichage, l’intégration native des périphériques d’entrée et les services propres à chaque plateforme. L’équipe sera également chargée de rechercher et de mettre en œuvre des optimisations de l’environnement d’exécution afin d’améliorer les performances de démarrage et l’efficacité d’exécution sur les appareils d’entrée de gamme comme sur les appareils haute performance. Pour ce faire, elle établira des points de référence en matière de performance, collaborera avec des expert(e)s internes et externes du domaine afin de mener des analyses rigoureuses des performances du moteur Unity sur la plateforme, et travaillera avec les principales parties prenantes à la mise en œuvre d’améliorations validées. Les candidat(e)s doivent posséder une expertise en C\+\+, en C\# et en programmation de systèmes Android, ainsi qu’une expérience démontrée dans la création de logiciels de grande qualité à grande échelle. **Ce que vous ferez** * Travailler au sein d’une équipe agile afin de concevoir et de développer des fonctionnalités et des Workflow dans l’éditeur Unity qui prennent en charge ces configurations de plateforme particulières. * Évaluer, analyser et repérer les possibilités d’optimisation dans l’ensemble de la pile technologique, puis collaborer avec plusieurs équipes afin de développer des solutions. * Rédiger une documentation technique complète et participer activement aux processus de révision de la conception. * Assurer la stabilité de la plateforme en examinant et en résolvant les signalements de bogues. * Renforcer la qualité et la livraison grâce aux tests automatisés et à des révisions de code rigoureuses, tout en favorisant une culture d’innovation, de collaboration et d’excellence technique. **Ce que nous recherchons** * Une solide expérience de la programmation de systèmes Android, appuyée par une maîtrise avancée de C\+\+, de C\# et de Java ou Kotlin. * Une expérience de la création et de la maintenance de systèmes de plateforme ou d’environnements d’exécution. * Une solide compréhension de la façon dont les applications de grande envergure utilisent plusieurs langages, notamment de l’exécution des appels synchrones et asynchrones, ainsi que de la gestion, de la propriété et du transfert de la mémoire entre ces langages. * Une expérience de la conception et de la mise en œuvre d’ensembles de fonctionnalités évolutifs dans une base de code multithread de grande envergure. * Des compétences en diagnostic, en débogage et en profilage des performances. **Vous avez peut\-être également** * Une compréhension approfondie de C\# et des environnements d’exécution gérés. * Une connaissance des méthodes de rendu 3D en temps réel et des API graphiques modernes, y compris Vulkan. * Une approche méthodique de la recherche et du développement de solutions d’optimisation novatrices. * Une passion pour l’avenir des jeux vidéo ou des expériences 3D en temps réel dans divers contextes. * Une connaissance des meilleurs moments et des meilleures façons d’utiliser l’intelligence artificielle dans le processus de développement logiciel. jobs.title: Senior Security Operations and Incident Response Analyst
jobs.description: ### **About the role** Our Security Operations (SecOps) team is seeking a Senior Security Operations and Incident Response Analyst to strengthen how we detect, investigate, and respond to threats across Unity’s cloud, production, and corporate environments. In this role, you will own security investigations and incidents end to end, from initial triage and scoping through containment, remediation, recovery, and post\-incident analysis. Beyond handling incidents, there is a lot of work ahead to improve, automate, and mature how we detect and respond to threats. You will play an active part in that work, bringing your own expertise and ideas, whether in automation, detection engineering, threat hunting, or other areas, to make our defenses stronger and our processes more efficient. You will also help shape how our team adopts AI. That means building and refining AI\-assisted workflows for alert enrichment, triage, investigation, and reporting, evaluating new tools and technologies as they emerge, and applying sound judgment to validate AI\-driven findings, so the team can scale its impact without losing analytical quality. Working within a collaborative, globally distributed team, you will partner with engineering, infrastructure, and other security teams, and have a real voice in shaping our tooling, playbooks, and ways of working. **What you will own** --------------------- * **Monitoring and incident response:** take an active part in daily security monitoring and lead investigations and incidents across cloud, production, corporate, and SaaS environments, from scoping through containment, remediation, recovery, and root\-cause analysis. * **Detection and response improvement:** identify gaps uncovered during investigations and help close them by improving our detection capabilities, monitoring coverage, and response processes. * **Automation and AI:** automate recurring enrichment, triage, containment, and reporting steps, and help build and refine AI\-assisted workflows that reduce manual work and improve analytical quality. * **Cross\-functional collaboration:** partner with engineering, infrastructure, and security teams across Unity’s business units to drive remediation and security improvements to completion, and communicate risks and decisions clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * **Continuous improvement:** write clear incident reports and post\-incident reviews, keep playbooks current, and share knowledge across the team. **What success looks like in the first 12 months** -------------------------------------------------- * Leading incidents end to end with clear communication to stakeholders and executives, including during live incidents. * Measurable improvement in mean time to detect and respond for the incident types you own. * A set of high\-value detections written or tuned by you, with false\-positive rates tracked and reduced. * Post\-incident reviews completed for the incidents you led, with follow\-up actions tracked to closure. * Playbooks for the incident types you handle most often written or updated. **What you bring** ------------------ ### **Required** * 4\+ years in security operations or incident response, with hands\-on ownership of investigations and incidents from detection to closure. * Strong investigation skills, including reconstructing attack timelines and correlating evidence across cloud, identity, endpoint, and SaaS sources. * Experience writing and refining queries in a SIEM or security data platform * Experience investigating complex incidents in at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure), with strong familiarity with its audit logs, identity and access model, and common attack paths. * Experience investigating corporate security incidents, including identity\-based attacks (for example Okta, Google Workspace, Entra ID), account compromise, and endpoint threats. * Proven hands\-on experience beyond incident response in at least one area, for example automation, detection engineering, threat hunting, forensics, threat intelligence, or AI\-assisted security tooling. * Calm, clear communication during incidents, with engineers and with non\-technical leaders. * You enjoy working as part of a team, sharing ideas, offering support, and learning from others. ### **Preferred** * Experience building or applying AI\-assisted tools to investigations, detection, or response workflows, and the judgment to validate their output. * Experience with SOAR platforms and building response automation. * Threat hunting and threat intelligence experience, including turning findings into new detections. * Purple teaming or adversary emulation experience, such as testing detection coverage against MITRE ATT\&CK techniques. * Detection engineering experience, including detection\-as\-code and measuring detection quality over time. * Digital forensics experience across endpoints (Windows, macOS, Linux) and cloud workloads, including containers and Kubernetes. *  . You go deep on the technical details, and you also see the business picture when deciding how to respond. You write things down so others can follow. You automate what you do twice. You treat every incident as a chance to get better, and you help your teammates do the same. Base Salary Range: We determine the base salary range for this role based on your primary work location: Zone A: $134,100 \- $201,100 USD gross Zone B: $151,500 \- $227,300 USD gross Zone C: $170,300 \- $255,500 USD gross *This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for equity awards and participation in our company incentive plans (such as annual discretionary bonuses or sales commissions). The final offer amount will depend on several factors, including geographic location and the candidate’s relevant experience, professional background, and skill set.* **Benefits** At Unity, we want our team members to thrive. We offer a wide range of benefits designed to support well\-being and work\-life balance. Please note: Benefits eligibility, specific offerings, and coverage vary based on the country and employment status. While specific benefits vary, here are some of the ways we strive to take care of our eligible team members globally: Comprehensive health, life, and disability insurance \| Commute subsidy \| Employee stock ownership \| Competitive retirement/pension plans \| Generous vacation and personal days \| Support for new parents through leave and family\-care programs \| Office food snacks \| Mental Health and Wellbeing programs and support \| Employee Resource Groups \| Global Employee Assistance Program \| Training and development programs \| Volunteering and donation matching program **Life at Unity** Unity \[NYSE: U] is the world’s leading game engine, powering play for more than 3 billion consumers each month. The top mobile games in the world, the most played PC indie titles, the most innovative console games, and virtually all of the top XR and Web Games are developed, deployed, and grown in Unity. Unity also enables teams across industries like automotive, manufacturing, and healthcare to design, simulate, and collaborate in 3D — closing the gap between ideas and reality. For more information, please visit www.unity.com. *Unity is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and celebrate our employees across age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law. Our differences are strengths that enable us to support the growing and evolving needs of our customers, partners, and collaborators. jobs.title: Applications Programmer
jobs.description: The Applications Programmer is an advanced, hands\-on software developer and technical lead responsible for design, development, modernization, operation, and support of complex research applications used by the Fein Memory and Aging Center. The Programmer makes substantial direct contributions to software development using Python, Django, Vue.js, PostgreSQL, MySQL, APIs, and related technologies while supporting the overall team by contributing to architecture and design decisions, code reviews, collaborative problem solving, mentoring, and development of software engineering practices. The position leads by example through active participation in coding, testing, debugging, deployment, and production support. The Programmer applies and promotes secure software development practices and advanced use of AI\-assisted software development tools, helping establish effective approaches for their responsible use. Responsibilities include DevOps and operational work in Docker and AWS environments, including application deployment, configuration, monitoring, troubleshooting, performance and reliability improvement, incident response, and ongoing maintenance. The participates as a member of the team in working with researchers, program staff, data professionals, and other users to understand complex research and operational requirements, translate them into technical solutions, and provide ongoing application support and training. The position develops and delivers user documentation and training for new and existing functionality and directly assists users in resolving application and workflow issues. As a senior technical contributor, the AP4 also helps guide application architecture, modernization, integration, development standards, and technical approaches across multiple projects while remaining actively engaged in day\-to\-day software development. **Department Overview** The Fein Memory and Aging Center (Fein MAC) is an internationally renowned clinical research center with more than 300 employees located primarily on the UCSF Mission Bay campus. The Fein MAC provides clinical care for patients with neurodegenerative disease processes and conducts clinical, translational, and basic research into Alzheimer's disease and related dementias. From this clinical population, external referrals, and direct recruitment efforts, we enroll patients in more than 50 structured research protocols and treatment trials. We are a California Alzheimer's Research Center and a federal Alzheimer's Disease Research Center. The Fein MAC Technology team develops and operates software, data systems, and technology infrastructure that directly support the Center's clinical, research, and education missions. The team works closely with investigators, research coordinators, data professionals, clinicians, and program leaders to build and maintain systems for research data collection and management, clinical and research workflows, data integration, reporting, and collaboration. Our software environment increasingly emphasizes modern open\-source technologies including Python, Django, Vue.js, PostgreSQL, MySQL, APIs, automated testing and CI/CD, together with responsible use of AI\-assisted software development tools. The team also maintains and progressively modernizes important legacy applications and integrations. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * Five (5\) or more years of progressively responsible professional software development experience, including experience on complex production systems. * Demonstrated advanced experience architecting, designing, developing, testing, debugging, and deploying complex web applications. * Advanced professional experience with Python and Python\-based web application development, preferably with Django. * Advanced experience with modern front\-end development using Vue.js or a comparable framework and JavaScript. * Advanced relational database skills, including data modeling and SQL with PostgreSQL, MySQL, or a comparable enterprise relational database. * Advanced experience designing APIs, integrations, data interfaces, and application architectures spanning multiple systems or data sources. * Demonstrated experience establishing or leading automated testing, CI/CD, deployment, configuration\-management, secure development, and production\-support practices. * Demonstrated advanced professional use of AI\-assisted and agentic software development tools, such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, or comparable tools, as part of hands\-on software development, including codebase analysis, implementation, refactoring, debugging, testing, documentation, and code review; demonstrated ability to evaluate, validate, and secure AI\-generated code. * Demonstrated ability to make and communicate architectural and technical decisions in the absence of precedent and to evaluate tradeoffs among competing technical and operational requirements. * Demonstrated ability to lead technical planning and serve as a hands\-on technical lead across projects or major software initiatives. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain complex technical information and tradeoffs to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Demonstrated complex problem\-solving skills and the ability to work with substantial autonomy while balancing multiple priorities. * Demonstrated experience with Docker/containerized development and deployment and AWS\-based application operations, including deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, configuration, and production support. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related field. * Seven (7\) or more years of progressively responsible professional software development experience * Experience modernizing legacy applications or leading migration from legacy enterprise technologies to current web application stacks. * Experience supporting clinical research, academic research, healthcare, or other environments involving regulated or sensitive data.

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: Software Developer SVC HS Information Technology \- Pennsylvania\-Pittsburgh \- (26007390\) Health Sciences IT (HSIT) supports the six schools of the health sciences by providing the applications, integrations, and technical services needed for the education, clinical, administrative, and research missions. The HSIT Applications \& Development team designs, builds, and maintains custom software that departments and faculty rely on daily, working directly with customers to translate business needs into supported solutions. Day\-to\-day work includes writing and debugging code in C\#/.NET and React, building and testing APIs, integrating applications with relational databases through ORM tools, participating in code reviews, and moving work through a CI/CD pipeline using Git. The developer is expected to work independently once requirements are defined, to document work thoroughly, and to recognize when to raise questions to more senior developers. Regular meetings with departmental customers are part of the role. A key ambition for the team is to deepen its expertise in artificial intelligence and machine learning, positioning the group to bring AI/ML capabilities into its applications where they can meaningfully enhance how users work. The developer participates fully in the Scrum process (sprint planning, estimation, stand\-ups, reviews, and retrospectives), collaborates with QA to ensure strong test coverage, and partners with the infrastructure team on deployment and access needs. Required Qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. * Five years of professional software development experience. * Experience with C\#/.NET and React. * Hands\-on experience building or integrating with cloud environments \- Microsoft Azure preferred; comparable experience with AWS or Google Cloud Platform will be considered. * Proficiency in UML modeling (class, sequence, use case, and activity diagrams) and relational databases/SQL, including complex queries, data modeling, and performance optimization. **Job Summary** --------------- Contributes to the design, development, coding, testing, debugging, implementation, and maintenance of moderately to more complex websites and/or software. Documents development and maintenance efforts, assists in integrating assigned work with other system components, and designs and performs functional testing. Essential Functions Design, develop, test, and maintain web applications in C\#/.NET and React that support the mission of the health sciences. Use AI tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot to write, review and debug code. Create, test, and document APIs that expose data to customers and to standard internal tools. Debug and troubleshoot application defects with close attention to detail, documenting root cause and resolution. Produce and maintain technical end\-user documentation for applications, APIs, and Integrations. Support QA analysts through unit testing and defect resolution prior to release. Perform other duties as assigned in support of Health Sciences IT and the six schools of the health sciences. Physical Effort Work is primarily sedentary and performed at a computer workstation, involving extended periods of sitting, typing, and viewing a monitor. The role requires occasional movement across campus to attend meetings. The incumbent may occasionally lift or move light equipment such as a laptop, monitor, or peripherals (generally up to approximately 20 pounds). *The University of Pittsburgh is an equal opportunity employer / disability / veteran.* Assignment Category Full\-time regular Bargaining Unit Eligibility This position is bargaining unit eligible Job Classification Staff.Software Developer III Job Family Information Technology Job Sub\-Family Programming \& Development Campus Pittsburgh Minimum Education Level Required Bachelor's Degree Minimum Years of Experience Required 5 Will this position accept substitution in lieu of education or experience? Combination of education and relevant experience will be considered in lieu of education and/ or experience requirement. Work Schedule Monday through Friday, 8:30am to 5pm; 2\-3 days in office rotating per week Work Arrangement Hybrid: Combination of On\-Campus and Remote work as determined by the department. Hiring Range TBD Based Upon Qualifications Relocation Offered No Visa Sponsorship Provided No Background Check For position finalists, employment with the University will require successful completion of a background check Child Protection Clearances Not Applicable Required Documents Resume Optional Documents Not Applicable

jobs.title: Embedded Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer – Platform Manageability Experience**:** 5\+ years of embedded firmware development, with 3\+ years in platform manageability or related system firmware Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Embedded Firmware Engineer to join our Platform Manageability team. The successful candidate will design, develop, integrate, test, and debug embedded firmware for complex server and accelerator platforms. The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience with Zephyr RTOS, embedded C/C\+\+ development, hardware bring\-up, low\-level communication protocols, and system\-level debugging. reproducible experimentation, model registries and controlled deployments. * Design and operate reliable, containerised ML services on Kubernetes. * Develop large\-scale vector retrieval and similarity search solutions using PostgreSQL and pgvector. * Lead offline and online experimentation, including lift analysis, holdout validation and A/B testing, translating results into actionable product decisions. * Improve model performance, scalability, reliability and infrastructure cost efficiency. * Drive engineering best practices through architecture reviews, code reviews, automated testing and technical documentation. * Mentor other engineers and contribute to the team's technical development. * Collaborate with product, data engineering and commercial teams across Europe and the US. **What you'll need** -------------------- * Significant commercial experience in Machine Learning Engineering, with demonstrated ownership of ML models and systems operating in production. * Strong software engineering and system design skills, with the ability to architect scalable and maintainable ML solutions. * Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL. * Hands\-on experience with PyTorch, scikit\-learn and gradient\-boosted models. * Strong experience with large\-scale distributed data processing using PySpark. * Extensive practical experience with MLOps and model serving, including Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD and MLflow. * Experience designing and operating ML workloads on AWS and/or GCP. * Strong understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including feature engineering, model evaluation, data leakage, bias and generalisation. * Experience troubleshooting, monitoring and optimising production ML systems. * Ability to independently make technical decisions and balance model performance, latency, reliability and cost. * Ability to deliver high\-quality production software using AI\-assisted engineering tools such as Claude Code or similar agentic coding environments. * Experience contributing to technical design discussions, reviewing code and mentoring engineers. * Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills. * Ability to work remotely with sufficient overlap with UK business hours. **Nice to have** ---------------- * AdTech experience, particularly audience modelling, identity resolution and programmatic advertising (DSPs and SSPs). * Experience with recommendation systems, semantic search and embedding\-based retrieval. * Vector databases, approximate nearest neighbour (ANN) indexes and LLM fine\-tuning. * Experience with Ray, Ray Serve, Databricks and Terraform. * Real\-time data processing using Kafka or Flink. * GPU inference optimisation, including quantisation, batching and model compression. * Experience with load testing, observability and distributed system performance optimisation. * Privacy\-aware machine learning, including GDPR, CCPA and sensitive\-category classification. jobs.title: Associate, Software Engineer
jobs.description: Vestwell is the financial technology company powering the new savings economy. The New York City\-based fintech platform redefines how people save for the critical aspects of life across retirement, education, and healthcare savings needs. Today, Vestwell enables over 790,000 businesses and more than 2\.75 million active savers, with over $57 billion in assets saved across all 50 United States. Vestwell offers a range of products, including workplace\-delivered retirement plans, employer\-offered student loan repayment benefits, and various savings accounts for education, emergencies, and individuals with disabilities. Vestwell's platform serves a diverse clientele, including financial advisers, employers, third\-party administrators, financial institutions, payroll providers, government agencies, and individual savers. To learn more, visit vestwell.com **Who Are We Looking For?** Vestwell is a fintech company that powers workplace retirement plans, state\-sponsored savings programs, and 529 education and ABLE savings accounts. Our platform is a set of distributed, event\-driven services that handle contributions, investments, and withdrawals, and that integrate with banking, recordkeeping, and payment partners. Because it moves real people's money, correctness, security, and auditability are part of the job. We build with AI agents as a core part of our workflow. Our engineers direct agents to plan, write, test, and refactor code, and they stay accountable for every decision and every line that ships. As an Associate Software Engineer, you'll start your career on that team. You'll implement parts of real features with guidance from senior engineers, and you'll learn fast because you're curious about how and why things work. **What Will You Be Doing?** * Implement assigned parts of features across our stack with guidance, working with your team and product manager and using AI coding agents. * Test your work, and be able to explain what it does and why it works. * Raise questions early when you're stuck: about the code, the requirements, or why things are done the way they are. * Evaluate the conclusions and decisions AI agents make. Check their output for correctness, and steer them toward complete results instead of accepting the first answer. * Learn our application designs and development best practices, and review AI\-produced code against our standards. * Learn to give agents clear instructions and enough context, using our in\-house AI skills and workflows. * Write unit tests and learn how our CI/CD pipeline protects production. * Validate teammates' work during code review: pull down the change, run it, and confirm the feature actually works. Use the feedback on your own reviews to grow. **Requirements** The Necessities * 0–2 years of professional experience. * Experience building a full\-stack application, for example an API backed by a database and a UI that uses it. The backend can be in any language; the frontend should be in **Angular** or **React**. * Familiarity with the software development lifecycle (SDLC): requirements, design, development, testing, code review, deployment, and maintenance. * Basic familiarity with SQL and relational databases. * Familiarity with unit testing. * Hands\-on experience using AI coding tools to build projects, and examples of what you learned from it. * Curiosity and a drive to learn: when an agent gives you an answer, you want to know why it's right. * The ability to explain and debug the code you submit, even when an agent wrote it. * Clear communication, and comfort saying "I don't understand this yet." The Extras * Exposure to **.NET (C\#)**, AWS, or message queues. This role will be based in either the New York City, Austin, King of Prussia, or Scottsdale office, and will be part of Vestwell's hybrid in\-office operation. The expected base salary range for this position is $95K \- $110K base. This position is eligible to participate in the Company Bonus Pool and is eligible to receive new hire equity in the Company. Please note that salary bands are based on NY and other similar metro areas and may differ based on where the role is ultimately hired. **Full\-Time Employee Benefits** We're an innovative, high\-growth company with an exciting future ahead. At Vestwell, we prioritize employee wellbeing through comprehensive health benefits, generous time off, and a dedicated Employee Wellbeing Committee. Our hybrid work model offers flexibility while providing access to our collaborative offices in Midtown Manhattan, Austin, King of Prussia, and Scottsdale. And, of course, as a company focused on helping people save for the future, we offer a competitive 401(k) plan. **Interview Process** Our interview process starts the same for every candidate with 1\-2 introductory conversations to learn more about your background, interests, and what you're looking for, while also giving you the opportunity to learn more about Vestwell and the team. From there, the process varies by role but typically includes a skills or experience\-based assessment, such as a coding interview, portfolio review, or deeper discussion of your relevant experience. Successful candidates then move on to a virtual or in\-person interview panel. Before extending an offer, we complete a reference check with a current or former manager and a peer. Throughout the process, we prioritize transparency, clear communication, and minimizing surprises. For your awareness you will only receive correspondence from recruiting@vestwell.com any other domain not ending in vestwell.com is not our Recruitment team. *Vestwell's* *Privacy Policy.* *Attention California residents: In the course of conducting our business and complying with federal, state, and local government regulations governing such matters as employment, tax, insurance, etc., we must collect Personal Information from you. Should you accept employment with Vestwell you may view our California Privacy Rights Act here:* *Vestwell's California Privacy Rights Policy.*

That includes API design, schema changes and data migrations, frontend state management, and performance tuning. The backend can be in any language; the frontend should be in **Angular** or **React**. * Solid SQL and relational database experience (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or similar). * Experience with **AWS** and distributed systems such as message queues and event\-driven services. * Strong unit testing skills and solid habits around CI/CD. * Regular, hands\-on use of agentic coding tools (for example Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot agents) in real work. * Examples of critical thinking you can walk us through: a requirement you questioned, a tradeoff you weighed, a bug in AI\-generated code you caught. The Extras * Experience with **.NET (C\#)**, or with both Angular and React. * Experience writing or improving reusable AI agent instructions, prompts, or skills. * Experience in fintech, retirement, or other regulated domains. This role will be based in either the New York City, Austin, King of Prussia, or Scottsdale office, and will be part of Vestwell's hybrid in\-office operation. The expected base salary range for this position is $145K \- $160K base. This position is eligible to participate in the Company Bonus Pool and is eligible to receive new hire equity in the Company. Please note that salary bands are based on NY and other similar metro areas and may differ based on where the role is ultimately hired. **Full\-Time Employee Benefits** We're an innovative, high\-growth company with an exciting future ahead. At Vestwell, we prioritize employee wellbeing through comprehensive health benefits, generous time off, and a dedicated Employee Wellbeing Committee. Our hybrid work model offers flexibility while providing access to our collaborative offices in Midtown Manhattan, Austin, King of Prussia, and Scottsdale. And, of course, as a company focused on helping people save for the future, we offer a competitive 401(k) plan. **Interview Process** Our interview process starts the same for every candidate with 1\-2 introductory conversations to learn more about your background, interests, and what you're looking for, while also giving you the opportunity to learn more about Vestwell and the team. From there, the process varies by role but typically includes a skills or experience\-based assessment, such as a coding interview, portfolio review, or deeper discussion of your relevant experience. Successful candidates then move on to a virtual or in\-person interview panel. Before extending an offer, we complete a reference check with a current or former manager and a peer. Throughout the process, we prioritize transparency, clear communication, and minimizing surprises. For your awareness you will only receive correspondence from recruiting@vestwell.com any other domain not ending in vestwell.com is not our Recruitment team. *Vestwell's* *Privacy Policy.* *Attention California residents: In the course of conducting our business and complying with federal, state, and local government regulations governing such matters as employment, tax, insurance, etc., we must collect Personal Information from you. jobs.title: Transportation Technician 3 (In-Training) | Multiple
jobs.description: **Description** --------------- **About WSDOT** The Washington State Department of Transportation (WSDOT) is a multimodal agency with a global reputation for excellence. Our dedicated workforce plans, designs, builds, and operates an integrated transportation system that safely and efficiently moves people and goods throughout the state. In addition to maintaining over 20,000 lane miles of state highway and 4,100 bridges, WSDOT leads an award\-winning Active Transportation Plan, manages the world's longest floating bridge, and operates the largest ferry system in the nation! **The Opportunity** WSDOT is currently seeking multiple Transportation Technician 3 In\-Training professionals to support project delivery in the Eastern Region. These positions provide essential technical support throughout the design, construction, and Plans, Specifications, and Estimates (PS\&E) phases of transportation projects, contributing to their successful and timely completion. Working alongside project inspectors and managers, these roles assist with construction activities, project documentation, and safety planning to ensure compliance with established standards and procedures. You will also work with a team to contribute to the development of plans, specifications, estimates, reports and other engineering documents. These positions play a vital role in maintaining safe work environments, supporting efficient project delivery, and advancing WSDOT’s commitment to a safe and reliable transportation system. **What to Expect** *You may work near high\-volume, high\-speed traffic, stand for extended periods, and navigate rough, steep, or uneven terrain.* Among the varied range of responsibilities held within this role, the Transportation Technician 3 In\-Training will: * Inspect various phases of highway construction projects, ensuring contractor work complies with approved plans, specifications, special provisions, and applicable standards. * Perform materials testing and inspections for subgrade, surfacing, paving, and structural projects, including density testing, asphalt inspection, and concrete testing. * Document construction activities by maintaining field notes, calculating quantities, preparing daily inspection reports, verifying calculations, and assisting with final records and as\-built documentation. * Develop and revise construction contract plans using computer\-aided design (CAD) software, including MicroStation and OpenRoads, in accordance with WSDOT design standards and guidelines. * Prepare engineering documents, special provisions, cost estimates, structure notes, and quantity tabulations while performing calculations for elevations, grades, coordinates, curves, and construction quantities. * Assist with roadway design activities, including intersections, cross sections, signing, and quantity estimates, using applicable design manuals, construction standards, and traffic data. * Conduct construction and design surveys by operating and maintaining survey equipment, collecting field data, performing computations, and assisting with project layout and topographic measurements. * Support project delivery by organizing project records and documentation, maintaining assigned vehicles and equipment, participating in safety meetings and technical training, and collaborating with contractors, project teams, and the public. **Qualifications** This is a Transportation Technician 3 position. However, the hiring manager reserves the right to fill the position at a lower level in the classification series based on candidate qualifications, providing an opportunity for an individual to gain the required experience on the job as part of a formal “in\-training” plan. **To qualify at the Transportation Technician 1 level, the following competencies are required:** * **Applied Technical Engineering Skills:** Demonstrated ability to perform transportation engineering technician work such as construction inspection, material testing, surveying, engineering data collection, drafting, plan preparation, or contract administration through professional experience. **To qualify at the Transportation Technician 2 level, the following competencies are required:** * **Engineering Fundamentals Knowledge:** Demonstrated understanding of engineering principles through formal education or equivalent experience in one or more of the following areas: civil, structural, geotechnical, traffic, or transportation engineering; soil mechanics; or other closely related disciplines. **To qualify at the Transportation Technician 3 level, the following competencies are required:** * **Professional Credential Recognition:** Possession of a recognized professional credential, such as Certification as an Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT), demonstrating foundational knowledge in engineering disciplines, **OR** Land Surveyor\-in\-Training (LSIT), demonstrating competency in surveying practices and legal standards. In addition to the above, the following are also  s the flexibility to choose between multiple investment options. **Social Security** All state employees are covered by the federal Social Security and Medicare systems. The state and the employee pay an equal amount into the system. **Public Service Loan Forgiveness** If you are employed by a government or not\-for\-profit organization, and meet the qualifying criteria, you may be eligible to receive student loan forgiveness under the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program. **Holidays** Full\-time and part\-time employees are entitled to paid holidays and one paid personal holiday per calendar year. **Note:** Employees who are members of certain Unions may be entitled to additional personal leave day(s), please refer to position specific Collective Bargaining Agreements for more information*.* Full\-time employees who work full monthly schedules qualify for holiday compensation if they are employed before the holiday and are in pay status for at least 80 nonovertime hours during the month of the holiday; or for the entire work shift preceding the holiday. Part\-time employees who are in pay status during the month of the holiday qualify for the holiday on a pro\-rata basis. Compensation for holidays (including personal holiday) will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status in the month to that required for full\-time employment, excluding all holiday hours. Pay status includes hours worked and time on paid leave. **Sick Leave** Full\-time employees earn eight hours of sick leave per month. Overtime eligible employees who are in pay status for less than 80 hours per month, earn a monthly proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full\-time employment. Overtime exempt employees who are in pay status for less than 80 hours per month do not earn a monthly accrual of sick leave. Sick leave accruals for part\-time employees will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full\-time employment. Pay status includes hours worked, time on paid leave and paid holiday. **Vacation (Annual Leave)** Full\-time employees accrue vacation leave at the rates specified in WAC 357\-31\-165(1\) or the applicable collective bargaining agreement (CBA). Full\-time employees who are in pay status for less than 80 nonovertime hours in a month do not earn a monthly accrual of vacation leave. Part\-time employees accrue vacation leave hours in accordance with WAC 357\-31\-165(1\) or the applicable collective bargaining agreement (CBA) on a pro rata basis. Vacation leave accrual will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full\-time employment. Pay status includes hours worked, time on paid leave and paid holiday. As provided in WAC 357\-58\-175, an employer may authorize a lump\-sum accrual of vacation leave or accelerate the vacation leave accrual rate to support the recruitment and/or retention of a candidate or employee for a Washington Management Service position. Vacation leave accrual rates may only be accelerated using the rates established WAC 357\-31\-165\. **Note:** Most agencies follow the civil service rules covering leave and holidays for **exempt** employees even though there is no requirement for them to do so. However, agencies are required to adhere to the applicable RCWs pertaining holidays and leave. **Military Leave** Washington State supports members of the armed forces with 21 days paid military leave per year. **Bereavement Leave** Most employees whose family member or household member dies, or for loss of pregnancy, are entitled to five (5\) days of paid bereavement leave. In addition, the employer may approve other available leave types for the purpose of bereavement leave. **Additional Leave** Leave Sharing Parental Leave Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Leave Without Pay Please visit the State HR Website for more detailed information regarding benefits. Updated 01\-07\-2026

Performs high\-level design/modeling to convert stakeholder needs into software solutions. Develops software and tools in support of design, infrastructure and technology platforms. Determines hardware compatibility and/or influences hardware design. Develops the architectural guidelines, specifications, and technical standards and communicates to stakeholders. **This role in summary** ------------------------ We are looking for an experienced Software Engineering Manager to lead a team responsible for the design, development, integration, and delivery of full\-stack embedded software across the home appliances product technology stack — from low\-level firmware and device drivers to operating system services, middleware, and application\-level software. This is a techno\-managerial role requiring strong embedded software expertise combined with proven people management and engineering leadership capabilities. The ideal candidate will drive technical excellence, build high\-performing teams, ensure predictable execution, and collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to deliver high\-quality, reliable, and scalable software solutions. The role requires the ability to guide technical and architectural decisions, manage engineering priorities and resources, develop talent, and foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement. **Your responsibilities will include** -------------------------------------- 1\. Technical Leadership \& Architecture * Provide technical direction for full\-stack embedded software development, spanning firmware, device drivers, operating systems, middleware, and application software. * Guide software architecture, design decisions, technology selection, and hardware/software integration to ensure scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions. * Drive engineering best practices, architecture/design reviews, software quality, automation, and adoption of modern technologies and tools. 2\. Engineering Execution \& Delivery * Own end\-to\-end software engineering execution, ensuring delivery commitments, milestones, resource plans, and quality objectives are achieved. * Drive Agile/Scrum practices, backlog prioritization, execution tracking, and proactive management of technical risks, dependencies, and resource constraints. * Establish and monitor engineering KPIs covering delivery predictability, software quality, productivity, test automation, and continuous improvement. 3\. People Management \& Talent Development * Lead, manage, and develop a high\-performing engineering team through clear performance expectations, regular feedback, coaching, and career development. * Identify technical competency gaps and drive targeted development plans, mentoring, training, and hands\-on learning opportunities. * Drive talent acquisition, workforce planning, succession planning, and development of future technical leaders. 4\. Embedded Software \& Connected Systems * Provide technical oversight across embedded software and firmware development using C/C\+\+, including device drivers, middleware, embedded operating systems, and application\-level software. * Guide development across embedded platforms such as RTOS, Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP, and Zephyr, ensuring performance, reliability, and hardware/software integration. * Drive technical alignment across connected\-product architectures, including device\-to\-cloud communication, APIs, telemetry, OTA updates, and cloud platforms such as AWS. 5\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Product Integration * Partner with Product, Hardware, Systems, Controls, Test, QA, Cloud, and Cybersecurity teams to align software roadmaps, priorities, and integrated product delivery. * Translate business and product requirements into engineering plans, technical solutions, and resource commitments while driving alignment across global teams. * Communicate engineering progress, technical trade\-offs, risks, and delivery status effectively to technical and business stakeholders. **Minimum requirements** ------------------------ * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field. * 12–15 years of professional experience in embedded software engineering or full\-stack embedded development. * 3–5 years of experience in direct people management or engineering management roles. * Proven experience leading engineering teams and delivering complex embedded software programs. * Demonstrated ability to balance technical leadership, people management, engineering execution, and stakeholder expectations. **Preferred skills and experiences** ------------------------------------ * Exposure to AWS, cloud infrastructure, and IoT services. * Experience with connected products or consumer electronics. * Familiarity with AI/ML and Generative AI tools for improving software engineering productivity. * Understanding of cybersecurity and DevOps practices. **Additional information** -------------------------- * Embedded Systems \& Architecture: Strong knowledge of embedded systems architecture, firmware development, microcontrollers/microprocessors, hardware/software integration, and embedded platforms (any of these RTOS, Embedded Linux, Android/AOSP, and Zephyr). * Programming \& Development: Good proficiency in C/C\+\+, with working knowledge of Python for scripting, automation, and engineering tools. * Software Quality \& Testing: Experience with unit, integration, system\-level testing, test automation, debugging, root cause analysis, and defect prevention. * Connected Systems \& Cloud: Understanding of connected\-product architecture, device\-to\-cloud communication, APIs, telemetry, OTA updates, and AWS/cloud infrastructure (preferred). * Modern Engineering Practices: Familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps, cybersecurity, and AI/Gen AI tools for improving software engineering productivity. \#LI\-II1 Connect with us and learn more about Whirlpool Corporation See what it's like to work at Whirlpool by visiting Whirlpool Careers. You will turn ambiguous customer problems into scoped engineering work and own delivery across the integrated workflow, from investigation and design through release and outcome verification. Prior training: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience. **Helpful experience** ---------------------- * Production AI integrations, tool\-using agents, structured\-output contracts, automated evaluations, or human\-in\-the\-loop workflows. * Cloud services, asynchronous processing, browser automation, or reliable business execution with idempotency and recovery. **What early success looks like** --------------------------------- Within your first 90 days, develop a working understanding of the integrated workflow and its users; with support from team lead, steer a meaningful, scoped improvement from problem clarification through safe release; add reusable regression coverage; verify the result the customer expected; and share learning that helps the team deliver the next improvement. **How we work** --------------- Our workflow spans productivity plugins and API/proxy, planning agents and evaluations on a shared AI brokering platform, and backend services that execute core domain functions via API contracts. We value engineers who can understand the broader context of each work item, trace the full workflow, and direct coding agents with the right context across components. We assess engineering judgment and demonstrated delivery, not proficiency in a particular programming language, framework, editor, or AI\-tool interface. Strong transferable experience and the ability to learn our stack are welcome. **What you will do** -------------------- ### **Agentic development:** Use agentic development tools to investigate, plan, implement, test, debug, review, and ship code. Define context and task boundaries, verify generated output, and stay accountable for the result. ### **SDD and context engineering:** Apply spec\-driven development and context engineering. Maintain specs, agents, and context as code (instructions, skills, prompts) in the repository. ### **Production AI:** Improve production AI workflows with context and tool design, structured\-output   logs, traces, saved results, and user feedback. Fix repeat root causes and verify the fix in production. Use outcome measures (successful orders and estimates, completion reliability, repeat usage) to prioritize improvements with Product. ### **Communication and sharing:** Communicate evidence, tradeoffs, and uncertainty clearly. Document what you learn so the team does not depend on one expert. Protect customer data and credentials, escalate risk early, and follow access controls and release governance. **How to apply** ---------------- If you meet most of these qualifications but not all of them, we encourage you to apply. We value transferable experience and do not expect you to match every item. In your application, include examples of your work that show how you deliver and verify software, including how you direct agentic development tools and validate their output. Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results. jobs.description: ### **About Xnurta** Xnurta, powered by SparkX, is an AI\-native retail media and advertising optimization platform for brands, sellers and agencies on Amazon and beyond. We combine multi\-agent AI systems, predictive analytics and deep domain expertise to deliver advertising performance at scale. ### **About the Role** Xnurta is strengthening its AI capabilities for advertising and commerce. We are looking for senior engineers who can independently own important technical problems and turn solutions into production systems. This is a Senior Individual Contributor role; people management is not a requirement. Candidates may specialize in data, model training and optimization, or AI/agentic systems. We expect substantial depth in at least one area and effective collaboration across the others—not mastery of every part of the stack. ### **Specialization Tracks** * Data and Training Data: Data modeling, quality, lineage, feature and sample construction, and feedback\-data management. Example: Turn business events, strategies, actions, and outcomes into trusted, reusable training and evaluation datasets; prevent leakage and training\-serving inconsistencies * Model Training and Algorithm Optimization: Predictive/decision models or large language models; training, fine\-tuning, evaluation, error analysis, and iteration. Example: Improve task effectiveness, budget allocation, or execution quality; design sound offline evaluations and online controlled experiments * AI / Agentic Systems: Tool use, workflow orchestration, state management, permissions, execution reliability, and observability. Example: Build agents that complete real tasks, including retries, idempotency, approvals, failure recovery, and outcome feedback ### **Responsibilities** * Own a critical component end to end. Take responsibility from problem definition and technical design through implementation, testing, and production release. * Solve core problems within your specialization. Improve data quality, train and optimize models, or build reliable AI/agentic systems, working with upstream and downstream teams to complete integration. * Validate improvements through experiments. Establish reproducible evaluations and appropriate baselines. Separate model, data, and engineering issues; connect offline results to real\-world value. * Own production quality. Monitor reliability, effectiveness, latency, and cost per task. Improve observability, diagnosis, and rollback mechanisms. * Build reusable capabilities. Contribute code, data standards, evaluation tools, and documentation that support multiple product lines, collaborating with teams in the U.S. and China. ### **Required Qualifications** * Deep expertise and demonstrated results in at least one specialization above, with the ability to explain the problem, approach, personal contribution, and validation method. * Experience deploying systems into production or delivering technology used by real users, with the ability to resolve data, engineering, and effectiveness issues beyond the prototype stage. * Strong coding skills. Model/data specialists should be proficient in Python and relevant tools; systems specialists should bring strong backend or distributed\-systems engineering skills. No single framework is prescribed. * Sound understanding of data quality, experiment design, and evaluation, including whether an improvement is reproducible, meaningful to the business, and worth its operating cost. * Clear English technical communication and documentation skills, and the ability to collaborate across Product, ML, Data, Engineering, and geographic locations. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Practical experience in model training/fine\-tuning, inference optimization, agent evaluation, tool execution, or learning from outcome feedback. * Experience in advertising, recommendations, search, forecasting, budget optimization, commerce, or enterprise automation. Advertising experience is not a universal prerequisite for this role. * Startup or zero\-to\-one experience, with an interest in understanding user problems directly, testing quickly, and iterating based on evidence. * Strong open\-source, research, or technical work connected to real engineering problems. Publications, degrees, and employer prestige do not substitute for delivery ability. ### **Initial Priorities** * Understand the assigned component's data, system interfaces, current effectiveness, and main bottlenecks. * Deliver a verifiable technical improvement with a clear comparison against the relevant baseline. * Integrate the improvement into production, with monitoring, documentation, and reusable engineering support. ### **Location \& Compensation** * Location: Campbell, CA (hybrid), full\-time * Base salary range: $100,000–$300,000 per year. Final leveling as Staff or Principal will reflect demonstrated technical scope and impact. ### **Responsibilities** * Define the shared data architecture. Translate AI and business requirements into data models, event schemas, ingestion patterns, and reusable datasets or interfaces. Connect advertising, commerce, and product\-usage data while preserving source definitions and customer boundaries. Prioritize improvements to existing systems rather than assuming a full rebuild. * Own end\-to\-end data delivery. Build and improve pipelines for acquisition, cleaning, normalization, storage, and consumption. Address API constraints, schema changes, duplicate records, late\-arriving data, backfills, and reconciliation so that production applications can depend on the data. * Build training, evaluation, and feedback assets. Develop versioned datasets and reproducible preparation workflows, with appropriate labels, outcome\-maturity rules, and safeguards against leakage and training\-serving inconsistencies. * Enable credible experimentation and measurement. Assess coverage, freshness, reliability, permitted uses, integration effort, and recurring cost before committing to a source or collection approach. * Make quality, governance, and cost operational. Establish lineage, ownership, validation, observability, access controls, and data\-use boundaries. Track storage, processing, and acquisition costs, including cost per customer or useful dataset. Improve efficiency without compromising reliability or evaluation quality. * Lead through hands\-on implementation and collaboration. Deliver critical components, review designs and code, and mentor engineers. Agree interfaces and responsibilities with U.S. and China teams so shared data capabilities support multiple product lines without unnecessary duplication. ### **Required Qualifications** * A track record of owning production data systems across multiple stages of the lifecycle, from source acquisition and data design to downstream consumption and operational support. * Strong SQL and Python skills, practical data\-modeling expertise, and experience building reliable batch and/or event\-driven pipelines, orchestration, storage, and data interfaces. Able to infer data requirements from the task or model objective rather than relying only on a supplied specification. * Sound understanding of event instrumentation, metric definitions, attribution or delayed outcomes, and the data requirements of controlled experiments. Able to partner with ML and analytics specialists on valid measurement. * Practical judgment on data quality, source permissions, tenant isolation, access, and the cost\-versus\-freshness trade\-off. Shared architecture must not imply unrestricted reuse of customer data for training or across customers. * Ability to move between architecture and implementation, independently resolve ambiguous problems, and explain technical trade\-offs to product and business partners. * Clear English technical communication and documentation skills, with experience collaborating across teams and geographic locations. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience connecting data infrastructure to model development, agent workflows, or optimization platforms, with measurable downstream impact. * Experience in advertising, recommendations, search, commerce, or other systems with decisions, actions, and delayed feedback. Relevant data and AI experience matters more than advertising\-industry tenure. * Experience with experimentation platforms, data observability, feature pipelines, offline replay, or human\-feedback data. * Startup or zero\-to\-one experience, including building useful capabilities with a small team and extending existing infrastructure pragmatically. * Experience evaluating external data providers or combining first\-party and third\-party data under explicit usage permissions. ### **Initial Priorities** * Map the current data lifecycle, consumers, ownership, quality gaps, and costs; propose a prioritized architecture and delivery plan with the existing teams. * Deliver one production\-ready, versioned dataset linking decisions and actions to outcomes, with lineage and quality checks, and validate its usefulness for an agreed model or product use case. * Establish the data instrumentation and reproducible measurement workflow for a pilot comparing production algorithms and human\-operated workflows, alongside ML, Product, and QA. ### **Measures of Success** Relevant measures include completeness and freshness of decision\-action\-outcome records, data reliability, reproducibility of datasets and experiment results, time required to prepare useful data, adoption across product lines, and unit data costs.
